JOB DESCRIPTION:

Position Summary

The Electronic Systems Engineer is responsible for the design and development of pneumatic and hydraulic brake systems controls, for passenger rail transit vehicles.

The primary objectives of this position are to develop a braking system control on time and specification compliance while achieving a high level of customer satisfaction and minimizing or mitigating risks through analysis and testing.


Functions:

  • Development of software for real time embedded controls utilized in the rail industry. Controllers include but are not limited to hydraulic and pneumatic braking controllers, HVAC controllers, and entry system controllers.
  • Development of Software documentation suites per IEEE standards, EN standards, or other project requirements. Proficiency with word processing, spreadsheets, and presentations under windows based operating systems.
  • Working within an engineering team environment including system, mechanical, product, and test engineers for product development and deployment.
  • Working within a program management team and providing input to develop and maintain project schedules and to understand the impact and consequences of project delays.
  • Working closely with customer(s) on and off-site during all phases of the project including design meetings and presentations, testing, commissioning, and technical support. National and International travel to be expected and will be dictated by project phase. Total annual travel is estimated to be approximately 6 non-consecutive weeks per year on average
  • Provide support and assistance to other colleagues, as directed, and any other duties as requested.
  • Travel is primarily local during the business day, although some out-of-the-area and overnight travel may be expected.
  • Must be able to comply with quality, product safety, and HSE rules, guidelines and regulations. Be energy conscious, if applicable.
  • Must understand and comply with applicable standards. ( i.e.: ISO 9001, ISO 22163, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 50001, AAR, and CMMI).
  • Maintain and safeguard business records.

Skills

  • Programming Skills: C++, LabVIEW, Visual Studio Suite, Linux Embedded, WinCE, Ascet, CODESYS
  • Communications: Ethernet protocols, CAN, CAN Open, and Serial communications.
  • Possess a general understanding of distributed control systems
  • Familiarity with IEEE and/or EN Documentation Requirements

Knowledge

  • Knowledge of, experience with, and commitment to software engineering process methods SCM (Software Configuration Management), SASD (Structured Analysis/Structured Design) or OOT (Object Oriented Technology), SEI CMMI (Software Engineering Institute’s Capability Maturity Model Integrated)
  • Knowledge of, experience with, and commitment to software engineering process methods SCM (Software Configuration Management), SASD (Structured Analysis/Structured Design) or OOT (Object Oriented Technology), SEI CMMI (Software Engineering Institute’s Capability Maturity Model Integrated)

Education and experience

  • Bachelor’s degree

  • Experience in rail, automotive, factory automation, or another industrial environment
  • Experience with electronics test equipment such as multi-meters, oscilloscopes, frequency generators, etc.

title: SC/DV SQL Server Architect CGEMJP00362235
description:
Role Title: SQL Server Architect - Cloud Resilience & High Availability (AWS Focus)

Duration: 03/03/2027 - likely to be extended depending on the vetting checks

Location: London. Hybrid, 3- 4 days per week onsite

Rate: up to £662.40 p/d Umbrella inside IR35

Clearance required: Active SC Clearance with DV Clerance eligibility or ideally Active DV Clearance

Role purpose / summary

Our client previously delivered a large scale, on premises deployment of SharePoint for Hydrogen in 2017. This implementation was designed for high availability, incorporating full disaster recovery and resilience across the application, SQL Server, and storage layers. The client is now looking to transition to SharePoint Subscription Edition and re-platform the solution onto AWS.

As part of this programme, the SQL Server Architect will be responsible for designing, validating, and optimising the SQL Server platform that underpins a complex, enterprise grade SharePoint Farm hosted on AWS. The engagement will begin with an eight week Proof of Value (PoV) focused on proving SQL Server resilience patterns, including Always On and HA/DR using cloud native AWS services. Experience with Azure is also beneficial to support comparative assessment.

Subject to a successful PoV, the role will progress into a comprehensive design phase running through to the end of 2026, producing a scalable, resilient, and compliant SQL Server architecture aligned to SharePoint and organisational standards.

The architect will work closely with the Capgemini Infrastructure Architect and the AWS ProServe team to assess, validate, and recommend the most suitable AWS native resilience options. Your findings will contribute directly to the formal recommendations report and shape the approach taken forward into the detailed design phase.

Engagement Phases & Focus

Phase 1 - Proof of Value (PoV): Resilience Patterns (Weeks 1-8)

Objective: Prove the viability and performance of HA/DR patterns for SQL Server supporting SharePoint on AWS.

Key Activities

  • Work with Infra Architect to define PoV success criteria (RPO/RTO, failover time, throughput, recovery steps).
  • Stand up PoV topology:
  • SQL Server Always On Availability Groups on Amazon EC2 across multiple AZs.
  • Storage using EBS (io1/io2 / gp3) and, where required, FSx for Windows File Server for cluster dependencies.
  • Integrate CloudWatch, AWS Backup, Systems Manager, and automation as appropriate (CloudFormation/Terraform/PowerShell).
  • Confirm and test SharePoint compatibility (content/search/service DBs).
  • Produce pattern catalogue and TCO/performance findings and assessment of complexity to introduce and in terms of operability and maintainability for each of the chosen patterns (Always On availability groups, Always On failover cluster instances (FCI), SIOS DataKeeper, AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery, and AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS)).

Deliverables

  • PoV Plan & Success Metrics
  • Resilience Pattern Catalogue (HA/DR topologies, pros/cons, prerequisites)
  • Testing of DR options with SharePoint team.
  • Performance Baseline & Findings Report (throughput/latency, failover timings)
  • PoV Recommendation & Next Step Design Decisions

Core Responsibilities

  • Architect HA/DR for SQL Server in AWS to support a mission critical SharePoint farm.
  • Evaluate native AWS options (EC2, EBS, FSx, Route 53, CloudWatch, Backup, Systems Manager, CloudFormation).
  • Design and validate Always On patterns, listener routing, quorum/witness.
  • Collaborate with the Infrastructure Architect to ensure network/IAM/security fit.
  • Produce documentation, runbooks, and handover materials for operations.

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • 10+ years with Microsoft SQL Server (2016+) architecture and operations.
  • Proven delivery of Always On Availability Groups, FCI, log shipping/replication.
  • Large scale SharePoint database design/operations experience.
  • Strong performance engineering (indexing, I/O, concurrency, wait stats, storage optimisation).
  • Deep understanding of networking for Always On, listener design, DNS failover.
  • Excellent documentation and stakeholder communication.

Desirable

  • Azure SQL HA/DR exposure (SQL MI, zone redundancy) for comparative design decisions.
  • Hands on AWS deployment for SQL workloads (EC2, EBS, FSx, Route 53, CloudWatch, Backup, SSM).
  • Automation tooling (CloudFormation/Terraform, PowerShell DSC).
  • Experience with regulated environments and security hardening.

All profiles will be reviewed against the required skills and experience. Due to the high number of applications we will only be able to respond to successful applicants in the first instance. We thank you for your interest and the time taken to apply!

If you receive suspicious outreach claiming to be from us, please contact us via the ManpowerGroup website.

title: Senior Research Assistant - Genetic Resources Team
description:
Reports to: Lebanon Genebank Manager
Location: Terbol, Lebanon

Purpose of the position

The Senior Research Assistant will provide technical and operational support to research, genebank, and project activities, contributing to the conservation, characterization, regeneration, and management of plant genetic resources. The position will support the planning and implementation of field, laboratory, and genebank activities; ensure accurate collection, recording, and management of research data; and contribute to the implementation, monitoring, documentation, and reporting of project activities and deliverables.

About ICARDA

The International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry Areas (ICARDA) is a treaty-based international non-profit research organization supported by CGIAR.
ICARDA’s mission is to reduce poverty, enhance food, water, and nutritional security, as well as environmental health in the face of global challenges including climate change. We do this through innovative science, strategic partnerships, linking research to development and capacity development that take into account gender equality and the role of youth in transforming the dry areas. ICARDA works in partnership with governments, universities, civil society, national agricultural research organization, other CGIAR Research Centers, and the private sector. With its temporary Headquarters in Beirut, Lebanon, ICARDA operates in regional and country offices across Africa, Asia and the Middle East. For more information: .

Main responsibilities

· Coordinate and implement field and laboratory activities under the Low-Methane Forages Project.

· Establish and manage forage germplasm experiments, including planting, crop management, characterization, biomass assessment, harvesting, and post-harvest handling.

· Collect agro-morphological, phenological, productivity, and other project-specific data according to agreed protocols.

· Coordinate the collection, labelling, processing, storage, and transfer of forage samples for methane-related screening and analysis.

· Ensure the accurate tracking of germplasm and plant samples from field establishment through processing and delivery to project partners.

· Maintain, verify, analyze, and report project datasets, including characterization, productivity, sample-processing, and shipment records.

· Supervise field workers and technical support staff and ensure the timely completion of activities according to project protocols and workplans.

· Coordinate activities with ICARDA scientists, other CGIAR centres, LARI, and other project partners.

· Contribute to project reporting, technical documentation, training, meetings, and capacity-development activities.

· Support additional GRS activities, including germplasm regeneration, characterization, seed processing, viability testing, conservation, and documentation.

· Perform other related duties as agreed with the supervisor.

Requirements

Education, qualifications, and experience

· MSc in Agriculture, Plant Science, Biology, Plant Genetic Resources, or a related discipline, with a minimum of three years’ relevant experience. A BSc in a relevant discipline, combined with substantial directly relevant experience, may also be considered.

· Demonstrated experience in supporting the planning, implementation, and monitoring of research activities and experiments according to established protocols.

· Demonstrated experience in collecting, recording, organizing, and maintaining research data and related documentation accurately.

· Demonstrated ability to coordinate field and/or laboratory activities and provide guidance to research technicians, daily labor, students, or other support staff, as required.

· Ability to plan and prioritize research activities, anticipate operational or technical problems, and contribute to practical solutions.

· Demonstrated ability to work independently while maintaining effective coordination with scientists, technical staff, and other functions.

· Ability to operate and maintain relevant field and/or laboratory equipment and ensure compliance with established procedures, safety requirements, and research protocols.

· Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel; experience with research databases, data-management systems, or relevant statistical software is an advantage.

· Ability to contribute to the preparation of technical reports, research summaries, presentations, and other research documentation.

· Fluency in English and the relevant national language, spoken and written, is essential.

· Demonstrated ability to work harmoniously with diverse colleagues and functions.

· Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks and activities efficiently and meet established deadlines.

Benefits

Terms of appointment, salary, and benefits

This is a nationally recruited position open for Lebanese nationals for which ICARDA offers an attractive compensation package including a competitive salary, medical insurance, 30 days of annual leave, five months’ maternity leave, 15 days’ paternity leave. The successful candidate will be offered an initial contract of 3 years, renewable subject to continued need for the position and satisfactory performance.

Please be advised that ICARDA accepts applications only in English, as per the organization's standard communication language. Applications in other languages will not be considered.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Gate-level Noise (Signal Integrity) / STA CAD Engineer
description:
Imagine what you could do here! At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products very quickly. Do you want to bring passion and dedication to your job? There's no telling what you could accomplish at Apple. The people who work here have reinvented entire industries with Apple Hardware products. The same real passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices - we continue to strengthen our commitment to leave the world better than we found it! As a member of the CAD group, you will support the gate-level glitch noise and static timing analysis (STA) methodologies that ensure the signal integrity and robustness of Apple silicon across advanced technology nodes. In this role, you will learn and apply sign-off methodologies, margin models, and production CAD flows for crosstalk glitch and timing closure using industry-standard tools, under the guidance of senior engineers. You will work closely with CAD and physical design teams, assist with tool qualifications, help execute tapeout ECO tasks, and gain exposure to modern automation - including AI-agent workflows - used to scale analysis across our largest SOC designs.

In this role, your primary responsibilities will include: Assist with applying established sign-off methodologies, noise margins, and tool qualification procedures for gate-level glitch noise and static timing analysis (STA), under senior engineer guidance. Run and maintain existing production CAD flows and scripts for core noise and STA tools, supporting constraint setup through tapeout sign-off. Help execute glitch noise analysis tasks - including checking glitch thresholds and propagation reports under supervision. Assist with root-cause analysis of crosstalk glitch and timing anomalies, learning to use established automated triage workflows and AI-agent pipelines. Work closely with design and physical design teams on noise/timing constraints and flow issues, escalating closure and waiver decisions to senior engineers. Help execute noise and timing ECO tasks to support design convergence toward tapeout. Participate in tool and version qualification activities, helping track QoR and performance data against golden baselines. Help maintain documentation and learn noise and STA best practices from the team.

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 1-2 years of experience in CAD methodology, EDA support, or digital design.
  • Foundational understanding of gate-level signal integrity concepts, including crosstalk glitch noise and static timing analysis (STA).
  • Exposure to industry-standard SI and STA tools (e.g., PrimeTime-SI, Tempus, or equivalent) through coursework, internship, or self-study.
  • Basic scripting skills in Python, Tcl, and/or Perl.
  • Willingness to learn noise and timing sign-off and ECO concepts with team support.

  • Participate in shift handoffs, tiered daily management, technical training, root-cause investigations, PM improvement, commissioning, and knowledge transfer for new or modified equipment.

Job Qualifications

  • Working proficiency in Maintenance Connection or a comparable CMMS, including reviewing assigned work, documenting labor and parts, recording findings, and completing technically useful closeout notes.

  • Must be able to pass a Pulmonary Function Test.

  • Ability to work safely around department chemicals using required engineering controls, procedures, PPE, and respiratory protection, with reasonable accommodation where applicable.
  • Ability to lift more than 50 pounds.
  • Ability to work in confined spaces and on uneven surfaces.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate degree, technical certificate, apprenticeship, or equivalent formal training in industrial maintenance, electrical technology, controls, vacuum technology, or a related discipline.
  • Experience with ASI vacuum systems or comparable chamber, autoclave, vacuum-pump, and process-control equipment.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office and digital maintenance documentation.
  • Applied math skills for electrical, vacuum, pressure, temperature, measurement, and troubleshooting calculations.

title: Consulting Power Engineer
description:

title: IS&T Electrical Architect
description:
Req ID:529490

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

We are looking for an IS&T Electrical Architect , based in Saint Ouen.

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your expertise in electrical applications strategy and architecture in a cutting-edge field.

You'll play a crucial role in shaping the future of Alstom’s electrical engineering solutions, ensuring alignment with global business processes and driving transformative initiatives. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (Engineering, IS&T, and Operations), lead pre-studies and high-level designs, and align solutions with business strategies, and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of defining and maintaining long-term solutions roadmaps and strategies, but also proactively anticipating solution evolutions to drive Alstom’s business transformation.

We’ll look to you for:

  • Ensuring alignment with global business processes for Electrical Engineering solutions
  • Defining and maintaining a long-term solutions roadmap and strategy
  • Conducting pre-studies and delivering high-level designs
  • Promoting and leading the evolution of Alstom’s Core Model
  • Supporting operations teams with critical incident management
  • Driving digital transformation for engineering processes
  • Enabling agility and robustness in Core Model adoption
  • Ensuring compatibility with technical and security patterns


All about you

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

  • Degree in Engineering, preferably in Information Technology
  • More than 10 years of experience in PLM/Electrical solutions, including business/functional architecture, project management, and solution deployments
  • Solid knowledge of engineering electrical business processes from industrial companies designing and manufacturing complex products
  • Strong expertise in Electrical solutions (e.g., Zuken, ETAP – ideally E3Series and SEE Electrical)
  • Excellent communication, efficiency, and execution abilities
  • Leadership skills with a business value-oriented mindset
  • Fluent in English and comfortable working autonomously in an international environment
  • Intellectual curiosity, creativity, and resilience


Things you’ll enjoy

Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

  • Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
  • Work with new security standards for rail signalling
  • Utilise our inclusive and agile working environment
  • Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
  • Progress towards leadership roles or specialized expertise
  • Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: Staff Engineer (Richmond)
description:
Dominion Energy is committed to providing reliable, affordable, and increasingly clean energy that powers our customers every day. If you want to work for a purpose-driven company that values safety and collaboration, we’re looking for you. You won’t just find a job here; you’ll find your career. Review the position below and apply today.

We offer a hybrid 3-2 work schedule (three days in the office, two days of teleworking) to accommodate the need for flexibility.

Military service members and veterans with ranks from E5-E9, W1-CW5, or O3-O6, plus appropriate equivalent combination of education and years of experience as outlined below will be considered for this opportunity.

At this time, Dominion Energy cannot transfer or sponsor a work visa or employment authorization for this position.

Job Summary

About the CVOW-C Project

Dominion Energy is constructing and operating the Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind (CVOW) project, the largest offshore wind project in the United States. CVOW is located in federal waters on the Outer Continental Shelf, approximately 27 miles off the coast of Virginia Beach.

The Staff Engineer – Regulatory Compliance provides engineering and technical support for the CVOW-C regulatory compliance program under the direction of the Regulatory Compliance Manager. The position develops, reviews, and validates engineering content supporting submissions and communications to BOEM, BSEE, the Marine Minerals Administration (MMA), and the Certified Verification Agent (CVA). The role evaluates technical records, identifies compliance risks, supports resolution of regulatory comments, and helps ensure that project engineering, fabrication, installation, commissioning, and as-built documentation are accurate, technically defensible, and consistent with approved project requirements. The Regulatory Compliance Manager retains responsibility for regulatory strategy, external commitments, approvals, and formal agency submissions.

Core Responsibilities
Prepare, review, and validate engineering content supporting Facility As-Built, Facility Design, Fabrication and Installation Reports, agency responses, inspections, and other regulatory submittals under 30 CFR Part 285.
Maintain technical consistency and traceability among design documents, fabrication and installation records, commissioning results, as-built records, CVA findings, and applicable federal and state permit commitments.
Identify potential regulatory noncompliance, incomplete evidence, conflicting technical information, and other technical risks; promptly communicate and escalate them to the Regulatory Compliance Manager and project leadership.

This role is the top progression level position in the Engineer series. Includes senior to technical expert engineers, able to perform highly difficult and very complex work requiring extensive knowledge of the subject matter and significant experience within functional assignment area. Plans and conducts complex work requiring independent judgment in the evaluation, selection, adaptation and modification of standard techniques, procedures, and criteria. Devises new and innovative approaches to previously undefined problems encountered and develops innovative and original industry-wide engineering criteria ensuring compliance with design criteria and standards. Possesses and applies advanced engineering knowledge and skills to provide technical expertise, guidance to all levels of engineers and/or team leadership. Possesses and applies advanced knowledge and technical skills to solve complex engineering problems, or to plan and coordinate medium to large scale engineering projects or varied assignments requiring diverse knowledge of engineering principles and practices. Serves as a resource to management on more complex engineering problems and issues. Perform research to find innovative and cost-effective engineering solutions to operational problems within assigned area. Serve as a technical expert on engineering related legal and regulatory issues to outside entities.

Expectations

Plans and conducts complex work requiring independent judgment, devises innovative approaches to previously undefined problems, and serves as a resource to management and a technical expert on engineering-related legal and regulatory issues with outside entities.

Typical Responsibilities

  • Serve as the senior engineering subject matter expert supporting regulatory compliance and recommend and maintain engineering review criteria, acceptance methods, technical checklists, and documentation standards for regulatory deliverables, subject to approval by the responsible engineering authority and Regulatory Compliance Manager.
  • Lead complex engineering evaluations of nonconformances, deviations, design changes, and field conditions in structural, geotechnical, electrical, and cable disciplines; develop technically supported recommendations concerning fitness for purpose, design-basis conformance, required corrective action, and regulatory impact for approval by the responsible engineering authority and Regulatory Compliance Manager.
  • Evaluate design changes and field modifications for impact on the approved design basis.
  • Interpret complex provisions of 30 CFR Part 285 and applicable BOEM, BSEE, and Marine Minerals Administration (MMA) permit conditions; develop draft technical positions and, when designated by the Regulatory Compliance Manager, represent Dominion Energy as an engineering subject matter expert in technical discussions with regulators and the CVA.
  • Review engineering analyses, technical dispositions, and regulatory submittal content prepared by engineers, contractors, and consultants; provide technical concurrence within delegated authority and identify matters requiring approval by the responsible design authority, Regulatory Compliance Manager, Legal, or management.
  • Coordinate with Engineering, Commissioning, Quality, Operations, the Owner’s Engineer, and the CVA to validate the as-built configuration baseline and identify CSSE inspection, testing, maintenance, and record-retention requirements that must be transferred into Operations.
  • Research and develop innovative, cost-effective engineering solutions to previously undefined technical and regulatory problems.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers, and brief management and executive leadership on significant regulatory issues, risks, and recommendations.

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Experience

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Experience

  • 8+ years of relevant engineering experience (an Engineering PhD may be substituted for up to 5 years of experience based on research engineering work on related projects, as approved by executive leadership).
  • Extensive knowledge of engineering theories, principles, and practices across a broad variety of assignments and related fields.
  • Extensive skill in advanced techniques and in the modification and extension of theories, precepts, and practices of the field and related disciplines.
  • Full knowledge of business, financial, and contractual matters.
  • Recognized by other engineers and management as an expert in the assigned area.
  • Provides expert technical advice to other engineers and management.
  • Strong planning, project management, and technical and organizational leadership skills.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, including technical writing.
  • In-depth knowledge of computer applications and ability to perform engineering calculations using applicable software (e.g., MATLAB, Excel).
  • Proven decision-making skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to think analytically and solve complex problems.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret and apply codes, regulations, and practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to process information quickly and effectively manage multiple tasks.
  • Equally effective working independently or in a team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with offshore wind or other offshore renewable energy projects and certification processes.
  • Working knowledge of 30 CFR Part 285 regulations.
  • Experience supporting BOEM, BSEE, Marine Minerals Administration (MMA), or successor federal agency regulatory compliance, as applicable.
  • Experience with Certified Verification Agent (CVA) programs or independent verification processes.
  • Proficiency with document control systems and project scheduling tools.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred. The employee must understand the limits of delegated engineering authority and requirements for review or approval by the responsible Engineer of Record or licensed Professional Engineer.

REQUIRED ENGINEERING CRITERIA:
For placement of a candidate in the Engineer job series, the following criteria must be met:

Possess a 4-year Engineering degree from an ABET accredited Engineering program based on the year that the Engineering program was accredited by ABET, or

Possess a 4-year Engineering degree from an institution outside of the U.S. which is accredited through the country's own Engineering accrediting body under the Washington Accord as a full signatory, and is a degree that was recognized by the country's accrediting body on or after the date that full signatory status was achieved, or

Possess a 4-year degree in Engineering (non-ABET accredited), Physics, Chemistry, Math or Engineering Technology and a post-graduate Engineering degree from an institution where the undergraduate degree in the same Engineering discipline is ABET-accredited based on the year the Engineering program was accredited by ABET, or

Holds or has previously held a valid U.S. Professional Engineer license.

Under the supervision of a licensed clinical neuropsychologist, the psychometrist will administer and score a range of standardized neuropsychological measures, assist with data collection for clinical trials, and contribute to the integrity of cognitive assessments used in both clinical and research contexts.

Job Responsibilities

  • Administer formal cognitive assessments for evaluation of memory and other cognitive disorders, adhering to high quality standardized administration and scoring procedures.
  • Score assessments accurately using available normative data; track and organize data for clinical and research use.
  • Maintain secure, well-organized records and ensure strict confidentiality of all patient and study data.
  • Participate as a rater in clinical trials focused on memory and neurodegenerative conditions; follow study specific protocols and documentation procedures.
  • Communicate respectfully and effectively with patients and multidisciplinary staff to support high-quality care and accurate assessment outcomes.

Education

  • Master's Degree in psychology, education, or a related field is required

Experience

The ideal candidate will have at least one year relevant experience in psychometric assessment, preferably in a neurology setting.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Familiarity with commonly used cognitive assessments; experience with ADAS-Cog and prior experience as a rater in clinical trials is strongly preferred.
  • Strong computer proficiency, including use of web-based platforms and Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with sensitivity to the needs of individuals with cognitive impairment and their families.

title: Project Coordinator IV (Sustainability)
description:
CLMI Group is looking for passionate construction and program management professionals to join our team! We value ambition, dedication, and innovation, and believe in building a network of talented individuals who share our commitment to making a difference.

Position Title: Project Coordinator IV (Sustainability)

Location: Los Angeles Community College District – Program Management Office (PMO), Los Angeles, CA. Candidates must be willing and able to work at any assigned LACCD college or site location and make site visits as project needs require.

Position Description:

This position is bond-eligible and is strictly limited to work associated with capital construction, modernization, and sustainability projects as defined under the BuildLACCD Bond Program. Duties performed under this position shall not include routine maintenance, repair, or operational tasks that fall within the responsibilities of facilities Maintenance & Operations (M&O). The scope of this role is exclusively tied to bond-eligible activities such as planning, design, construction, commissioning, and related project management functions necessary to deliver capital improvements consistent with LACCD’s Capital Construction Bond Program requirements and legal limitations governing bond fund expenditures.

The Project Coordinator IV – Sustainability provides project coordination, cost management, and financial controls support to the BuildLACCD Sustainability Strike Team throughout the planning, scoping, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout of sustainability and energy-related capital improvement projects across the Los Angeles Community College District (LACCD). Working under the direction of the Sustainability Strike Team Lead, this position supports the Strike Team Cost Analyst and Project Managers, and coordinates with District personnel, Campus Administration, College Project Teams (CPTs), the Program Management Office (PMO), Program Controls, and other stakeholders to support project budget development, funding verification, cost forecasting, financial reporting, and project establishment.

The position supports Districtwide sustainability initiatives, including Energy Information Systems (EIS), the Sustainability and Climate Action Roadmap, Building Management Systems (BMS), Central Plant and Local Building Decarbonization, Central Plant optimization, LED lighting upgrades, energy efficiency retrofits, renewable energy systems, Photovoltaic (PV) systems, microgrids, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure, electrification, and other sustainability-related capital improvement projects.

Duties:

  • Provide day-to-day project coordination, cost management, and financial controls support to the Strike Team Cost Analyst, Project Managers, and the Sustainability Strike Team throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Prepare, organize, and maintain project management documents, records, correspondence, reports, and other project-related communications.
  • Support project establishment and White Paper development by coordinating financial documentation, funding verification, preliminary budgets, cost estimates, and required reviews in accordance with established BuildLACCD PMO Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Coordinate with District personnel, CPTs, PMO, Program Controls, and other stakeholders to verify project budgets, available funding, cost estimates, forecasts, and financial requirements.
  • Coordinate with CPTs and PMO Cost Analysts to support budget establishment, monitoring, budget transfers, and accurate financial reporting.
  • Develop and maintain cost forecasts and Estimates-to-Complete (ETCs); track Change Order Requests (CORs), commitments, and funding availability.
  • Monitor project budgets, expenditures, contract balances, remaining encumbrances, funding availability, and financial risks to identify potential shortfalls before they affect project delivery.
  • Work with PMO Cost Analysts to verify the accuracy and integrity of project budgets and financial forecasts in accordance with established cost management procedures.
  • Participate in change management and risk assessment meetings to identify cost-related trends, risks, exposures, and potential mitigation strategies.
  • Perform monthly budget and cost reconciliations to support accurate month-end reporting, and review expenditures across multiple funding sources.
  • Coordinate with scheduling teams to assess cash flow and schedule performance impacts on costs, including variances, overruns, underruns, and forecasting concerns.
  • Review financial reports, cost performance, and progress data; communicate material variances and potential financial risks to Project Managers and appropriate stakeholders.
  • Track contract Periods of Performance (POP), contract balances, remaining encumbrances, and available funding.
  • Coordinate invoice oversight and reconciliation with accounting and project stakeholders to support timely and accurate payment processing.
  • Collaborate with PMO to validate project budget data, support stakeholder dashboards, and maintain accurate program controls databases and financial reports.
  • Gather physical completion data and coordinate updates to project budget and forecast records as appropriate.
  • Proactively identify funding issues that could delay procurement, contract execution, project initiation, or other critical activities.
  • Support compliance with applicable District requirements, BuildLACCD PMO SOPs, cost management procedures, and bond funding requirements throughout project development and implementation.
  • Perform other bond-eligible project cost management and coordination duties as directed by the Sustainability Strike Team Lead.

Requirements

Minimum Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of five (5) years of recent professional experience in engineering, project management, sustainability, project controls, cost management, and/or a related field
  • BS/BA degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Sustainability, or a related field. Four (4) additional years of qualifying experience beyond the minimum experience requirement may be substituted for the required education
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data analysis, financial modeling, budget tracking, and reporting
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint
  • Proficiency with enterprise-level Project Management Information Systems (PMIS), such as Proliance, Trimble Unity, or equivalent platforms
  • Strong writing, analytical, organizational, and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently, coordinate with diverse stakeholders, and manage multiple project priorities

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting capital improvement projects within large public works or educational facility construction programs
  • Experience with project cost management, forecasting, Estimate-to-Complete (ETC) development, and funding verification
  • Familiarity with BuildLACCD or similar capital improvement program financial controls, budget management, and project establishment processes
  • Familiarity with Division of the State Architect (DSA) design and construction processes
  • Experience supporting energy efficiency, renewable energy, electrification, or other sustainability-related capital improvement projects
  • Familiarity with data visualization or analytics tools used for project cost and performance reporting (e.g., Tableau or equivalent)

Offered rate of compensation will be based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors, including education, qualifications, experience, and geographic location. The salary range for this position is $115,000–$125,000.

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k)
  • 401k Matching
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Short Term / Long Term Disability / Life

description:
About Ticketek Entertainment Group

Ticketek Entertainment Group (TEG) is a Live Experience Group that helps people discover, access and experience the unforgettable. We believe Life is better live®.

With over 50 years in live entertainment, we sell more than 30 million tickets annually, connect with 30 million fans across Australia and New Zealand, and bring 18,000+ events to life each year. Our values guide everything we do: we partner with purpose, empower boldness within clear boundaries, and celebrate human connection – always putting the fan first.

The Client Ticketing Services Manager will join our Ticketek team based in Sydney. This role will work closely with clients from NSW's most prestigious venues, ticketing world-class entertainment events.

  • Business Development: Work with the State Manager to innovate and provide value-added solutions that increase ticket sales and build brand profile.

Capabilities to Bring

  • Brand Ambassadorship: You demonstrate a client-focused attitude and communicate with style and professionalism across all levels.
  • Problem-Solving: You possess sharp attention to detail and the ability to troubleshoot complex issues in fast-paced environments.
  • Relationship Mastery: You have the ability to develop new and existing relationships, resolving client problems in a helpful, efficient manner.
  • Technical Aptitude: You have an understanding of (or the ability to quickly learn) complex ticketing systems and digital processes.

$75,000 base + super

We’re Australasia’s home of live entertainment – from stadium tours to your local comedy show – and we look after the people who make it happen.

  • Recognition that means something: ALL STAR Awards and service milestones, celebrating the people and teams who bring our values to life every day

TEG is an equal opportunity employer committed to embracing a diverse and inclusive work environment.

If this sounds like the opportunity for you, we welcome you to apply. We believe in creating a place where our people can do their best work!

In 1976, ten independent hauliers joined forces and founded DSV in Denmark. Since then, DSV has evolved to become the world's 3rd largest supplier of global solutions within transport and logistics. Today, we add value to our customers' entire supply chain by transporting, storing, packaging, re-packaging, processing and clearing all types of goods. We work every day from our many offices in more than 80 countries to ensure a steady supply of goods to production lines, outlets, stores and consumers all over the world. Our reach is global yet our presence is local and close to our customers. Read more at www.dsv.com

Location: USA - Bridgeport, 48809 Al-227

Division: Solutions
Job Posting Title: Data Center Team Lead (3rd Shift)
Time Type: Full Time

Responsible for providing and maintaining effective material orders, customer service, and inventory management as well as various customer material movement requests. Responsible for the assembly and installation of servers and various electronic components using a variety of hand tools, power tools and measuring devices.

Tasks & Responsibilities:

  • Oversee loading and unloading of inbound and outbound freight to and from vehicles and containers including the management of shipping documents and records
  • Perform quality checks on inbound and outbound freight, checking for accurate part numbers, quantities and ensuring material is in pristine condition
  • Execute daily inventory cycle counts and replenishment orders for critical spare parts on site at the datacenter
  • Process return shipments of various electronic components utilizing multiple warehouse management systems
  • Oversee and perform the placement server racks on the datacenter floor utilizing laser measuring devices with 100% accuracy
  • Oversee and perform the population of electronic components and install cabling into server racks by following provided diagrams and schematics
  • Install rack hardware using various hand, power and measuring tools
  • Operate various types of material handling equipment such as straddle stackers, rack movers and electric pallet jacks
  • Perform and oversee cleanup activities in the work area to ensure safety, cleanliness, and adherence to 5s standards
  • Push, pull and lift frequently throughout the workday

Deliverables & Achievables:

  • Daily adherence to safety and process procedures
  • Punctuality and reliability
  • Attention to detail and a focus on quality
  • Ability to be flexible and cross-train in multiple departments within the datacenter
  • Effective delegation and coaching skills

Details/Specification/Explanation of the role specific skills

Strong interpersonal and customer service skills are required. This position will regularly interact with customers and other stakeholders on site at the datacenter in this role. The ability to forge positive working relationships with the different working groups is key to our team's success. Critical thinking abilities and strong analytical skills are needed in this role for confident decisions making based on information and data provided to meet production goals effectively, accurately, and efficiently. Experience with computers is required in this role. Knowledge of electrical safety and static discharge hazards and protocols are required as this position requires working with live electrical and electronic equipment and components. 3-5 years of related experience is required.

The individual in this position must be capable of performing all of the essential functions with or without a reasonable accommodation

Must be able to pass any federal/state/local government, airport, or company-required background checks, clearances, and/or drug and alcohol tests.

For this position, the expected base pay range is $26.25 – $26.25 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors such as relevant experience, skills, education, certifications, and geographic location, in accordance with applicable laws and company policy.

At DSV, we move more than goods. We move careers, ambitions and opportunities.

With close to 150,000 colleagues in over 90 countries, we are the global leader in transport and logistics, and it is our people who bring our services and solutions to life every day. title: *Application Subject Matter Expert III
description:
Zurich (Schaumburg, IL) seeks an Application Subject Matter Expert III to support the development of applications by understanding the requirements of customers and recommending application performance improvements to ensure alignment with business requirements. Specific duties include: understand and support customers’ processes and products to determine how they best fit within the goals of the function or business unit; engage with the solution architect in the reviews and validation of the detailed technical design for business applications provided by the supplier; determine rough order of magnitude for the level of effort/cost of new application functionality; perform quality review checks on project deliverables; support, review and validate the documentation for functional specifications; recommend application performance improvements and application decommissioning; serve as a liaison between the IT and Business Units; support the Portfolio Manager in building business cases, including cost/benefit analysis, risk assessment, and project scalability; evaluate the implementation activities, troubleshoot system environmental issues; provide impact analysis of application changes across various components holding an end-to-end view of the system; recommend integration and parallel testing criteria; and oversee conceptual design of business applications. Option to work remotely 10% of the time.

Position requires a Bachelor’s degree, or foreign equivalent, in Computer Science, Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related field of study, plus 7 years of experience in the job offered, or as a Service Delivery Manager, Service Manager, Application Architect, Subject Matter Expert, Project lead or similar position supporting the development of applications. Must have 7 years of experience working with each of the following: Mainframe z/OS; UNIX System Services; OMVS; Message Queues; XML; Xpeditor; Endevor; DB2; Datacom/DB; JCL; COBOL; PL/1; CICS; SDF II; FTP/MoveIt; SPITAB; Stored Procedures; Service Now; JIRA; Batch and real time processing; Application Development; acting as liaison between business stakeholders and IT teams to translate the business needs into strategic IT solutions; developing, testing, debugging and maintaining application code within endevor and application inventory; implementing system integrations and interfaces across multiple platforms and environments, designing solutions that reduce operational costs, licensing expenses, business risk and enhance system stability and performance; working on audit compliance reporting and user access recertification; and act as a subject matter expert for the production support and business teams. Must also have 4 years of experience working with application support, service delivery, incident management, change management and disaster recovery. Additionally, specific experience must include: working on mainframe modernization initiatives, including rehosting, transformation, and data center migrations; and Azure Storage, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Spark, ADF pipeline, and SQL DB. Option to work remotely 10% of the time.

Full time position. Apply by submitting your resumes at Zurichna.com/en/careers, Job ID: 138046.

EY Parthenon – Deals - Financial Services (Manager) (Multiple Positions) (1757751), Ernst & Young U.S. LLP, New York, NY.


Serve as a Transaction Support professional to help clients achieve their strategic goals, in acquiring or divesting assets, working with clients in the financial services sector. Examine financial statements to determine normalized cash flow and to determine the financial statements comply with laws and regulations. Inspect account books and/or accounting systems for efficiency and use of accepted accounting procedures. Organize and maintain financial records. Assess financial operations and make best-practices recommendations to management. Identify ways to improve the processes for finding and eliminating waste. Work on performance evaluations and help organizations plan the cost of doing business. Advise clients across the transaction lifecycle — from strategic assessment to implementation and post-deal integration. Identify key value drivers, challenge assumptions about future performance and work with other EY service teams to deliver an integrated service to clients. Participate in due diligence engagements related to acquisitions by private equity investor groups and strategic corporate buyers. Perform strategic development and execution of appropriate transaction structure, including the execution of financial due diligence. Analyze financial/operational results of targets. Identify post-acquisition action steps to achieve anticipated earnings/cash flow improvements. Correlate due diligence findings with client valuations. Interpret data on price, yield, stability, future investment-risk trends, and economic influences.

Manage and motivate teams of professionals with diverse skills and backgrounds. Consistently deliver quality client services by monitoring progress. Full time employment, Monday – Friday, 40 hours per week, 8:30 am – 5:30 pm.

title: Product Manager - Emission Abatement & Selective Catalytic Reduction Systems
description:
Summary

As the Product Manager for Emission Abatement & Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR) Systems, you will serve as the primary technical authority on emissions control technologies for large-bore reciprocating internal combustion engines (RICE). You will lead the engineering specification, design, integration, optimization, troubleshooting, lifecycle support, and regulatory compliance strategies for emission control systems across Enerflex’s power generation team.

This role requires deep practical knowledge of Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR), oxidation catalysts, three-way catalysts, ammonia slip catalysts, urea/DEF and ammonia dosing systems, emissions instrumentation, controls, and exhaust-system integration.

The SME will report to the Director of Power Generation and work across Product Development, Applications Engineering, Manufacturing, Commissioning, Service, suppliers, and customers to ensure emissions-abatement systems are technically sound, safe, reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and capable of meeting project emissions requirements.

Principle Responsibilities and Duties

  • System Integration: Lead the scoping and integration of Emission Abatement equipment, primarily SCR systems, including catalyst modules, urea/ammonia dosing systems, and mixing ducts with natural gas reciprocating engines.
  • Collaborate with Applications and Product Development team to ensure products meet project requirements and quantify technical risks for Management Teams.
  • Performance Review: Review technology efficiencies, ammonia slip, and backpressure constraints to balance emissions performance with engine fuel efficiency. Review vendor proposals, calculations, P&IDs, general arrangements, equipment specifications, control narratives, and instrumentation requirements. Work with engine OEM data and project-specific operating profiles to identify technical risks before equipment release.
  • Design Criteria: Establish design criteria for pressure drop, catalyst face velocity, mixing, exhaust temperature, instrumentation locations, service access, and catalyst replacement. Evaluate emissions-system operation across the engine's full operating envelope, including startup, shutdown, load changes and turndown.
  • Fluid Dynamics & Thermal Analysis: Review Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) and thermal modeling, performed by sub vendors, to ensure uniform reductant mixing and temperature distribution.
  • Simpler Systems: Advise and review proposed designs from sub vendors for 3-way catalyst, oxidation catalyst, and stack / ducting design for pressure drop.
  • In House Testing: Develop best practices, review and develop testing procedures for technicians, and assist in procurement of testing instruments to validate shop unit testing. Liaison with 3rd party testing companies as needed. Develop requirements for instrument calibration, sampling location, sample conditioning, test stabilization, data recording, and test reporting.
  • Root Cause Analysis: Liaison with sub vendors to diagnose complex field failures, including catalyst poisoning (e.g., from sulfur or lube oil), masking, thermal degradation, and dosing system malfunctions. Interpret collected data to distinguish between engine-related, dosing-related, catalyst-related, controls-related, instrumentation-related, and exhaust-distribution problems.
  • Commissioning Support: Provide high-level technical guidance during the commissioning and testing of new emissions control installations, generally within the Company’s Shop. Provide Remote field support for Enerflex service technicians. Help establish company best practices and procedures for initial startup and commissioning of emissions-control systems. Contribute to the development of commissioning checklists, acceptance criteria, troubleshooting guides, and technician procedures. Assist in troubleshooting when installed system performance does not meet design or permit requirements. Capture field lessons learned and translate them into improved designs, specifications, and commissioning practices.
  • Regulatory Navigation: Maintain expert-level knowledge of global emissions standards (e.g., EPA Tier 4, IMO Tier III, Stage V) to guide product development and client compliance.
  • Technology Roadmap: Support Product Development by evaluating emerging catalyst materials, control algorithms, and alternative reductants to keep the company's product portfolio competitive.Scoping Roadmap: Enhance Application Departments capabilities to obtain quality initial designs for best fit abatement solutions.

Qualifications

  • Degree: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical, Chemical, or Environmental Engineering.
  • Experience: 5+ years of direct experience in the design, testing, and operation of SCR systems.
  • Domain Focus: Proven expertise specifically with reciprocating engines, understanding their unique exhaust flow pulsations, temperature profiles, and transient behaviors.
  • Understanding of catalyst chemistry (e.g., Vanadium-Tungsten, Zeolite) and chemical reactions involved in NOx reduction.
  • Understanding of reductant fluid dynamics (urea decomposition, pyrolysis risk management, and spray crystallization prevention).
  • Familiarity with engine control units (ECUs), closed-loop emissions control logic, and NOx/NH3 sensor integration.
  • Experience with related emissions components like Diesel Particulate Filters (DPF) and Oxidation Catalysts (Ox-Cat).
  • Strong communication skills to translate complex chemical and mechanical concepts for clients, sales teams, and field technicians.

Physical Requirements

Fast-paced general office environment. Many tasks have high degrees of time sensitivity. Domestic and international travel is possible on occasion.

About Us:

Transforming Energy for a Sustainable Future. Enerflex is a premier integrated global provider of energy infrastructure solutions, covering gas processing, compression, power generation, refrigeration, cryogenic, energy transition, and water solutions. We proudly employ more than 5,000 highly skilled employees across over 25 countries worldwide.

Enerflex places its core Values of Integrity, Commitment, Creativity, and Success into action across all aspects of the business. Our innovation, strong commitment to safety, and superior service to our customers positions us as the optimal partner to meet the needs of the dynamic energy industry.

title: Data Administrator
description:
Position Summary

The Data Administrator is an individual contributor responsible for accurately entering, evaluating, maintaining, and adjusting master data — including pricing, product, and customer/vendor/address records — across P21 (ERP), CRM, and related systems of record. This role uses systemic tools, research, and subject-matter-expert feedback to validate data as error-free and current, and is critical to guaranteeing clean data that supports pricing integrity, sales credit, and reporting across the business.

Reporting to the Manager, Commercial Systems, this role may focus on a specific data domain (e.g., pricing, product, or address/customer data) or flex across domains based on business need, and partners closely with Strategic Pricing, Commercial Analytics & Reporting, and Subject Matter Experts across the business.


Core Areas of Focus

Pricing Data Administration

• Maintain price records, segment codes, and other pricing data in the ERP system in support of the pricing team’s objectives and sales initiatives

• Translate commercial agreements (customer and vendor) into digital pricing records; execute and test mass price record updates and modifications

• Accurately enter pricing changes as market conditions require, including customized pricing for sales teams

• Use system knowledge to help diagnose the root cause of transactional pricing data errors

Product & Address/Customer Data Administration

• Accurately assign products to generic product groups; recommend adding product groups as necessary

• Evaluate, maintain, and adjust address, customer, vendor, and ship-to data; recommend merging records that represent the same entity

• Use Excel and internet research to fill data gaps, filter, and assign data as necessary

• Work with Subject Matter Experts to resolve questions on product, address, or customer data fields

Data Quality & System Support

• Use system tools and reports to ensure the ongoing accuracy of master data

• Transcribe or code source data into the format required for data entry

• Participate in company quality initiatives and comply with Standard Operating Procedures

• Support cross-functional data requests and dataflow updates in partnership with Commercial Systems and Commercial Analytics & Reporting

Additional Support

• Perform other data assignment tasks, duties, and special projects as assigned


Key Internal Partnerships

• Manager, Commercial Systems — Direct supervision, data priorities, and escalation

• Strategic Pricing — Pricing changes, segment codes, and mass price updates

• Commercial Analytics & Reporting — Data definitions, hierarchy accuracy, and reporting quality

• Subject Matter Experts (Sales, Product, Purchasing) — Validation and resolution of data questions

• IT — System tools, error tables, and technical support

title: Manager, Ethics and Integrity Program
description:
What if you could redefine what’s possible?

With us, you can. You want Purpose. Growth. Opportunity. People who get it.
We are the home of ambitious, passionate, and innovative world shapers.
With an unmatched breadth and depth of engineering, advisory and science-based expertise, our global minds unite to power local solutions.
We are pathfinders and impact makers.
We are Visioneers.
We are WSP.

The Opportunity

Help shape and strengthen a global ethics and integrity program that supports more than 80,000 employees worldwide. Working under the leadership of the WSP Chief Ethics and Integrity Officer and closely with executive Ethics leadership, you will coordinate the worldwide implementation of initiatives and controls across all program pillars.
Your work will support ethical culture, reputation risk management, and compliance across areas including anti-corruption, fair competition, anti-money laundering, human rights, and sanctions regimes. This Canada-wide opportunity offers the chance to lead complex global initiatives, collaborate across functions and regions, and continuously improve how the Ethics and Integrity program delivers impact.

Your Impact

  • Manage the full lifecycle of the Global ethics policy portfolio, including development, engagement with regional Ethics teams and functional and business subject matter experts, updates and improvements, translations, publication, and oversight of the human, system, or AI resources executing lifecycle tasks. You will manage this work on behalf of the Chief Ethics and Integrity Officer, who remains the policy owner.
  • Manage the full lifecycle of Global ethics awareness and communications programs, including Canopy, WSP’s intranet, internet content, and other communications. You will coordinate development, stakeholder engagement, updates and improvements, translations into more than 10 languages, distribution, and the resources involved in delivering the work.
  • Lead the full lifecycle of the Global ethics training program, including the development and evolution of the annual Code of Conduct Refresher e-learning and new-hire Code of Conduct Onboarding e-learning. You will engage regional Ethics teams and functional and business subject matter experts, coordinate updates and improvements, manage translations into more than 10 languages, oversee assignment through multiple LMS systems, track completion, and manage the resources supporting the lifecycle. You will also develop targeted training for specific audiences, including anti-corruption, fraud detection, or sanctions content, and coordinate its development, delivery, assignment, and tracking.
  • Manage the Global ethics program’s periodic recertification lifecycle, covering project planning, engagement with the external assessor, consultation with regional Ethics teams and functional and business subject matter experts, data collection and submission, draft-report review and commentary, findings analysis, and recommendations for updating existing global initiatives or considering new ones.
  • Lead internal engagement and collaboration initiatives for the Ethics team, including activities that sustain team culture across time zones and locations, colleague interview videos, job-description development, training plans, and other measures that facilitate collaboration and growth. You will also support the effective use of the team’s shared Teams communications platform and file repository.
  • Support executive and Board reporting, enabling the efficient preparation of monthly and quarterly program reports. You will monitor and analyze key program indicators aligned with the three-year strategic action plan, gather information from regional teams through scheduled data-collection tools and meetings, and turn that information into effective, impactful presentations.
  • Coordinate essential program services and strategic initiatives, facilitating renewals for required professional services such as due diligence services and ensuring the effective and accurate use of licences and platforms. You will also lead designated global strategic and growth initiatives, including multi-year and cross-functional alignment initiatives, the transition of regional program elements into the global program, and pilot phases involving staged rollouts across regions or groups.
  • Drive continuous improvement and support program priorities, identifying and executing tactical projects that strengthen program operations and performance while adjusting their direction as needed throughout the year. You will support designated areas such as third-party diligence, risk assessment, and other controls, and assist the Chief Ethics and Integrity Officer in advancing the program’s priorities, strategic framework, and day-to-day mandate as assigned.

The Skills That Set You Apart

  • Approximately seven or more years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience deploying global initiatives within an international organization.
  • Exceptional organizational, written, and oral communication skills.
  • Experience in project management or program coordination.
  • Experience working with business integrity programs or in legal compliance environments is an asset.
  • Knowledge of additional languages is an asset.

Why Choose WSP?

We exist to shape communities to advance humanity. The brightest engineers, advisors and scientists from across the globe call WSP home.

  • A global community of brilliant minds – your next idea, mentor, or opportunity is always within reach.

title: Meewerkstage HR-ondersteuning
description:
Dit ga je doen

Tijdens deze stage maak je kennis met verschillende werkzaamheden binnen HR. Je werkt mee met twee teams: Werving & Selectie (W&S) en Personeelsservice en Informatie (PSI). Ook ondersteun je het stagebureau van RVO.

Je krijgt verschillende praktische en administratieve taken. Zo leer je stap voor stap wat er achter de schermen gebeurt bij het aannemen van nieuwe medewerkers en stagiairs en bij het regelen van personeelszaken.

Bij Werving & Selectie help je bijvoorbeeld met:

  • het verwerken van vacatures en stagevacatures;
  • het plannen van sollicitatiegesprekken;
  • het verwerken van gegevens van kandidaten en stagiairs;
  • administratieve werkzaamheden rondom de plaatsing van stagiairs.

Bij Personeelsservice en Informatie help je onder andere met:

  • het opstellen en verwerken van stageovereenkomsten;
  • het controleren of documenten op tijd zijn ondertekend;
  • het verwerken en archiveren van documenten;
  • het beantwoorden van vragen van stagiairs;
  • contact met stagiairs en onderwijsinstellingen.

Je hoeft natuurlijk niet alles meteen te kunnen. Collega’s leggen je de werkzaamheden uit en begeleiden je tijdens je stage. Naarmate je meer ervaring krijgt, kun je steeds meer taken zelfstandig uitvoeren.

Om de week sluit je aan bij het overleg van het stagebureau. Daar bespreken we wat er speelt, welke werkzaamheden nog gedaan moeten worden en wie waarmee aan de slag gaat.

We kijken ook naar jouw opleiding, leerdoelen en interesses. Zo krijg je de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, praktijkervaring op te doen en te ontdekken welke werkzaamheden binnen HR goed bij jou passen.

Voor deze stage hebben we ruimte om 3 dagen mee te werken. Zo heb je nog een dag te besteden aan eventueel een schoolopdracht.

Dit bieden we nog meer

Stagevergoeding

Als jouw stage bij het Rijk langer duurt dan één maand. Dan heb je recht op een stagevergoeding. De stagevergoeding is gebaseerd op een vijfdaagse werkweek, waarbij wordt uitgegaan van 40 uur stage (5 dagen van 8 uur) per week. Bij een stage van minder dan 40 uur per week, wordt dit berekend naar evenredigheid van het aantal afgesproken uren.

Reiskostenvergoeding

Kun je als stagiair geen gebruikmaken van een OV-studentenkaart voor het reizen tussen je woning en de stageplek? Dan kun je een reiskostenvergoeding krijgen. Hiervoor gelden de woon-werkverkeer regels voor rijksambtenaren. Maak je als stagiair een dienstreis? Dan gelden de regels voor binnenlandse dienstreizen en buitenlandse dienstreizen voor rijksambtenaren. Reis je met de trein voor een dienstreis? Dan reis je in tweede klasse.

Vakantie-uren

Alleen bij stages van een maand of langer vindt toekenning van vakantie plaats. Je hebt tijdens je stage aanspraak op 160 vakantie-uren op jaarbasis bij een stage van 40 uur per week. Is de stage voor minder dan 40 uur per week overeengekomen? Dan wordt de aanspraak op vakantie-uren naar evenredigheid vastgesteld.

Dit vragen wij

Je wilt graag meer leren over HR en de administratieve werkzaamheden die daarbij komen kijken. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe verschillende HR-onderdelen samenwerken en vindt het leuk om nieuwe werkzaamheden te ontdekken. Je werkt nauwkeurig, gaat zorgvuldig om met gegevens en documenten en vindt het belangrijk dat de administratie op orde is. Ook kun je je werk goed organiseren en houd je overzicht over de taken die je uitvoert. Zodat jij en jouw collega’s elkaars werk eenvoudig over kunnen nemen.

Samenwerken vind je belangrijk. Je werkt samen met collega’s van verschillende teams en staat open voor uitleg en feedback. Je stelt vragen als je iets wilt leren of ergens niet uitkomt en vindt het leuk om collega’s te ondersteunen. Je neemt initiatief, denkt mee over hoe werkzaamheden beter of makkelijker kunnen en krijgt steeds meer vertrouwen om taken zelfstandig op te pakken.

Verder heb je

  • Een inschrijving bij een Nederlandse mbo-opleiding in de richting van HRM of administratie.

Hier kom je te werken

Over Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO)

Vandaag werken aan de wereld van morgen

De wereld verandert elke dag en wij veranderen mee. Met meer dan 6000 RVO’ers werken we iedere dag aan morgen. We ondersteunen, adviseren en stimuleren ondernemend Nederland. We helpen met innoveren en verduurzamen. Nationaal en internationaal, want ons werk stopt niet bij de grens. Samen werken we aan:

  • De verduurzaming van onze energievoorzieningen.
  • Het tegengaan van klimaatverandering.
  • Een omslag naar een duurzaam landbouw- en voedselsysteem.
  • Een sterke digitale economie.

Het zijn grote uitdagingen, maar wij geloven dat het mogelijk is. Daarom verbinden we ondernemers, overheden en organisaties om te bouwen aan het Nederland van morgen.

We doen het samen.

Wat doen we?

Wij maken overheidsbeleid bereikbaar en uitvoerbaar. Van voorlichting, advies en financiering tot het bieden van een luisterend oor voor ondernemers en organisaties. En dat is nog maar een klein onderdeel van wat we doen. Ondernemend Nederland is ontzettend veelzijdig en daarom zijn wij dat ook.

Divers maakt beter

Met enorme uitdagingen op komst, is de juiste mensen aan boord hebben belangrijk. Het maakt bij ons niet uit wie je bent. Wij kijken naar wat je kunt en waar jouw ambities liggen. Om de wereld duurzamer te maken hebben we ideeën nodig uit alle hoeken van de samenleving. Daarom hebben we voor iedereen plaats bij RVO, zolang je maar nieuwsgierig en ondernemend bent. We geven je vertrouwen, vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Want zo boek jij de mooiste resultaten. Voor jezelf, voor ondernemers en voor morgen.

Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO)

Bijzonderheden

Stageovereenkomst

  • Voor deze stage geldt uitsluitend de stageovereenkomst van de Rijksoverheid. Indien de opleiding een eigen stageovereenkomst hanteert, dient de stagiair dit vooraf zelf af te stemmen met de opleiding of de stagebegeleider. De stage kan alleen starten nadat de Rijksoverheid-stageovereenkomst door alle partijen is ondertekend.

Hybride werken

  • Bij RVO werken we hybride. Voor deze functie wordt van je verwacht dat je twee keer per week op de RVO-vestiging in Den Haag aanwezig bent. Voor de overige dagen kun je je werk vanaf elke locatie doen (vanuit huis, op één van de RVO-kantoren of elders).

Sollicitatieproces

  • Sollicitaties worden pas behandeld na sluiting van de vacature.

Selectieproces

  • Alle binnengekomen cv’s worden beoordeeld aan de hand van de eisen uit de vacature. Zorg dus dat uit jouw cv duidelijk wordt of je over de benodigde eisen beschikt.

Overig

  • Voor werken bij RVO is een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) vereist.
  • Om de vacaturetekst later nog terug te kunnen lezen, raden we aan deze vooraf te downloaden.
  • De start- en einddatum van je stage is in goed overleg af te spreken.
  • Alle informatie over je stage bij de Rijksoverheid is te vinden op: . Zo krijg je naast een mooie stagevergoeding ook vakantie-uren en goede begeleiding.

Afdelingsomschrijving

Het team Werving & Selectie houdt zich bezig met het vinden van nieuwe medewerkers voor RVO. We helpen bij het plaatsen van vacatures en regelen verder alles rondom het organiseren van sollicitatiegesprekken. Verder zijn we vraagbaak voor sollicitanten en vacaturehouders.

Het team PSI (Personeel Service en Informatie) zorgt ervoor dat de gegevens en documenten van nieuwe medewerkers goed worden verwerkt. Ook kijken we regelmatig hoe we onze werkprocessen makkelijker en slimmer kunnen maken.

Tijdens je stage werk je met collega’s van beide teams samen. Hierdoor leer je verschillende kanten van HR kennen. Je krijgt bijvoorbeeld te maken met werving, contact met studenten en collega’s en administratieve werkzaamheden. Ook krijg je de ruimte om mee te denken over hoe we onze dienstverlening kunnen verbeteren.

Je komt terecht in een gezellig en professioneel team. We helpen elkaar, delen onze kennis en staan open voor vragen en nieuwe ideeën. Onze collega’s werken op verschillende RVO-locaties en vanuit huis. Daarom werken we zowel online als op kantoor met elkaar samen.

We vinden het belangrijk dat jij je snel welkom voelt. Je krijgt goede begeleiding en voldoende ruimte om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat studenten een goede start bij RVO krijgen en dat alles rondom hun stage goed geregeld is.

title: Audio Architecture Engineering Program Manager
description:
Imagine what you could do here! At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. What starts as a one-page proposal or an early prototype gets challenged, refined, and proven out by teams across hardware, software, and silicon. Engineering Program Managers make that happen. They bring teams together, drive decisions, and keep ideas moving from concept to reality.

We are looking for an experienced, technically driven Audio Architecture Engineering Program Manager within Hardware Program Management to lead cross-functional coordination and alignment for future Audio IP, and to track Pre-Silicon and Post-Silicon validation across SoCs and products.

In this role, you will be the operational partner to Platform Architects and lead cross-functional collaboration across Platform Architecture (PA), Audio Software (Audio SW), System Architecture, Acoustics, and Silicon Engineering. You will drive recurring architecture forums, streamline feature intake, track specification milestones from requirements to freeze, and follow critical Audio IP updates through pre-silicon validation and post-silicon bring-up. The role provides broad exposure across multiple product lines and long-range roadmaps, with direct visibility to engineering leadership.

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field, and 10+ years of relevant industry experience.
  • 3+ years of Engineering Program Management, Technical Program Management, or engineering leadership experience.
  • Experience coordinating programs that span multiple engineering teams across hardware, silicon, or software disciplines.
  • Experience tracking technical deliverables, specification milestones, or validation schedules across SoC or IP development lifecycles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with audio subsystems, DSPs, digital serial interfaces (SoundWire, I2S, PDM), or power-constrained wearable/hearable architectures.
  • Experience tracking Pre-Silicon verification (emulation, FPGA, modeling) and Post-Silicon bring-up for complex IPs or SoCs.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to build strong relationships, influence without authority, and drive alignment across senior architects and engineering leads.
  • Ability to filter and distill complex technical issues and dependencies into clear executive summaries.

  • ERP Functional Support

  • Reporting & Business Intelligence

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
