title: Director Engineering - UOP
description:
As a Director Engineering – UOP at Honeywell Technologies, you will provide technical leadership for the execution of complex mega projects. You will serve as a key technical partner to the Project Manager and Program Director, coordinating multidisciplinary engineering teams and ensuring project deliverables meet customer and UOP requirements while achieving schedule and cost commitments.

In this role, you will lead through a matrixed organization across engineering disciplines including structural, mechanical, piping, instrumentation, electrical, rotating equipment, and other technical functions. You will drive alignment across these disciplines throughout project execution, including the coordination and timely review of technical documentation and vendor deliverables. Your strong engineering background, technical leadership, and ability to coordinate complex work across multiple stakeholders will be critical to ensuring UOP mega projects are delivered in accordance with technical requirements, schedules, and budgets.

You will report directly to the Sr Program Director and work out of our Rosemont, IL or Houston, TX location on a hybrid work schedule.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical leadership for the engineering execution of large, complex UOP mega projects.
  • Serve as the technical partner to the Project Manager and Program Director, leading the technical aspects of project delivery while working closely with project leadership.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams across structural, mechanical, piping, instrumentation, electrical, rotating equipment, and other technical disciplines.
  • Ensure engineering deliverables comply with customer specifications, UOP standards, processes, and technical requirements.
  • Drive engineering execution to meet project schedule and cost commitments.
  • Coordinate the review and resolution of vendor drawings, documentation, and other technical deliverables in a timely manner.
  • Work across a matrixed organization to align technical teams, maintain accountability, and resolve issues affecting project execution.
  • Support the technical and commercial review of engineering and vendor documentation.
  • Manage engineering activities and large budgets associated with large-scale projects.
  • Partner directly with customers and internal stakeholders on technical matters throughout project execution.
  • Promote disciplined execution of UOP engineering processes, procedures, standards, and specifications.

You Must Have

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited engineering institution.
  • 8+ years of experience in engineering, engineering program management, project engineering, or related technical project execution.
  • Experience delivering complex, multidisciplinary engineering projects against schedule and budget commitments.
  • Strong engineering background with experience coordinating multiple technical disciplines.
  • Experience working with engineering specifications, technical requirements, vendor documentation, and engineering deliverables.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and influence teams in a matrixed environment without direct reporting authority.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills with the ability to engage technical, project, and customer organizations.

We Value

  • Experience within Honeywell UOP or previous experience working with UOP engineering standards, processes, specifications, and procedures.
  • Senior or Principal-level engineering experience supporting large, technically complex projects.
  • Experience working within an engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) environment or with a Tier 1 engineering organization.
  • Experience coordinating structural, mechanical, piping, instrumentation, electrical, and rotating-equipment engineering disciplines.
  • Strong technical judgment with the ability to identify, escalate, and resolve engineering issues that could affect project schedule, cost, quality, or compliance.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence across organizational boundaries and drive accountability through matrixed teams.
  • Strong customer-facing communication and technical leadership skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making abilities.
  • Collaborative mindset with a strong focus on execution, quality, and continuous improvement.

description:

We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

What you'll build

In this role, you contribute to the design, development, and operation of AI-native enterprise applications within fast-moving, customer-embedded delivery teams.

You bring solid engineering fundamentals and a growing command of AI and machine learning techniques, applying them to solve real-world business problems under the guidance of Forward Deployed Architects and Managers.

This is a role for someone who is hungry to learn, eager to contribute, and excited by the challenge of building production-grade solutions that make a tangible difference for enterprise customers.

In this role, you will:

  • Contribute to the development of production-grade, cloud-native applications integrating AI capabilities such as large language models, RAG pipelines, and agent-based components.
  • Work within customer projects and cross-functional delivery teams, learning to understand business processes, technical landscapes, and customer needs.
  • Implement features, components, and integrations under the guidance of architects, maintaining code quality and adherence to engineering standards.
  • Support prototyping, testing, and iteration of AI solutions in customer environments, adapting to feedback and evolving requirements.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and design sessions, actively developing your engineering skills and knowledge.
  • Assist with monitoring, troubleshooting, and improving deployed solutions to ensure reliability and operational stability.
  • Contribute to documentation, reusable components, and engineering best practices to support team productivity and knowledge sharing.
  • Demonstrate a proactive learning mindset — staying current with AI/ML developments and applying new techniques and tools to improve solution quality.

What you bring:

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in software and application engineering for cloud-native, enterprise, and SaaS environments, with strong knowledge of architectural principles such as scalability, security, and reliability.
  • Solid foundational skills in software engineering, with proficiency in Python and hands-on experience in at least one cloud-native development environment.
  • Growing understanding of AI and ML concepts, including familiarity with large language models, machine learning frameworks (e.g. TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn), and API-based AI services.
  • Exposure to data pipelines, MLOps concepts, or AI/ML model integration in application contexts.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a team, follow engineering standards, and take ownership of assigned tasks with a strong sense of accountability.
  • Curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset — you actively seek feedback, learn from experience, and are motivated to grow quickly in a high-pace environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP) and familiarity with tools such as Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams and customer-facing settings.
  • An interest in or early exposure to SAP AI technologies such as SAP AI Core or SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) is a plus.

About the position

Join a strong team of innovative, dedicated professionals improving the way the City moves. Contribute your people leadership, operational and project management expertise to continuous improvement of fuel and energy support operations and driving down the City fleet’s green house gas emissions (GHG) through targeted strategic projects.

The City of Toronto has the largest municipal fleets in Canada and one of the most complex fleets in North America. The City of Toronto relies on the Fleet Services Division to provide responsive, efficient fleet management services to City divisions, agencies and corporations that maximize safety and environmental sustainability. Fleet Services is also responsible for fuel and energy management, vehicle operator training, vehicle maintenance, asset management, and green fleet initiatives, including implementation of the Sustainable City Fleets Plan and other initiatives focused on lowering GHG.

While specialized knowledge of fuel and energy management is an asset, the focus of this role is on strong people leadership, operational management, and the ability to successfully lead and implement change initiatives. Fleet Services is committed to developing its leadership talent, making this an ideal opportunity for individuals looking to broaden their experience and grow into future senior leadership roles within the City.


What you'll do

As a manager within the Transformation Team, you will:

  • Manage the City’s fuel operations, ensuring fuel sites are functional and safe as well as implementing measures that ensure fuel use is compliant with City policies

  • Manage the City’s electric vehicle charging infrastructure, working with internal staff and vendors to ensure high uptime for the system and provide guidance and education to clients to increase efficient use of the system

  • Manage licensing processes for City fleet vehicles including leveraging technology to plan workflows and track licensing costs

  • Manage the episodic and seasonal rental vehicle program including working with clients to analyze and manage utilization, with a focus on working across the division and with clients to facilitate financial efficiencies wherever possible

  • Implement transformational projects including initiatives focused on driving down GHG emitted by City fleet vehicles and equipment

  • Work collaboratively with the contract management team and finance team to monitor spend rate on key contracts and ensure contract terms and conditions are followed by all parties, escalating concerns where necessary

  • Provide excellent customer service to clients through setting up processes, standard operating procedures, coaching front-facing staff and acting on feedback from clients and internal partners

  • Prepare the annual budget for relevant programs in partnership with the finance team and client divisions

  • Manage capital and state of good repair upgrades to fuel infrastructure

  • Contribute to and carry out business continuity plans when necessary

  • Develop and implement Fleet policies and procedures, service level agreements with vendors and clients, and key performance indicators for management and operational oversight and control

  • Manage, motivate and train the team’s union and non-union staff, ensuring effective teamwork, high standards of work quality, continuous learning and innovation

  • Manage the human resources requirements of union and non-union staff, including workforce planning, hiring, discipline and performance management within the guidelines set out in Human Resources policies and procedures and applicable collective agreements

  • Oversee the development, implementation and maintenance of internal processes and procedures and ensure compliance with corporate and divisional financial and accounting policies and guidelines

  • Develop and implement cost and operational efficiencies by undertaking cost studies to determine effective service delivery mechanisms, combined with reviewing, developing and implementing required policies, procedures and operational changes

  • Act as a resource for the senior management team, proactively providing insights and recommendations to drive continuous improvement and address issues as they arise

  • Develop strong working relationships with client divisions, partners and other relevant areas within the City

  • Ensure Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) standards are met, safe work practices employed and that facilities and equipment are in good repair

What you'll need to succeed in this role

Key qualifications:

  1. Post-secondary education combined with progressively more responsible management experience, or an equivalent combination of education and/or relevant experience

  1. People leadership experience within an operational setting with the proven ability to develop and build collaborative and successful teams

  1. Experience implementing systems-level transformational change projects

  1. Demonstrated experience leading and implementing projects, operational improvements, and change initiatives, including knowledge of project management principles and practices

  1. Strong practical knowledge of how to apply an equity, diversity and inclusion lens to the role of a people leader and to wider Fleet Services initiatives

  1. Understanding of environmental sustainability principles and an interest in supporting initiatives focused on reducing greenhouse gas emissions. Experience in sustainability or GHG reduction initiatives is considered an asset.

  1. Exceptional problem-solving abilities with the proven ability to generate creative solutions to complex operational problems

  1. Experience in contract management for high value contracts, as well as demonstrated experience negotiating with and managing vendors

  1. Financial experience in contract management and forecasting, combined with solid business acumen, budget and operational planning experience

  1. Proven interpersonal and functional leadership abilities with an emphasis on high operational standards and the ability to build, develop and deliver a strong and consistent level of customer service

  1. Advanced oral and written communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to engage effectively with diverse individuals, teams, and staff at all levels of the organization

  1. Experience writing succinct senior level briefing notes, briefing presentations and other materials conveying strategic information and recommendations

  1. Advanced strategic thinking skills coupled with strong research and analytical skills

  1. Political acuity with an exceptional ability to handle sensitive and confidential situations with diplomacy

  1. While all qualified applicants will be considered, lived experience as an Indigenous person, a Black person or a member of an equity-deserving group is a strong asset. Applicants are welcome to self-identify in their cover letter if they feel comfortable to do so

title: Assembly Coordinator
description:

The hourly rate for this position is $22.59 per hour.

What you’ll do:

The Assembly Coordinator is responsible for supporting the daily operation of assembly production lines while providing leadership, direction, and development to production associates. This role ensures safe, efficient, and productive operations through effective workforce coordination, assembly planning, schedule execution, quality compliance, and continuous improvement activities. The Coordinator serves as a liaison between production, planning, engineering, quality, materials, and other functional groups to ensure customer and business requirements are achieved.

The successful candidate will lead by example, promote Eaton values and safety culture, drive operational excellence, and support the development of team members while ensuring production goals, quality standards, and delivery commitments are met.

• Lead by example by demonstrating company values, policies, leadership principles, safety requirements, and 5S practices.

• Support employee engagement and accountability through effective communication and leadership.
• Ensure team members are properly trained, qualified, and following standardized work instructions.
• Assist with onboarding and development of new employees.

Production Operations
• Monitor and coordinate daily assembly activities to ensure production schedules and customer requirements are achieved.
• Coordinate staffing needs, work assignments, and resource allocation to support production requirements.
• Escalate issues related to material shortages, equipment downtime, quality concerns, or staffing constraints.
• Ensure products, changeovers, and workflow activities are executed safely and efficiently.

Assembly Planning & Scheduling
• Participate in assembly planning activities to support production requirements and customer demand.
• Attend planning and production meetings to review schedules, priorities, capacity constraints, and material availability.
• Collaborate with Planning, Materials, Engineering, and Operations teams to ensure production plans are achievable.
• Monitor production schedules and proactively communicate risks that may impact delivery commitments.
• Support workload balancing and labor planning to maximize efficiency and on-time performance.

Continuous Improvement

• Actively participate in Continuous Improvement initiatives, Kaizen events, value stream activities, and operational excellence projects.
• Identify opportunities to improve safety, quality, productivity, delivery performance, and inventory management.
• Collect, analyze, and communicate operational data to support improvement efforts.
• Support implementation and sustainability of process improvements and standard work.
• Promote a culture of problem solving and continuous improvement throughout the assembly area.

Communication & Collaboration
• Work closely with Production Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers, Buyers/Planners, Quality, and other functional teams to resolve operational challenges.
• Communicate production status, priorities, and issues to leadership and supporting departments.
• Support cross-functional initiatives that improve operational performance and customer satisfaction.

Administrative Responsibilities

• Utilize ERP systems (SAP) and other business systems to support production activities.
• Maintain accurate production records and performance metrics.
• Support departmental reporting and data collection requirements.
• Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Qualifications:

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5 years experience working in a manufacturing environment
  • Associate’s Degree from an accredited institution

SKILLS

  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working in a team-oriented environment with cross-functional groups.
  • Working knowledge of SAP and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Ability to analyze data and make sound operational decisions.
  • Understanding of lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and standard work concepts preferred.
  • Ability to lead in a fast-paced manufacturing environment while maintaining a strong focus on safety, quality, and customer satisfaction.

title: On-Site Property Administrator
description:
The Presidio is a 72-unit Tax Credit, HUD Based, Bond/City Senior Community located in San Clemente, CA. This is a live on-site role; 1 bedroom unit. The Presidio HUD/Tax Credit position may also include overseeing another 27-unit Tax Credit only property about 14 miles away located in Laguna Beach, CA.

The Property Administrator will assist in the operation and compliance of Project-Based Section 8 (HUD) and Tax Credit (TCAC) properties. This role ensures compliance with affordable housing programs by performing initial certifications, recertifications, and other administrative functions. title: Analytics Platforms Analyst
description:
For more than 90 years, Simplot Company has grown as a family-owned, privately held global food and agriculture company. Our diverse businesses span agriculture, food production, manufacturing, mining, plant and animal sciences, ranching and cattle production, logistics, and transportation, connecting many of the essential steps that bring food from the earth to communities around the world.

That diversity creates strength, stability, and opportunity. Across our global business, employees can build new skills, explore different career paths, and contribute to meaningful work in a culture where safety is foundational.

Whatever your role, your work at Simplot contributes to something bigger. Join us to grow your career, make an impact, and help shape the future of food and agriculture.

Summary

As the Analytics Platforms Analyst, you will strengthen how Simplot works with data to improve decisions and make work more efficient. You will enable business users to build and use reports, dashboards, and data models in Power BI and Microsoft Fabric that are secure, efficient, and built on trusted data.

You will partner with business users and IT data engineering to define use cases, recommend the right tools and architecture, and co-develop solutions. As a senior individual contributor, you will help set enterprise standards, monitor the health and cost of the environment, and build the training, templates, and guides that let users succeed on their own. You will also evaluate new Power BI and Fabric capabilities, including embedded Copilot features, and determine which are ready and valuable for Simplot.

This work is shared across a small team, and no one is expected to be an expert in every area. What matters most is curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to keep learning as the technology changes quickly.

Typical Education

Bachelor's Degree (B.A. or B.S.) from 4 year college or university

Key Responsibilities

Enable business users

  • Help users scope use cases and choose the right tool and architecture (Power BI, Fabric, Excel)
  • Coach users on building reports, semantic models, and dashboards that align with best practices
  • Connect users to trusted enterprise data models
  • Create training materials, how-to guides, and design templates
  • Support Power BI and Fabric questions and incidents, and improve how we provide that support

Manage the environment

  • Define and maintain Power BI and Fabric standards, including architecture patterns, user tiers, design practices, and ownership
  • Monitor capacity and usage, flag outdated or poorly performing content, and work with business and data engineering teams to resolve it

Shape what’s next

  • Explore new Power BI, Fabric, and Copilot capabilities, and pilot the ones that show promise
  • Use adoption data and user feedback to guide where we invest next

Required Experience

  • Expertise developing solutions in Power BI or similar tools (typically 5+ years)
  • Experience supporting, training, or coaching business users
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Structured and process-oriented, with the ability to adapt to evolving technologies and business needs

Preferred Qualifications

  • Power BI workspace and capacity management, and self-service governance practices
  • Microsoft Fabric
  • Databricks, Azure Data Lake, or other enterprise data platforms
  • Creating training content or leading workshops

Other Information

This is a full-time onsite position reporting to Simplot HQ in downtown Boise, ID.

Job Requisition ID: 27812

Travel Required:

Location(s): Simplot Headquarters - Boise

Country: United States

title: Medical Liaison -Sickle Cell Disease / Hemoglobinopathies   - Carolinas
description:
About the Department

The Clinical, Medical and Regulatory (CMR) department at Novo Nordisk is one of the most diverse and collaborative groups within the organization. From healthcare provider interactions and developing and implementing regulatory strategies with the FDA to providing medical education and collecting data to support efficacy and new product development, CMR is involved. The one thing that keeps us all marching to the same beat is our patient centered focus. At Novo Nordisk, you will help patients around the world. As their needs evolve, so does our challenge to find better and more innovative ways to improve their quality of life. We’re changing lives for a living. Are you ready to make a difference?

The Position

Builds relationships with HCPs and demonstrates the clinical outcomes of NNI Hemoglobinopathies portfolio. Educates and demonstrates the safety and efficacy of key products to HCPs. Provides medical information and coordinates educational workshops, round tables, medical forums, etc.. May explore and identify sites for clinical trials in all stages of development. Incumbents have a deep scientific and clinical education and experience. Within Field Medical Affairs, this position functions as a scientific liaison between NNI and key external customers to further scientific exchange. S/he provides advanced product and scientific and medical field support to Medical, Sales and Marketing, as well as Managed Care and Government by using academic/professional credentials and scientific expertise to communicate with health care providers, organized providers/accounts and other relevant healthcare organizations. Strategic determination of change of territory prioritization will be based on customer need and analytics which identify need for change. This may occur at any time throughout the annual performance cycle. Develops and maintains medical (territory and account) plans in coordination with his/her Field Director.

Relationships

Position reports to Field Director/Sr Field Director. Serves as organization spokesperson on advanced medical and technical projects with the ML teams, Clinicians, Marketing, Market Access & Government and Sales personnel. External relationships include key opinion leaders (KOL’s), academic institutions, physicians, nurse practitioners, diabetes educators, pharmacists, blood bank staff, organized providers/IDNs and MCOs as needed based on territory archetypes.

Essential Functions

  • Administrative Duties:
    • Completes administrative duties in an accurate manner and on a timely basis, in line with current SOPs and working practices
    • Complies with all guidelines, policies, legal, regulatory and compliance requirements
    • Ensures effective administrative management of regional business as well as operational budgets
    • Maintains thorough understanding of all relevant Novo Nordisk processes and procedures and proactively assists other FMA members to further their understanding with these as needed
    • Provides monthly reports on scientific support activities in region to Director including budget expenditures as directed
    • Records all activities within a customer response management system (e.g. VEEVA) and all expenses within Concur in accordance with FMA procedures
  • Advocacy & Professional Relationship Development:
    • Attends assigned medical and scientific meetings: a) ensures and maintains awareness of current issues and new data pertaining to NNI products; b) develops and maintains relationships with key health care providers and IHNs; c) develops appropriate use of NNI products and greater utilization of its services d) supports and assists representatives and managers in answering questions from health care providers and IHNs
    • Combines account management skills, business acumen and scientific expertise to enhance value and develop collaborative relationships
    • Establishes the medical account strategy/plan through the identification and cultivation of key relationships and brings forth appropriate collaboration opportunities
  • Field-Based Clinical Support:
    • Collaborates with Health Economics & Outcomes Research (HEOR) team to deliver scientific value proposition of NNI’s products and devices to key customers and formulary decision makers. Delivers HEOR presentations upon request
    • Collaborates with Marketing and Sales management to inform the development of scientific strategies to optimize NNI’s products and development activities in the medical community
    • Collaborates with trial/study investigation sites; ensuring effective coordination and facilitation of studies to ensure timely review, initiation and completion, as well as publication of study results. Provides clinical support in cooperation with other Novo Nordisk groups to ensure investigators demonstrate appropriate knowledge of studies, support patient recruitment and retention activities, answers responsive requests from investigators and provides feedback to sites to other groups
    • Coordinates and collaborates with regional FMA team members to ensure integrated comprehensive coverage of regional clinical and scientific needs
    • Coordinates with key internal stakeholders to provide customized and dedicated system-wide clinical education and support within respective IHNs and coordinate and manage professional relations of Novo Nordisk within these Networks from an overall “account management” level
    • Coordinates with respective HSM to provide scientific and clinical education to Chief Executives, Medical Directors and formulary stakeholders to secure proper access to NNI’s products and services in respective IHNs
    • Develops and presents product and scientific updates as requested, including Formulary presentations within IHNs, using approved material

Physical Requirements

  • 50-75% overnight travel required.
  • The territory for this position is: NC, SC.
  • Position is Field Based and the ideal candidate must live within the territory or in a bordering state located near a major airport.
  • Driver must maintain a valid driver’s license. Must be in good standing by not exceeding the Novo Nordisk points threshold assigned based on review of Motor Vehicle Records.

Qualifications

  • Doctoral degree required
  • At least two years’ experience in a health-related system, pharmaceutical company, or managed care environment required
  • Relevant clinical and/or therapeutic experience preferred
  • Displays business acumen/knowledge based on experiences such as participation in formulary process decisions
  • Extensive experience in diabetes strongly preferred
  • Strong communication skills

This position is part of a job family. Title and level within the job family are evaluated based on a number of factors, such as years of experience, scope of work, proficiency, and business need. Candidates will be assessed for the most appropriate title and level within the job family during the recruitment process. The base range of pay for each title in this job family are as follows:

• Medical Liaison - $170,000 to $215,000
• Senior Medical Liaison - $198,000 to $245,000

In addition, this position is eligible for a company bonus based on individual and company performance. Novo Nordisk offers long-term incentive compensation and or company vehicles depending on the position's level or other company factors.

Employees are also eligible to participate in Company employee benefit programs including medical, dental and vision coverage; life insurance; disability insurance; 401(k) savings plan; flexible spending accounts; employee assistance program; tuition reimbursement program; and voluntary benefits such as group legal, critical illness, identity theft protection, pet insurance and auto/home insurance. The Company also offers time off pursuant to its sick time policy, flex-able vacation policy and parental leave policy.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and defeating diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

Novo Nordisk is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by local, state or federal laws, rules or regulations.

If you are interested in applying to Novo Nordisk and need special assistance or an accommodation to apply, please call us at 1-855-411-5290. This contact is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

title: Senior Service Order Manager
description:
Eaton’s ES AMER ESS division is currently seeking a Senior Service Order Manager. This role is located out of Raleigh, NC.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $84000 - $123000 a year.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

The Senior Service Order Manager provides internal and external sales support. This position will manage orders for CPS Service Strategic/ Hyperscale customers nationwide to include order entry, backlog management, and leverage all available resources to meet/ exceed customer expectations while creating a positive customer experience.

What you’ll do:

• Provide general order management, including order entry, promised-date compliance, backlog management, coordination of material shipments, on-time delivery, order expediting, and order status and tracking.

• Collaborate with Sales, technicians, vendors, Eaton manufacturer representatives, Eaton business partners, Purchasing, Credit, and Supply Chain departments to drive order issue resolution and customer satisfaction. Provide solutions and alternatives to meet customer needs.

• Proactively communicate with customers in a timely manner regarding order verification, order status, pricing, and shipment status. Coordinate with Operations to verify lead times, schedule customer orders according to delivery needs, and communicate special-handling requests.

• Challenge cross-functional processes to support continuous business improvement.

• Proactively run and analyze reports to determine which orders must be completed to meet revenue targets and customer demand.

• Manage the order backlog to ensure forecast accuracy for the business unit.

• Assist with facilitating the Return Material Authorization, credit, and rebill processes.

• Coordinate with other teams to ensure work orders are complete and all required nonstandard details are present and accurate at the time of invoicing to support timely payment.

• Maintain service vendor relationships by efficiently assigning orders to vendors and processing vendor invoices.

• Participate in meetings with customers and project teams.

Qualifications:

Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited institution
  • Minimum of three (3) years experience in customer support, supply chain or related business experience
  • No relocation benefit is offered. Candidates must reside within 50 miles of the job location listed on the job description
  • Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H1B, H1-B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.

Preferred Experience

  • SAP, Power BI, Salesforce experience

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

title: Events & Graphic Design Intern
description:
The opportunity

We are seeking a Events & Graphic Design Intern to join the Marketing & Communication team in Rome. The team is young, cohesive and highly motivated, covering a wide range of activities across marketing, communication, events and brand development.

The intern will support the team in the development of visual and communication materials, digital content and internal and external communication activities, as well as in the organization of corporate and commercial events. This role offers the opportunity to work on different projects and collaborate with multiple stakeholders, developing both creative and organizational skills.

Day-to-day responsibilities

  • Supporting the development of visual and graphic materials for internal and external communication
  • Creating presentations, infographics, social media assets and other branded materials
  • Supporting the production and adaptation of content in line with Worldline brand guidelines
  • Supporting the creation and editing of digital content, including basic video editing
  • Supporting corporate and commercial events, including materials, logistics and on-site activities
  • Assisting in the coordination of communication activities and campaigns
  • Collaborating with internal teams and external agencies, suppliers and partners
  • Supporting the team in the development of marketing and communication projects

Who are we looking for

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:

Interest in Graphic Design, Marketing and Communication
Deep understanding of graphic design principles and visual communication
Knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (particularly Photoshop and/or Illustrator), Canva and PowerPoint
Video editing skills
Interest in digital content creation and AI tools for both graphic and video
Creativity, attention to detail and a strong visual sense
Good organizational and time-management skills
Communication and teamwork skills
Ability to manage multiple activities and priorities
Good knowledge of English (written and spoken)

Perks & Benefits

Shape the evolution

We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you’ll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career – wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.

The Echo/Vascular Technologist performs diagnostic ultrasound and vascular imaging procedures to evaluate the structure and function of the heart and vascular system. Essential Functions

Licenses and Certifications

title: Project Manager (7131) - Fleet & Infrastructure Integration
description:
Secure Your Future with SEPTA – A Leader in Transportation!

The Southeastern Pennsylvania Transportation Authority (SEPTA) is the sixth-largest transportation system in the U.S., connecting communities across a 2,200-square-mile service region. SEPTA is at the forefront of innovation in the transit industry, ensuring reliable and efficient services while driving economic growth in the Philadelphia region.

Only candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship, will be accepted at this time.

We are proud to be recognized as:

2023 FORBES Best in State Employer

Philadelphia Employer of Choice for 2024

We are seeking to hire candidates for our Project Manager (7131) - Fleet & Infrastructure Integration position.

Opening Date: 11/02/2026

Closing Date: Until Filled

Job Grade: SAM 42

Starting Salary: $121,966.00

Additional $5,000 salary increase for having a Pennsylvania PE License.

OVERALL DESCRIPTION

The Project Manager position requires an extensive background in Engineering/Architecture and construction, as well as knowledge of business practices.

Manages all aspects of 3rd party and in-house projects, as assigned by their respective Program Manager or Director, to ensure that project planning, design, implementation, and completion meet the requirements and needs of SEPTA and the requirements of all the agencies, governments, special interest groups and the general public to which SEPTA is responsible.

The Project Manager plans, develops, coordinates, and directs critical interface and readiness projects, acting as a crucial link between vehicle procurements (e.g., the M5 fleet, Silverliner VI fleet, and modernized bus fleets) and infrastructure modifications. This includes comprehensive coordination across the design, construction, testing, and commissioning phases for these projects, with a detailed focus on schedule, risk management, and cross-department integration.

The Project Manager will come in contact with many people at higher organizational levels, both within SEPTA and outside the Authority. His/Her contacts include Department Managers and their staff within SEPTA, as well as consultant/contractor firms' and Federal, State, City, and local government officials. He/She must possess the ability to communicate effectively in a professional manner.

SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Consults with senior management in developing on-going zero emission or railway improvement programs, by formulating conceptual project plans ensuring infrastructure readiness for new bus and rail fleets (e.g., Modernized Buses, M5, Silverliner VI) and advising on complex interface issues, schedule variances, and policy or administrative matters requiring escalation, and specifications so as to best allow for simultaneous multi-discipline improvements and conformance to applicable funding agency requirements.
  • Prepares budgets, schedules, program, and force account plans for proposed projects.
  • Prepares Requests for Proposals, manage consultant contracts, and coordinate design concepts and reviews with Operations Departments.
  • Provides liaison with appropriate Federal, State, City and local government agencies and SEPTA to coordinate design requirements with consultant design.
  • May represent the Authority with Special Interest Groups or local committees, and present designs at public meetings.
  • Has responsibility for maintaining, forecasting, and maintaining budgets and manpower requirements.
  • Directs the project management team during the design construction and/or procurement stages of a project. This includes project management, construction management, and coordination with government agencies and SEPTA Operations Departments.
  • Monitors progress, performance of consultants and contractors.
  • Consults with supervision concerning unusual problems and developments on administrative and policy matters.
  • Supervises, coordinates, and reviews the work of a team of engineers/architects and construction inspectors. Estimates manpower needs and schedules and assigns work to meet schedules.
  • The Project Manager applies intensive and diversified knowledge of principals and practices in broad areas of engineering and construction assignments. He/She must make decisions independently in resolving engineering problems and construction issues. He/She may act as an individual researcher on specific issues.
  • Responsible for the development and review of project management training and seminars within his/her discipline.
  • Complies with all Authority and departmental safety and security policies and procedures as well as all applicable job safety responsibilities. Reports any safety concerns, compromises or hazards affecting operations, the public, self and/or other employees. Responsible for personal safety and is encouraged to promote the safety of others.
  • Performs other duties as assigned/required.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Architecture, and eight (8) years of progressively engineering/architectural experience, or an equivalent combination of engineering and project management, or related experience in construction required.
  • Or a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Architecture with EIT or either MS in Engineering or MBA with six (6) years responsible experience preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills required.
  • Excellent computer skills required.

title: Production Assistant
description:
GKN Aerospace is ‘s werelds meest toonaangevende leverancier binnen de vliegtuigindustrie. Met 32 productielocaties in 12 landen bedienen we meer dan 90% van ‘s werelds vliegtuig- en motorfabrikanten en een omzet behaald van £3.6 miljard in 2025. Wij ontwerpen en produceren innovatieve slimme ruimtevaartsystemen en componenten. Elke keer dat je per vliegtuig reist, is het waarschijnlijk dat GKN je op weg helpt.
We zijn op zoek naar mensen die een verschil willen maken, getalenteerde medewerkers met de vaardigheden en passies om het beste te worden in wat ze doen.

Job Summary

Production Assistant role is responsible for carrying out the required standard activities of their assigned tasks, in full compliance to the Work Instruction and/or Standard Operating Procedure, and without compromise to their own, and colleagues, safety.

Where required to achieve certified status, the team member will be taught how to undertake their tasks safely, and to a high quality level, through a rigorous Job Instruction process, and will be expected to attain the relevant certification, as measured by the competence matrix and specified in the sites BMS/QMS.

The team member will be fully supported by their Team Leader (TL), who will enable their training, coaching and quickly respond to them if they find any off-standard / quality issues.

They will be expected to actively identify safety concerns (Hazard identification), make problems immediately known to their TL (Pull the Andon), and raise improvement ideas to solve problems (Kaizen).

They will be part of a team that will collectively work on creating a Great Place to Work through a culture of continuous improvement, safe working and open dialogue.

2nd Shift Role

Job Responsibilities

  • Contribute to their team in creating a Great Place to Work by role-modelling safety-first, a Kaizen mind-set, and supporting their colleagues
  • Hold themselves, and fellow team members accountable to embody the GKNA culture principles
  • Undertake all of their tasks in compliance with the standard work and their training, and make any problems; safety, quality, or other, immediately known to their TL
  • Exemplify a safety-first mindset and follow all GKN Aerospace Health, Safety and Environmental policies and standards
  • Understand their teams People, Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cash and Cost Key Performance Indicators and their contribution to them
  • Become certified at the Lean Foundation level and implement at least 1 Kaizen per month
  • Support the team and TL in problem solving, contributing ideas based upon own experience of their tasks
  • Be an active member of the team, promoting collective engagement with each other
  • Comply with all legal and regulatory requirements:
  • The companys Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action policies
  • Compliance and Ethics Policy on Contracting with the United States Government in all areas of responsibility involving direct and indirect contracting with the United States Government
  • Export Control regulations

Job Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • Physical stamina, strength and ability to stand for extended periods of time.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A track record of Kaizen implementation
  • Experience working within a Lean Operating Model / Production System
  • Aerospace experience
  • A passion for the Aerospace industry

Diversity Inclusion and Belonging (DIB)

As a global engineering company, innovation is what differentiates us from our competitors and is central to our success.

A balance of cultures, ethnicities and genders help bring new ideas and creativity to GKN. We need people of different backgrounds, with different skills and perspectives to spark originality, imagination and creativeness in our teams around the world.

We treat all our employees and applicants fairly and are committed to ensuring that there is no discrimination or harassment against any employee or qualified applicant on the grounds of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Talent & Development Manager
description:
Compensation

Salary Range: $135,000-$150,000

Job Summary

The Talent & Development Manager is responsible for defining, developing, implementing, and evaluating learning strategies and programs that support the business objectives and employee-development needs. Working in partnership with Human Resources, operations and department managers, this position will identify organizational skill gaps, develop training plans, facilitate learning programs, support employee development, provide coaching, and promote a culture of continuous learning.

Main Responsibilities

Training Strategy, Development, and Facilitation

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive training and development strategy aligned with Sully-Miller’s operational and organizational goals.
  • Work closely with the Colas Inc. Director of Learning and Development to supplement existing programs and create new learning solutions based on Sully-Miller’s evolving business needs.
  • Partner with Human Resources and company managers to assess and identify training needs across departments, business functions, and create business plans.
  • Lead design, development, delivery, and evaluation of learning programs, including technical training, leadership and management development, sales, train-the-trainer, and curriculum-based learning assets.
  • Identify skill and knowledge gaps through needs analysis, competency modeling, and stakeholder interviews; translate findings into prioritized learning solutions.
  • Translate complex operational and technical information into practical, easy-to-understand learning content for employees at all levels.
  • Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics that demonstrate training impact on performance, retention, productivity, and safety. Provide clear, timely reporting to stakeholders on program outcomes and ROI.

Career Development and LMS

  • Partner with Human Resources and management on employee-development discussions, succession planning, and related talent-management initiatives.
  • Assist managers with identify, develop, and monitor emerging leaders through competency assessments and Individual Development Plans.
  • Identify and assign available courses within the Colas learning-management system and assign training based on employee, department, and organizational needs.

Internship Development Program

    • Coordinate intern classes, jobsite visits, learning activities and intern presentations and end-of-program activities.
    • Review intern program and recommend enhancements for future internship cycles.
    • Perform other related duties and special projects as assigned.

Education and/or Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Training and Development, Communications, Business Administration, Education, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience designing, delivering, and managing training and development programs; experience in transportation, construction, or heavy civil industries preferred.
  • Experience supporting learning and development within the construction, heavy civil, materials, manufacturing, or related industry.

Skills

  • Instructional design expertise: solid understanding of ADDIE, SAM, or other instructional design methodologies.
  • Creativity and innovation: track record creating modern learning experiences (gamification, simulations, blended learning) that engage diverse audiences.
  • Learning technologies: practical experience with LMS configuration, xAPI/SCORM standards, content management, and analytics. Familiarity with modern learning platforms and microlearning tools.
  • Change management: experience applying change management principles to support adoption of new skills and processes.

Position Summary

Purpose Financial is seeking a talented and motivated Sr Data Engineer to join our dynamic and growing data engineering Platform Team. The role reports to the Manager, Data Engineering and will support Purpose Financials initiative to build a data driven culture and improve decisioning for enterprise-wide teammates. Experience with dbt required.

The Senior Data Engineer will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and maintaining our data infrastructure and pipelines to enable efficient collection, storage, processing, and analysis of large-scale datasets. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to build and acquire underlying data for application owners and end-users and design strategic data services for the organization. The right Senior Data Engineer will need to have expert knowledge of AWS and/or Snowflake cloud environments.

Job Responsibility

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable data pipelines to ingest, transform, and load structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data from various sources into our data lake and warehouse environments.
  • Implement data integration solutions to consolidate data from disparate sources, including databases, API’s, streaming platforms, and 3rd party services (e.g., Snowpipe, SnowPark, Dynamo, Kafka).
  • Optimize data processing workflows for performance, efficiency, and scalability using distributed computing or parallel processing frameworks such as FiveTran, dbt, Snowpark, Snowpipe, etc.…
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with IT & business stakeholders to understand data requirements, define data models, and develop solutions to support data services, reporting, and Software Development.
  • Partner with data, IT, and business teams to improve design and building of metrics to enhance our analytic capabilities.
  • Implement data quality checks, data validation processes, and error handling mechanisms to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of data across all stages of the data lifecycle.
  • Support the design and maintenance of data schemas, and metadata repositories for governance documentation of data lineage, definitions, and dependencies.
  • Support the development and maintenance of data governance policies, standards, and best practices to ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and industry standards.
  • Apply best practices for AWS and Snowflake architectures, data pipelines and data models.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize the performance and availability of data systems and infrastructure using monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies, tools, and trends in data engineering, cloud architectures, and cloud computing to evaluate their potential impact and relevance to our data platforms.
  • Responsible to coach and mentor junior data engineers.

Job Responsibilities Cont.

Education Required

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Experience Required

  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data pipelines, and data services required.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum based development and methodology.
  • Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python, SQL, Spark, or Java, with experience in data manipulation, transformation, and analysis.
  • Expert level experience with cloud-based data platforms and services such as AWS, Snowflake and dbt.
  • Experience with distributed computing frameworks such as Apache Spark, Kafka, etc.
  • Proficiency in database systems, data warehousing, data patterns/architectures, and SQL query optimizations.
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal and teamwork skills, with the ability to interact with stakeholders at all levels of the data team.

Knowledge Required

Excellent written and verbal communications skills; adaptability and flexibility to a changing environment; and comfortable working in a dynamic, high volume, fast-paced environment. Ability to understand and ensure compliance with policies, procedures, and laws governing our industry/business and products.

Physical Requirements

Sitting for long periods of time; standing occasionally; walking; bending; squatting; kneeling; pushing/pulling; reaching; twisting; frequent lifting of less than 10 lbs., occasional lifting of up to 20 lbs.; driving and having access during the workday to an insured and reliable transportation; typing; data entry; grasping; transferring items between hands and/or to another person or receptacle; use of office equipment to include computers; ability to travel to, be physically present at, and complete the physical requirements of the position at any assigned location.

Data Architecture
Data Management

ETL/ETT/ETM Tools and Process
Technical Expertise

title: Medical Liaison -Sickle Cell Disease / Hemoglobinopathies - West
description:
About the Department

The Clinical, Medical and Regulatory (CMR) department at Novo Nordisk is one of the most diverse and collaborative groups within the organization. From healthcare provider interactions and developing and implementing regulatory strategies with the FDA to providing medical education and collecting data to support efficacy and new product development, CMR is involved. The one thing that keeps us all marching to the same beat is our patient centered focus. At Novo Nordisk, you will help patients around the world. As their needs evolve, so does our challenge to find better and more innovative ways to improve their quality of life. We’re changing lives for a living. Are you ready to make a difference?

The Position

Builds relationships with HCPs and demonstrates the clinical outcomes of NNI Hemoglobinopathies portfolio. Educates and demonstrates the safety and efficacy of key products to HCPs. Provides medical information and coordinates educational workshops, round tables, medical forums, etc.. May explore and identify sites for clinical trials in all stages of development. Incumbents have a deep scientific and clinical education and experience. Within Field Medical Affairs, this position functions as a scientific liaison between NNI and key external customers to further scientific exchange. S/he provides advanced product and scientific and medical field support to Medical, Sales and Marketing, as well as Managed Care and Government by using academic/professional credentials and scientific expertise to communicate with health care providers, organized providers/accounts and other relevant healthcare organizations. Strategic determination of change of territory prioritization will be based on customer need and analytics which identify need for change. This may occur at any time throughout the annual performance cycle. Develops and maintains medical (territory and account) plans in coordination with his/her Field Director.

Relationships

Position reports to Field Director/Sr Field Director. Serves as organization spokesperson on advanced medical and technical projects with the ML teams, Clinicians, Marketing, Market Access & Government and Sales personnel. External relationships include key opinion leaders (KOL’s), academic institutions, physicians, nurse practitioners, diabetes educators, pharmacists, blood bank staff, organized providers/IDNs and MCOs as needed based on territory archetypes.

Essential Functions

  • Administrative Duties:
    • Completes administrative duties in an accurate manner and on a timely basis, in line with current SOPs and working practices
    • Complies with all guidelines, policies, legal, regulatory and compliance requirements
    • Ensures effective administrative management of regional business as well as operational budgets
    • Maintains thorough understanding of all relevant Novo Nordisk processes and procedures and proactively assists other FMA members to further their understanding with these as needed
    • Provides monthly reports on scientific support activities in region to Director including budget expenditures as directed
    • Records all activities within a customer response management system (e.g. VEEVA) and all expenses within Concur in accordance with FMA procedures
  • Advocacy & Professional Relationship Development:
    • Attends assigned medical and scientific meetings: a) ensures and maintains awareness of current issues and new data pertaining to NNI products; b) develops and maintains relationships with key health care providers and IHNs; c) develops appropriate use of NNI products and greater utilization of its services d) supports and assists representatives and managers in answering questions from health care providers and IHNs
    • Combines account management skills, business acumen and scientific expertise to enhance value and develop collaborative relationships
    • Establishes the medical account strategy/plan through the identification and cultivation of key relationships and brings forth appropriate collaboration opportunities
  • Field-Based Clinical Support:
    • Collaborates with Health Economics & Outcomes Research (HEOR) team to deliver scientific value proposition of NNI’s products and devices to key customers and formulary decision makers. Delivers HEOR presentations upon request
    • Collaborates with Marketing and Sales management to inform the development of scientific strategies to optimize NNI’s products and development activities in the medical community
    • Collaborates with trial/study investigation sites; ensuring effective coordination and facilitation of studies to ensure timely review, initiation and completion, as well as publication of study results. Provides clinical support in cooperation with other Novo Nordisk groups to ensure investigators demonstrate appropriate knowledge of studies, support patient recruitment and retention activities, answers responsive requests from investigators and provides feedback to sites to other groups
    • Coordinates and collaborates with regional FMA team members to ensure integrated comprehensive coverage of regional clinical and scientific needs
    • Coordinates with key internal stakeholders to provide customized and dedicated system-wide clinical education and support within respective IHNs and coordinate and manage professional relations of Novo Nordisk within these Networks from an overall “account management” level
    • Coordinates with respective HSM to provide scientific and clinical education to Chief Executives, Medical Directors and formulary stakeholders to secure proper access to NNI’s products and services in respective IHNs
    • Develops and presents product and scientific updates as requested, including Formulary presentations within IHNs, using approved material

Physical Requirements

• 50-75% overnight travel required.
• The territory for this position is: CA, OR, WA, ID, MT, NV, UT, CO, WY, AZ, HI, AK.
• Position is Field Based and the ideal candidate must live within the territory or in a bordering state located near a major airport.
• Driver must maintain a valid driver’s license. Must be in good standing by not exceeding the Novo Nordisk points threshold assigned based on review of Motor Vehicle Records.

Qualifications

  • Doctoral degree required
  • At least two years’ experience in a health-related system, pharmaceutical company, or managed care environment required
  • Relevant clinical and/or therapeutic experience preferred
  • Displays business acumen/knowledge based on experiences such as participation in formulary process decisions
  • Extensive experience in Sickle Cell Disease / Hemoglobinopathies strongly preferred
  • Strong communication skills

This position is part of a job family. Title and level within the job family are evaluated based on a number of factors, such as years of experience, scope of work, proficiency and business need. Candidates will be assessed for the most appropriate title and level within the job family during the recruitment process. The base range of pay for each title in this job family are as follows:

  • Medical Liaison - $170,000 to $215,000
  • Senior Medical Liaison - $198,000 to $245,000

In addition, this position is eligible for a company bonus based on individual and company performance. Novo Nordisk offers long-term incentive compensation and or company vehicles depending on the position's level or other company factors.

Employees are also eligible to participate in Company employee benefit programs including medical, dental and vision coverage; life insurance; disability insurance; 401(k) savings plan; flexible spending accounts; employee assistance program; tuition reimbursement program; and voluntary benefits such as group legal, critical illness, identity theft protection, pet insurance and auto/home insurance. The Company also offers time off pursuant to its sick time policy, flex-able vacation policy and parental leave policy.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and defeating diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

  • Proficiency in computer scheduling programs (i.e. Primavera P6, Microsoft Project).

  • Contractor and Infrastructure project experience developing mid-size projects schedules is preferred.
  • Cost, Earned Value and Claims exposure is preferred.

title: Gate-level Noise (Signal Integrity) / STA CAD Engineer
description:
Imagine what you could do here! At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products very quickly. Do you want to bring passion and dedication to your job? There's no telling what you could accomplish at Apple. The people who work here have reinvented entire industries with Apple Hardware products. The same real passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices - we continue to strengthen our commitment to leave the world better than we found it! As a member of the CAD group, you will support the gate-level glitch noise and static timing analysis (STA) methodologies that ensure the signal integrity and robustness of Apple silicon across advanced technology nodes. In this role, you will learn and apply sign-off methodologies, margin models, and production CAD flows for crosstalk glitch and timing closure using industry-standard tools, under the guidance of senior engineers. You will work closely with CAD and physical design teams, assist with tool qualifications, help execute tapeout ECO tasks, and gain exposure to modern automation - including AI-agent workflows - used to scale analysis across our largest SOC designs.

In this highly visible role, your primary responsibilities will include: Contributing to the development of sign-off methodologies, noise margins, and tool qualification strategies for gate-level glitch noise and static timing analysis (STA) across advanced nodes. Develop and maintain production CAD flows and scripts for core noise and STA tools, from constraint setup through tapeout sign-off. Support the glitch noise analysis approach - including glitch thresholds, propagation, and its impact on timing and functional integrity. Support root-cause analysis of crosstalk glitch and timing anomalies, using and helping build automated triage workflows and AI-agent pipelines to improve debug efficiency. Collaborate with and support design and physical design teams on noise/timing constraints, flow issues, and sign-off waivers. Support noise and timing ECO methodologies to help accelerate design convergence toward tapeout. Participate in systematic tool and version qualifications, tracking QoR, performance, and correlation against golden baselines. Help author documentation and guidelines and share noise and STA best practices with the team.

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline and 3+ years of industry experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in gate-level signal integrity, with an emphasis on crosstalk glitch noise and static timing analysis (STA).
  • Hands-on experience with industry-standard SI and STA tools (e.g., PrimeTime-SI, Tempus, or equivalent).
  • Exposure to noise and timing sign-off on advanced process nodes.
  • Experience with or exposure to noise and timing ECO flows and techniques for design closure.
  • Scripting and automation skills in Python, Tcl, and/or Perl.
  • Ability to coordinate and drive initiatives with appropriate guidance.
  • Familiarity with standard cell library noise characterization (e.g., CCSN) or correlating gate-level models with SPICE simulations.
  • Understanding of place-and-route (P&R) implementation engines and physical design convergence.
  • Interest in modern AI/LLM-assisted workflows for CAD scripting, report parsing, or automated triage.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.

It’s an exciting time to join us as we lead change across the public service to implement social investment and support Government to achieve better outcomes from social sector spending.

Kōrero mō te tūranga | About the role

Bring your economics expertise to work that matters.

As Principal Analyst, you will provide senior economic thought leadership and hands-on analytical advice for the Community-Led Commissioning System Enablement programme.

Your work will help shape how government understands social sector spending, investment value and outcomes, and turn complex evidence into practical decisions.

You will:

  • Lead and quality-assure economic analysis, investment advice, forecasting and value-for-money assessments.

  • Develop decision-ready insights and reusable tools, including regional evidence, spend visibility, fiscal and demand outlooks, and return-on-investment approaches.

  • Work across economics, data, evaluation, policy and commissioning teams to test assumptions, strengthen evidence and support senior decisions.

You are an experienced economist or principal-level analyst who combines technical depth with sound judgement and a practical, collaborative approach.

You can make complex analysis useful to people who need to make decisions.

You will bring:

  • Strong applied economics, investment analysis, modelling, forecasting or cost-benefit/value-for-money expertise.
  • Experience leading or quality-assuring complex analysis and working confidently with complex datasets.
  • The ability to explain technical findings clearly to senior leaders and non-technical audiences.
  • Sound judgement about data quality, assumptions, privacy, ethics and responsible use of evidence.
  • Strong collaboration, prioritisation and delivery skills in a fast-moving, evolving environment.

The Social Investment Agency is a central agency, set up to lead the social investment approach to improve people’s lives and to support the Government to achieve better outcomes from social service expenditure.

title: Mechanical Technician
description:
Eaton’s ES AMER ARS division is currently seeking a Mechanical Technician to join our Fibrebond team in Minden, LA!

The core hours average 54 per week (including OT) between 6 am - 4:30 pm.

There is overtime every other Saturday from 6 am - 2:30 pm.

The hourly range for this position is $16.50-$18.48 per hour.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

What you’ll do:

The Mechanical Tech must be competent in the areas of In Building requirements and one of the following: Prefab, Generator or AC’s. Responsibilities may include hanging air conditioners, waveguides, fire suppression systems, and/or generators. May also be responsible for installing cable trays, grounding (wiring), generator exhaust systems, louvers, dampers, vent fans, ice shields, block out plates and polyphasers. Performs duties under limited supervision. Exercises initiative and judgment to complete and apply technical guidance given in work assignments.

Fibrebond, an Eaton company, designs and manufactures pre integrated modular buildings and power enclosures that protect mission critical equipment for data center, industrial, utility, and communications customers. Headquartered in Minden, Louisiana, Fibrebond is known for its engineered to order solutions that support complex infrastructure projects across North America. In 2025, Fibrebond was acquired by Eaton, expanding Eaton’s modular solutions portfolio while preserving Fibrebond’s strong engineering expertise, customer focus, and manufacturing operations in Louisiana.

In this role, you will:

• Reads and interprets Bill of Materials and prints to obtain the correct parts for each building.
• Measures and cuts cable trays with portable band saw according to prints.
• Measures and cuts all threads with a chop saw according to prints.
• Cad welds ground wire to ground bar.
• Prepares cover plates and waveguides for installation.
• Prepares vent fans and poly phasers for installation.
• Interprets prints to determine appropriate location for halo grounding, cable tray, ground bars, etc.
• Installs halo ground (wire around top of ceiling).
• Uses crimpers and c-taps to connect wire.
• Installs cover plates, waveguides and ground bars according to print.
• Drills holes in ceiling and installs mounting hardware for cable tray. Installs cable tray.
• Uses crimpers to install lugs to ground wires and connect ground wires to ground bar.
• Installs vent fans, poly phasers and ac grills.
• Aligns wave guides over designated areas of wall. Anchors to wall. Caulks around wave guide to seal.
• Reads blueprints to determine placement of cable trays.
• Drills holes in walls and installs mounting hardware for cable trays. Hang cable trays on ceilings.
• Reads blueprints to determine appropriate grounding (wiring). Attaches fasteners along top of wall just below ceiling.
• Connects wiring vertical along top of wall with fasteners. Attaches a second wire that runs horizontal and crimps wires together.
• Interprets prints and Bill of Materials to determine size and type of generator required.
• Threads and cuts pipe with a pipe threading machine to correct measurements.
• Installs generator pan and anchors to floor.
• Operates a forklift to set generator in building and anchor to floor.
• Installs exhaust thimble (ladder, drill hole, caulk around it), exhaust piping and fuel lines.
• Installs fire suppression systems.
• Operates forklift to place generator inside building. Pushes or pulls generator into place.
• Installs fire suppression systems including cylinders. Installs piping up the wall and overhead.
• Interprets prints and Bill of Materials to determine size and type of AC’s required.
• Removes packing material from AC and prepares for installation.
• Operates a forklift to pick up AC. Aligns AC to holes on building and secures with anchors.
• Caulks AC and AC sleeves.
• Installs flashing as required.
• Installs mounting hardware on walls for air conditioners.
• Operates a forklift to pick up air conditioners. Aligns in the building for installation.
• Drills holes in the wall with a hammer drill and inserts mounting hardware. Tightens fasteners with a ratchet.
• Aligns and installs louvers and dampers on walls of building.

Required (Basic) Qualifications:
• High School Diploma or GED equivalent from an accredited institution
• Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Previous experience using miscellaneous hand and power tools such as electric drill, portable band saw, chop saw, caulk gun, hammer drill, wrench, wire crimpers, wire strippers, hydraulic crimpers, pipe threaders.

Skills:

General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI), an affiliate of General Atomics, is a world leader in proven, reliable remotely piloted aircraft and tactical reconnaissance radars, as well as advanced high-resolution surveillance systems.

The Fleet and Deployment Services (FDS) team at General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI) manages the Capital Fleet of over 30 aircraft with supporting equipment. We are looking for a Program Manager to lead the Future Operations team to improve aircraft and equipment utilization and work with stakeholders for efficient project execution. This position reports to the Director of FDS and is responsible for the overall execution of fleet operations in support of company-wide stakeholders. The team is responsible for the technical, operational, fiscal planning, and execution of multiple simultaneous complex projects executed on the Capital Fleet. This role will lead all phases of operational projects, from scope creation, budgeting, and initiation through completion. Preferred experience successfully managing multiple projects simultaneously, leading, aviation operations, and understanding of aviation maintenance concepts. Responsible for decisions that could impact outcomes where erroneous decisions could cause serious schedule delays and expenditure of additional time and resources impeding the execution of company goals.

- Support GA-ASI projects with aircraft and assets within established company priorities.
