title: Government and Infrastructure-Risk Consulting-Enterprise Risk, Controls and Resilience - Manager
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Government & Infrastructure – Consulting – Risk Consulting – Enterprise Risk, Controls & Resilience – Manager

The Opportunity

From strategy to execution, the Government & Infrastructure (G&I) practice of Ernst & Young LLP provides a full range of consulting and audit services to help our Federal, State, Local and Education clients implement new ideas to help achieve their mission outcomes. We deliver real change and measurable results through our diverse, high-performing teams, quality work at the highest professional standards, operational know-how from across our global organization, and creative and bold ideas that drive innovation. We enable our government clients to achieve their mission of protecting the nation and serving the people; increasing public safety; improving healthcare for our military, veterans and citizens; delivering essential public services; and helping those in need. EY is ready to help our government build a better working world.

Within G&I Risk Consulting, we help government organizations understand and manage risks that can affect mission outcomes, financial performance, operations and public trust. Our teams build and operate the programs that strengthen governance and controls, improve resilience, prevent fraud and financial loss, manage grant and relief funds, enhance compliance, and enable better risk-informed decisions. Across our work, we use data, AI, automation and technology platforms to improve how risks are identified, assessed, monitored and managed.

Our Enterprise Risk, Controls & Resilience team helps government organizations govern risk, strengthen controls and stay resilient. Our work spans internal controls management (including OMB Circular A-123 and Federal Managers' Financial Integrity Act requirements), internal audit, integrated and enterprise risk management (ERM), enterprise resilience, third-party risk management (including vendor risk management), and ethics and regulatory compliance. We design, transform and operate these programs, using AI, data analytics and Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platforms to automate control testing and monitoring, so that government organizations can achieve and sustain clean audit opinions and make risk-informed decisions.

As a Risk Consulting Manager in our Enterprise Risk, Controls & Resilience team, you may be assigned to one or more government agencies as your primary clients. You will lead engagements or major workstreams, own engagement quality and economics, develop our people and play an active role in growing the practice by shaping offerings, building client relationships and leading pursuits. You will be a key team member in the development and growth of our G&I Risk business, which is a priority for our firm.

Your key responsibilities

Client delivery and engagement leadership

• Lead internal controls (including OMB Circular A-123, audit readiness and control remediation), internal audit, integrated and enterprise risk management, third-party risk, ethics and regulatory compliance, or enterprise resilience engagements or major workstreams, from planning through closure.

• Serve as a direct point of contact for agency leaders, such as CFO, Chief Risk Officer, internal audit and program leaders, including status reporting, managing expectations and resolving issues.

• Advise on control and risk program design, including governance, risk appetite, A-123 and state internal control assessment strategy, audit-readiness roadmaps, internal audit transformation, ERM and third-party risk operating models, compliance programs and resilience programs.

• Lead the design, build and operation of third-party risk management programs, including governance and policy, risk appetite for vendor relationships, inherent risk tiering, risk-based due diligence standards, contract requirements, ongoing monitoring and offboarding, and advise leaders on critical vendor concentration and fourth-party dependencies.

• Own engagement economics: budget-to-actuals, contract terms, burn rates, staffing mix, change requests and margin.

• Design the delivery approach, including which testing, documentation, vendor assessment and reporting work is delivered through our Service Delivery Center (SDC), and set requirements, quality standards and acceptance criteria for that work.

• Review and approve deliverables to make sure they meet EY quality and risk management standards and working paper documentation standards.

• Hold difficult conversations with team members and clients professionally and on time.

Practice and people development

• Shape offerings, methodologies and accelerators in internal controls, internal audit, ERM, third-party risk, compliance and resilience, including AI-enabled testing, controls monitoring and third-party risk assessments delivered as a managed service; contribute to thought leadership.

• Delegate, supervise and review the work of multiple Staff and Seniors, and provide timely feedback and career advice.

• Serve as a formal counselor to Staff and Seniors, including coaching and participating in the firm-wide performance review process.

• Recruit, interview and onboard talent.

Business development

• Identify, shape and qualify new opportunities, for example from audit results, oversight findings, vendor-related incidents or new mission requirements, with existing and new clients.

• Lead proposal and orals development (solution, staffing model, pricing inputs and win themes) with Senior Managers and Partners.

• Build account knowledge: client mission priorities, audit and risk posture, budget cycles, contract vehicles and upcoming needs.

Skills and attributes for success

• Understanding of internal control and risk frameworks such as the GAO Green Book, COSO Internal Control and COSO ERM, and OMB Circular A-123, including control testing design and execution and risk and control self-assessment

• Understanding of enterprise risk concepts such as risk identification, risk appetite and tolerance, key risk indicators, scenario analysis, third-party risk and business continuity planning

• Knowledge of, or experience with, federal business processes such as funds management, budget formulation and execution, receivables, disbursements, property management, human resources, financial reporting and grants management, or comparable state, local and education processes such as benefits programs

• Knowledge of working paper documentation standards and internal audit standards (e.g., IIA Global Internal Audit Standards, GAGAS)

• Deep knowledge of third-party risk management practices and the ability to design operating models and maturity roadmaps

• Experience conducting resilience activities such as business impact analyses, critical process identification, dependency mapping, scenario analysis, tabletop exercises, recovery testing, and resilience assessments and roadmaps

• Strong report-writing skills to communicate findings and recommendations to clients

• Excellent communication skills to discuss observations and negotiate the acquisition of data for testing and reporting on internal controls

• Project and people management skills and experience, including leading blended teams that use onshore delivery centers

• Ability and willingness to supervise and develop team members

• Ability to conduct research on regulatory guidance, current industry standards and trends, and new legislation and requirements

• Knowledge of how to effectively leverage firm approved AI tools to enhance problem-solving and productivity and the ability to exercise sound judgment around AI-related risks and considerations

• Ability to assess and articulate the evolving risks that AI presents to clients across multiple risk domains, including AI embedded in vendor products and services

To qualify for the role, you must have

• A bachelor's or master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Risk Management, Public Administration or a related discipline.

• A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in internal audit, internal controls, OMB Circular A-123, financial statement audit, audit readiness and control remediation, enterprise risk management, third-party or vendor risk management, compliance or resilience, with a public accounting firm, a professional services firm, a government organization or within industry.

• Demonstrated experience managing engagements or workstreams, including budgets and teams, and contributing to proposals or business development.

• A US certification in at least one of the following: CPA, CIA, CGFM, CDFM, CA, CMA, RIMS-CRMP, FRM, CTPRP or CBCP.

• U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance or higher.

• Due to the nature of our work in G&I, work may be required at client, EY and/or contractor sites. Our goal is to assign professionals to projects within a commutable distance of their work location office; in certain circumstances, travel may be required beyond your work location based on client and project needs. Candidates should be willing to travel on average 25% to 30% or more in a hybrid environment.

Ideally, you'll also have

• Working knowledge of the US Standard General Ledger (USSGL) and the Statements of Federal Financial Accounting Standards (SFFAS).

• Experience designing or leading ERM, third-party or vendor risk management, compliance, or enterprise, business continuity or operational resilience programs (e.g., applying ISO 22301, ISO 31000 or NIST SP 800-34), or controls monitoring delivered as a managed service.

• Experience implementing or configuring third-party risk management platforms (e.g., ServiceNow Vendor Risk Management, Archer Third Party Governance, OneTrust, ProcessUnity) and integrating vendor risk intelligence sources (e.g., BitSight, SecurityScorecard).

• Familiarity with state internal control and internal audit statutes (e.g., Massachusetts Chapter 647 of the Acts of 1989, the New York State Governmental Accountability, Audit and Internal Control Act, Section 215.86 of the Florida Statutes, the Texas Internal Auditing Act and the California State Leadership Accountability Act).

• Existing relationships with federal or state agencies and experience pursuing work on government contract vehicles.

What we look for

At EY, we know it's your point of view, energy and enthusiasm that make the difference. Top performers have experience delivering project plans on large, complex engagements from analysis through implementation. They have experience with federal or state agencies, often gained by working in a Big Four global management consulting firm or a blue-chip company focused on government and the public sector. title: Engineering Manager, Bazel & Remote Build Execution
description:
Apple Services Engineering (ASE) builds and runs the infrastructure behind Apple's services. ASE DevX (Developer Experience) provides the tools and platforms ASE engineers use to build, test, and ship. Thousands of Apple engineers build, test, and ship services with Bazel, and they run it through our toolchain: bazel wrapper CLI, our Bazel Central Registry mirror, shared rulesets, and a remote build execution (RBE) platform that runs their actions at scale. The Bazel team builds and operates that toolchain. We make builds fast, hermetic, and reproducible, and we help large codebases move onto Bazel and stay there.

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team. You'll own the roadmap for Apple's Bazel ecosystem and RBE platform, and you'll grow a team of engineers whose work directly sets how fast other teams can ship. You'll also represent Apple in the open-source Bazel community.

As the Engineering Manager for the Bazel team, you will be responsible for:

  • Platform strategy: Own the vision and multi-quarter roadmap for Bazel at Apple. That includes the developer toolchain (bazelw, rules, toolchains, IDE integration), the module ecosystem (Bzlmod, the registry, shared modules), and the remote execution and caching platform.
  • Remote build execution at scale: Drive the scaling, reliability, and cost efficiency of RBE. That includes expanding execution platforms (such as macOS execution), custom base images, capacity planning, and SLOs for availability and build performance.
  • Migrations and customer adoption: Partner with product engineering organizations to move large, complex codebases onto Bazel. Balance hands-on expertise and tooling from our team with migration work owned by customer teams, and measure success by build time, reliability, and developer satisfaction.
  • Supply chain and compliance: Make sure builds meet Apple's security and compliance requirements, such as SBOM generation, provenance, and hermetic dependency management. Do this through platform defaults, not per-team effort.
  • Developer experience: Invest in the tools developers touch every day: build UIs and observability, failure triage, local and CI parity, and AI-assisted workflows for build maintenance and migration.
  • Open source: Contribute upstream to Bazel and its rule ecosystem where it serves Apple, and build relationships with the maintainers and the wider community.
  • People leadership: Hire, mentor, and grow a team of senior and staff engineers. Run a sustainable support and on-call model. Build a culture of technical rigor, ownership, and customer empathy.
  • Cross-functional influence: Align priorities with partner infrastructure teams (CI, compute, artifact management, security). Communicate trade-offs and status to senior leadership. Make the case for investment based on measured impact.

Minimum Qualifications

    • 8+ years of software engineering experience in build systems, developer tooling, infrastructure, or distributed systems
    • 3+ years of engineering management experience, including managing senior engineers and running hiring, performance, and career development
    • Hands-on experience with a modern build system at scale (Bazel, Buck2, Pants, or equivalent), including how dependency graphs, action caching, and remote execution behave
    • Track record of delivering large, multi-quarter infrastructure projects across team boundaries, from scoping and sequencing through delivery and operation
    • Experience operating production services using SLOs, metrics, and telemetry to drive reliability and performance decisions
    • Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to influence engineers and senior leadership
    • BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

    • Deep Bazel expertise: Starlark rules and providers, toolchains and platforms, transitions, Bzlmod, and the Remote Execution API
    • Experience building or operating remote execution and caching systems (Buildbarn, BuildBuddy, EngFlow, Buildfarm, or in-house)
    • Experience leading large codebase migrations onto a new build system and driving organizational adoption of an internal platform
    • Familiarity with Apple platform toolchains (Xcode, Swift, Clang, SDKs, code signing) and macOS execution environments
    • Experience with Kubernetes, containers, and large-scale compute or batch scheduling
    • Knowledge of software supply chain security: SBOMs, provenance, reproducible builds
    • Contributions to Bazel, rules_apple, rules_swift, rules_go, rules_oci, or related open-source projects
    • Experience using AI-assisted development tools and agents to improve engineering productivity
    • Experience managing geographically distributed teams

Preferred qualifications:

  • A collaborative approach to teamwork, reflecting the culture of collaboration that sets JLL apart, locally and across the globe.
  • Comfort working across a diverse, multi-site portfolio with varying stakeholder needs.

Location:

On-site –Cheshire, GBR

Job Tags:

Hiring

title: Meewerkstage bij team Woonregelingen
description:
Dit ga je doen

Nederland heeft een grote opgave om meer woningen te realiseren en bestaande woonvormen te verbeteren. Daarvoor stellen ministeries verschillende subsidieregelingen beschikbaar. Binnen Team Woonregelingen werken wij met ongeveer 35 medewerkers aan meer dan 20 regelingen. Tijdens jouw stageperiode krijg je een kijkje in onze “bouwkeuken”, mag je meedenken over onze werkwijze en zorgen we ervoor dat je aan een mooie eigen opdracht kunt werken.

Waar jij aan werkt

Ons team bestaat uit Procescoördinatoren, Uitvoeringsexperts, Projectadviseurs en Beoordelaars die ieder hun specifieke rol hebben bij de uitvoering van de regelingen. Je krijgt de kans om bij al deze rollen mee te kijken maar ook mee te werken aan de verschillende taken die daarbij horen. Daarbij gaat het om het opzetten en beheersbaar maken van de regelingen maar ook het beoordelen van de dossiers. De regelingen zijn heel divers zoals Huisvesting voor Aandachtsgroepen, Stimulering van Zorggeschikte Woningen, Herplaatsbare Woningen, maar ook de algemene Woningbouwstimulans. Bij veel van deze regelingen zijn de gemeenten onze klant. We gaan dan ook regelmatig op werkbezoek naar een gemeente. Het voorbereiden van zo’n werkbezoek kan één van jouw taken zijn.

Binnen het team is er veel onderlinge betrokkenheid. Je zult merken dat mensen elkaar makkelijk opzoeken en bereid zijn om kennis te delen. Daardoor sta je er nooit alleen voor en heb je kans veel te leren. Wij staan ook altijd open voor optimalisatie van onze werkwijze en nodigen je dan ook van harte uit met ons mee te denken over waar het slimmer of beter kan.

Je wordt gekoppeld aan één van onze medewerkers die zelf ooit stagiair is geweest en je dus kan begeleiden bij een zo succesvol mogelijke stage.

Verder willen we jou de kans geven aan een mooie zelfstandige opdracht te werken, die zowel jou als ons iets kan bieden. Denk daarbij aan: ideeën voor benutten van AI; klanttevredenheidsonderzoeken; procesoptimalisatie; planning; communicatie over ons werkterrein; data. Welke opdracht het uiteindelijk wordt zullen we in het begin van de stage samen met jou bepalen.

Kortom binnen deze stage is er alle ruimte voor jou om actief mee te denken én werken!

Dit bieden we nog meer

Stagevergoeding

Als jouw stage bij het Rijk langer duurt dan één maand. Dan heb je recht op een stagevergoeding. De stagevergoeding is gebaseerd op een vijfdaagse werkweek, waarbij wordt uitgegaan van 40 uur stage (5 dagen van 8 uur) per week. Bij een stage van minder dan 40 uur per week, wordt dit berekend naar evenredigheid van het aantal afgesproken uren.

Reiskostenvergoeding

Kun je als stagiair geen gebruikmaken van een OV-studentenkaart voor het reizen tussen je woning en de stageplek? Dan kun je een reiskostenvergoeding krijgen. Hiervoor gelden de woon-werkverkeer regels voor rijksambtenaren. Maak je als stagiair een dienstreis? Dan gelden de regels voor binnenlandse dienstreizen en buitenlandse dienstreizen voor rijksambtenaren. Reis je met de trein voor een dienstreis? Dan reis je in tweede klasse.

Vakantie-uren

Alleen bij stages van een maand of langer vindt toekenning van vakantie plaats. Je hebt tijdens je stage aanspraak op 160 vakantie-uren op jaarbasis bij een stage van 40 uur per week. Is de stage voor minder dan 40 uur per week overeengekomen? Dan wordt de aanspraak op vakantie-uren naar evenredigheid vastgesteld.

Dit vragen wij

Als meewerk stagiair bij team Woonregelingen ben je vooral leergierig en neem je makkelijk het initiatief. Je wil graag meer leren over werken in een grote uitvoeringsorganisatie. Daarnaast vind je het interessant om mee te denken over het thema Wonen in relatie tot de subsidieregelingen die daarvoor beschikbaar zijn.

Voor de zelfstandige opdracht is het van belang dat je goed kunt plannen, organiseren en prioriteiten kunt stellen, zodat je weet wat er op welk moment moet gebeuren om tot resultaat te komen.

In ons werk is samenwerken essentieel. Je werkt intensief samen met in principe het gehele team en ondersteunt waar nodig. We nemen elkaars werk moeiteloos over als iemand afwezig is en geven elkaar feedback om samen beter te worden. Jij vindt het vanzelfsprekend om jouw kennis te delen, vragen te stellen en collega’s te helpen wanneer dat nodig is.

Verder heb je:

  • Een inschrijving bij een Nederlandse hbo-opleiding in de richting van Bestuurskunde/ Overheidsmanagement of Data
  • Interesse in een meewerkstage en zit je in het 2e, 3e of 4e jaar van je studie.

Hier kom je te werken

Over Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO)

Vandaag werken aan de wereld van morgen

De wereld verandert elke dag en wij veranderen mee. Met meer dan 6000 RVO’ers werken we iedere dag aan morgen. We ondersteunen, adviseren en stimuleren ondernemend Nederland. We helpen met innoveren en verduurzamen. Nationaal en internationaal, want ons werk stopt niet bij de grens. Samen werken we aan:

  • De verduurzaming van onze energievoorzieningen.
  • Het tegengaan van klimaatverandering.
  • Een omslag naar een duurzaam landbouw- en voedselsysteem.
  • Een sterke digitale economie.

Het zijn grote uitdagingen, maar wij geloven dat het mogelijk is. Daarom verbinden we ondernemers, overheden en organisaties om te bouwen aan het Nederland van morgen.

We doen het samen.

Wat doen we?

Wij maken overheidsbeleid bereikbaar en uitvoerbaar. Van voorlichting, advies en financiering tot het bieden van een luisterend oor voor ondernemers en organisaties. En dat is nog maar een klein onderdeel van wat we doen. Ondernemend Nederland is ontzettend veelzijdig en daarom zijn wij dat ook.

Divers maakt beter

Met enorme uitdagingen op komst, is de juiste mensen aan boord hebben belangrijk. Het maakt bij ons niet uit wie je bent. Wij kijken naar wat je kunt en waar jouw ambities liggen. Om de wereld duurzamer te maken hebben we ideeën nodig uit alle hoeken van de samenleving. Daarom hebben we voor iedereen plaats bij RVO, zolang je maar nieuwsgierig en ondernemend bent. We geven je vertrouwen, vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Want zo boek jij de mooiste resultaten. Voor jezelf, voor ondernemers en voor morgen.

Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO)

Bijzonderheden

Stageovereenkomst

  • Voor deze stage geldt uitsluitend de stageovereenkomst van de Rijksoverheid. Indien de opleiding een eigen stageovereenkomst hanteert, dient de stagiair dit vooraf zelf af te stemmen met de opleiding of de stagebegeleider. De stage kan alleen starten nadat de Rijksoverheid-stageovereenkomst door alle partijen is ondertekend.

Hybride werken

  • Bij RVO werken we hybride. Voor deze functie wordt van je verwacht dat je twee keer per week op de RVO-vestiging in Den Haag aanwezig bent. Voor de overige dagen kun je je werk vanaf elke locatie doen (vanuit huis, op één van de RVO-kantoren of elders).

Sollicitatieproces

  • Sollicitaties worden pas behandeld na sluiting van de vacature.

Selectieproces

  • Alle binnengekomen cv’s worden beoordeeld aan de hand van de eisen uit de vacature. Zorg dus dat uit jouw cv duidelijk wordt of je over de benodigde eisen beschikt.
  • De gesprekken zijn gepland in december of januari in Den Haag.

Overig

  • Voor werken bij RVO is een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) vereist.
  • Om de vacaturetekst later nog terug te kunnen lezen, raden we aan deze vooraf te downloaden.
  • De start- en einddatum van je stage is in goed overleg af te spreken.

Alle informatie over je stage bij de Rijksoverheid is te vinden op: . Zo krijg je naast een mooie stagevergoeding ook vakantie-uren en goede begeleiding.

Teamomschrijving

Je komt terecht in een team van ongeveer 35 collega’s met twee teammanagers. De groep is divers in leeftijd en achtergrond. Nieuwe collega’s worden goed begeleid en ingewerkt. Collega’s nemen de tijd om je wegwijs te maken en je vragen te beantwoorden, zodat je snel zelfstandig aan de slag kunt.

title: Product Engineer
description:
Product Engineer

Location: Waukegan, IL

Salary Range: $ 71,000.00 to $ 87,000.00

About SKF:

SKF, reducing friction since 1907, re-imagining rotation for a better tomorrow!

SKF is an industry-leading manufacturer that has been a cornerstone in industrial life. Wherever there are machines or products in motion, SKF bearings are there to reduce friction. SKF drives the industries that support our way of life, powers the machines that put food on the table, and even helps explore the cosmos.

Sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. SKF is on pace to decarbonize all its production facilities by 2030.

We’re guided by our SKF values. Collaboration is critical to the success of our colleagues, partners, and customers. Curiosity and Courage provide a foundation for innovation and advancement. And we do this work out of Care for our people, customers, communities, and the planet.

We’re a company committed to a culture of belonging, where all our people are encouraged to be themselves and grow their careers in an equitable environment.

Learn about SKF at .

Job Summary:

SKF works to reduce friction, noise, make things run faster, longer, cleaner and more safely. Doing this in the most effective, productive, and sustainable way has made the SKF Group a leading global supplier of products, solutions and services within rolling bearings, seals, mechatronics, services and lubrication systems.

Product Development and Engineering Americas is part of the Global Technology Development (TD) organization and plays a decisive role in defining the right offers for the SKF Product value propositions. Product Development and Engineering translates market trends and customer needs into new, long term and sustainable solutions, by defining, developing and maintaining the product technical data and ensuring the up to date product technical knowledge is used to bring value to SKF customers and employees.

Product Engineering supports the daily business with technical product expertise and finished product level specifications. Our team has many vital responsibilities that enable new products and variants to end up at the customer. We enable smooth handling of product requests from the customers by providing specifications, product data and new solutions.

Your day-to-day work:

  • Accelerate the development of the Global Agriculture PD&E team located in NAM and provide training and support to help increase their capabilities.

  • Plan, drive, execute and report product design requests and engineering tasks with priority to support the TD and Americas region strategies.
  • Use and maintain design tools for parametric design of bearing variants and design automation.
  • Support the Full Value Chain globally by creating and optimizing design rules and product design specifications.
  • Develop & maintain bearing 3D CAD models for design verification and creation of finished drawings.

  • Use Innovation and Creative Problem solving to find solutions to customer needs.

We expect you to have:

  • Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong understanding of the industrial distribution market and its dynamics.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Willingness to travel up to 15% or as needed.
  • A minimum of a Bachelors degree in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering and 2 years experience in product development, project engineering or similar R&D environment.
  • Broad technical understanding and interest
  • Strong knowledge of manufacturing and testing
  • Ability to build and maintain sustainable relationships with internal customers and stakeholders, aiming at maximization of the SKF results.
  • Good communication skill and good knowledge of English, both verbally and in writing
  • Tools requirements:
    • CREO/Solid Works - have good knowledge about parametric design and generic models
    • Simulation, Modeling, and Calculation tools
    • Microsoft tools: Excel, PowerPoint, Word
    • PDM Link knowledge

    • Experience and exposure to project management

The person we are looking for is self-motivated with a high level of drive and commitment.

A team player interested in learning and sharing competencies with others.

Personal Profile

  • Well-structured and self-motivated with a high level of own drive and commitment
  • Pro-active and open-minded team player, eager to learn and share competencies
  • Ability to understand stakeholder needs and transform those into feasible and robust solutions
  • Willingness and ability to travel, and potentially work abroad on shorter assignments

We offer

  • You will be a part of a diverse workforce where you get to face exciting challenges and varied tasks
  • You will enjoy supportive colleagues and a secure organizational structure.

What You’ll Love About SKF:

Work/Life Integration. SKF supports work/life integration, home, family, community, personal well-being and health.

Diversity in the Workplace. At SKF, we strive to embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in everything we do. By developing a culture of belonging, our people can flourish; leading to an inclusive, equitable environment that promotes leadership, engagement and innovation.

Added benefits include company paid life insurance, STD, LTD. Supplemental benefits include critical illness coverage, tuition reimbursement, employee discount programs, and much more!

Bonus. SKF offers STVS (Short Term Variable Salary) or Sales Incentive based on company performance and at the discretion of management.

Invest in your Future. Participate in our 401K program that boasts a 10% employer contribution: 100% match up to 5% of your elected contribution (100% Vested) plus an additional 5% company contribution.

title: Engineering Change Coordinator - Leeds, AL
description:
Job Overview

The Engineering Change Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and driving engineering changes for Engineer-to-Order products from identification through implementation and closure. The role ensures changes to drawings, bills of material, routings, specifications, and associated manufacturing information are communicated, prioritized, released, and implemented in a controlled manner.

The EC Coordinator acts as a central point of coordination between Engineering, Manufacturing, Materials/Planning, Quality, and Commercial teams, helping ensure engineering changes align with customer commitments, production schedules, material availability, and product quality.

A Day In The Life

Engineering Change Coordination

  • Own the day-to-day coordination and tracking of Engineering Changes for ETO orders.
  • Maintain visibility of open ECs, priorities, responsible owners, required actions, and completion status.
  • Facilitate EC review and disposition with Engineering, Operations, Materials, Quality, and other stakeholders.
  • Ensure changes progress from initial request through engineering release and manufacturing implementation.
  • Escalate ECs that threaten customer delivery dates, manufacturing schedules, or material availability.

ETO Order Support

  • Review active ETO orders for engineering changes or documentation issues that could prevent execution.
  • Coordinate resolution of drawing, BOM, specification, configuration, and manufacturing-documentation discrepancies.
  • Work with Planning and Operations to ensure released engineering information is available when required to support manufacturing.
  • Identify changes affecting work already released to production and coordinate appropriate disposition.

Change Impact Management

  • Determine which open orders, components, drawings, BOMs, or production activities may be affected by a proposed engineering change.
  • Coordinate material disposition when changes create obsolete, excess, rework, or replacement material requirements.
  • Ensure downstream stakeholders understand when a change becomes effective.
  • Coordinate implementation timing to minimize disruption to production and customer delivery.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Serve as the communication link between operations and the ETO execution team.
  • Clearly document decisions, owners, required actions, and due dates.
  • Follow up on overdue activities and unresolved dependencies.
  • Communicate high-risk changes to appropriate leadership.

Process & Performance Improvement

  • Develop and maintain EC tracking and reporting.
  • Monitor recurring causes of engineering changes and identify opportunities to reduce preventable changes.
  • Support improvements to ETO engineering-release and change-management processes.
  • Track metrics such as open ECs, aging, overdue actions, implementation cycle time, and ECs affecting production.
  • Help improve engineering-release quality and first-time-right execution.

Measures of Success

  • Reduction in aging/open Engineering Changes
  • Engineering Change cycle time
  • Percentage of EC actions completed by required date
  • Number of production interruptions attributable to unresolved engineering changes
  • On-time engineering release supporting ETO production
  • Reduction in recurring/repeat engineering changes
  • Improvement in first-time-right BOM and drawing releases

What will help you thrive in this role?

  • Associate's degree or equivalent relevant manufacturing experience.
  • Experience working in an engineered-product or manufacturing environment.
  • Strong ability to coordinate multiple priorities and follow actions through completion.
  • Ability to read and understand engineering drawings, bills of material, and product specifications.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and standard Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred

  • Experience in an Engineer-to-Order or Configure-to-Order manufacturing environment.
  • Experience with ERP systems such as SAP.
  • Experience with engineering change control, BOM management, document control, or product lifecycle management processes.
  • Familiarity with CAD drawings and engineering documentation.
  • Experience supporting electrical, mechanical, or utility-industry products.

Hubbell Incorporated

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

Hubbell Utility Solutions

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

title: Early Career Environmental Engineering
description:
This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for a full-time Early Career Environmental Engineer for our Minneapolis, MN office. Be involved in projects with our Earth & Environment Team and be a part of a growing organization that meets our client’s objectives and solves their challenges. WSP environmental engineers enjoy completing a wide a range of environmental assessment, inspection, and remediation projects.

This is a tremendous opportunity to broaden your engineering, regulatory, compliance, and field experience as you grow your career with WSP. We pride ourselves in offering our team members the opportunity to grow professionally with mentoring and training opportunities along with our Developing Professionals Network. Selected applicant will take part in providing local technical assistance for investigations of soil, air, and groundwater and protection and mitigation efforts relating to water supply, property transfers, hazardous or solid waste disposal, air emission sources, and pollution control. Generates accurate and concise documentation, ensuring that responsibilities are delivered and adhered to with a level of quality that meets or exceeds acceptable industry standards.

Your Impact

  • Under general supervision, provide field support on a wide variety of environmental projects including site assessment, remediation, compliance programs, Phase I environmental site assessments, and sampling/monitoring.
  • Conduct subsurface investigations which include drilling, geologic/geotechnical logging and environmental media sampling.
  • Maintain quality control standards and procedures for accurate and precise measurements.
  • Perform engineering calculations, cost estimates, data validation, and report preparation.
  • Prepare reports, including documenting field investigative procedures, data management and interpretation, and development of graphical and tabular presentation of data.
  • Perform Phase 1 environmental site assessments.
  • Utilize GIS to support data evaluation, presentation and mapping, as applicable.
  • Assist with verifying the characteristics of a site, providing entry-level technical assistance on various environmental issues.
  • Generate complete, accurate, and concise documentation using electronic systems and field/work site notebook.
  • Work closely with WSP project managers to meet client expectations with regards to defined project objectives, schedule, budget, change management, problem solving, and project deliverables.
  • Demonstrate proficiency using Microsoft Office products and strong technical writing and data analysis skills.
  • Comply with safety guidelines and site-specific procedures which include but are not limited to, the maintenance of sample collection, location data, statistical documentation, and logbooks.
  • Complete training on assigned tasks.
  • Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers to evaluate, select, and design site remedies involving contaminated soil, groundwater, and vapor leading to regulatory closure.
  • Prepare or support the preparation of SWPPP, SPCC, FRP, and ERAP plans, including performing site inspections.
  • Prepare and implement site Health and Safety Plans (HASPs) and Traffic Control Plans.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Environmental, Civil, or Geological Engineering or closely related discipline.
  • 0 to 1 years of relevant post education experience.
  • Excellent problem solving skills with analytical mindset.
  • Familiarity with the concepts of reducing and eliminating the use or generation of hazardous substances, processes, or products.
  • Familiarity with relevant environmental laws, regulations, compliance practices, and record-keeping requirements.
  • Competent interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others, expressing ideas effectively and professionally to an engineering and non-engineering audience.
  • Proficient self-leadership with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to work independently under general supervision, as well as part of a team to meet business objectives.
  • Basic proficiency with technical writing, office automation and communication software, technology, and tools.
  • Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
  • Ability to work schedules conducive to project-specific requirements that may extend beyond the typical work week.
  • Occasional travel (potentially up to 40%) may be required depending on project-specific requirements.
  • Must possess a valid US driver’s license and successfully complete WSP's Motor Vehicle screening.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Engineer in Training Certification (or ability to obtain).
  • Certifications: OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER Training
  • Prior internship related to the degree of study and the specific engineering discipline.

WSP Benefits:
WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on a providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.


Compensation:

Expected Salary (all locations): $58,200 - $87,300

WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

title: Technology Project Manager
description:
Permanent Full Time

-

We’re seeking a skilled Technology Project Manager to lead small/medium scale digital initiatives that deliver meaningful business and technology outcomes. This role is responsible for planning and executing projects end to end, aligning technical solutions with business objectives, and ensuring successful delivery within defined scope, budget, and timelines.

About You

You’re a proactive and collaborative project leader who performs well in dynamic environments and values strong stakeholder partnerships. You bring an enabling leadership mindset, removing obstacles for teams, fostering alignment, and adapting your approach as project needs evolve. You’re comfortable operating at both a high level and in the details when required to keep delivery on track.

What You Will Do

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with business, vendor, and technology stakeholders
  • Collaborate with sponsors and team members to align project objectives with business goals
  • Lead technology projects through the full delivery lifecycle, from initiation to close
  • Coordinate cross functional project teams and manage dependencies between workstreams
  • Develop, execute, and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, and budgets
  • Identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and change requests
  • Resolve conflicts within the project and escalate appropriately when needed
  • Communicate project status, risks, and impacts clearly to stakeholders at all levels
  • Monitor project performance to ensure delivery against scope, budget, quality, and timelines
  • Ensure compliance with corporate risk, governance, and project management standards
  • Track and report on project metrics, milestones, and outcomes
  • Support continuous improvement by applying lessons learned and promoting best practices
  • Ensure adherence to the organization’s project delivery methodology

What You Will Bring

  • PMP or equivalent project management certification (or working toward)
  • 5 years’ experience managing technology projects in waterfall, agile or hybrid environments
  • Demonstrated success delivering small/medium complexity projects with multiple stakeholders
  • Experience managing project budgets, timelines, scope, and dependencies
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Solid understanding of digital solutions, enterprise systems, and agile delivery practices
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business focused communications
  • Problem solving mindset with a collaborative and adaptable approach
  • Experience working with distributed or cross functional teams

Given the size and scope of our organization, we have the flexibility for this position to be located in the following head office locations: Toronto, Winnipeg, London. This role follows a hybrid work model, with an in-office presence required three days per week.

-

The base salary for this position is between $65,800 - $109,700 annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). title: Technical Specialist II
description:
Technical Specialist II – Gulfstream Aerospace Corporation – 500 Gulfstream Road, Savannah, GA 31407

DUTIES: Responsible for design, integration, testing, audit, certification, & support of aircraft systems used on multiple company platforms. Work across multidisciplinary teams to ensure aircraft systems meet functional, performance, safety, & regulatory requirements. Develop & manage aircraft system requirements, design, & architecture. Perform requirement validation to ensure compliance with regulatory standards & certification criteria for aircraft systems. Perform Development Review (DR) audits with suppliers & internal systems engineering teams to ensure alignment with technical requirements & certification standards. Collaborate with Engineering Authorized Representative to conduct DR audits, including Aircraft Development Review, System Development Review, & Supplier System Development Review audits, ensuring compliance with certification & program requirements. Perform system-level analysis, compliance evaluations, & risk assessments. Select appropriate methods, techniques, & evaluation criteria to resolve complex engineering issues. Create & maintain Aircraft Development Plans, Requirement Management Plans, Verification & Validation Plans, Process Assurance Plans, & Configuration Management Plans. Author development assurance sections of aircraft & system certification plans to align with system engineering design intent with regulations. Perform Process Assurance activities in accordance with system engineering/ARP4754A/B guidelines. Actively contribute to Problem Report Review Board & Change Control Board by evaluating reported issues & proposed changes, assessing impact on aircraft & system functionality, safety, & compliance, & supporting decision-making for corrective actions & updates. Create & maintain job aids for DR audits aligned with certification standards & ARP4754A/B guidelines to support consistent & compliant audit execution. Support complex hardware (DO-254)/software (DO-178B/C) integration & verification activities. Collaborate with all critical systems on aircraft to ensure system integration & compatibility, including Avionics, Flight Controls, Powerplant, Electrical System, Software, & Data Concentration & Network Engineering teams. Interface with suppliers & customers to define system specs & resolve technical issues. Develop & support model-based systems engineering capability for various aircraft systems in MATLAB System Composer. Ensure adherence to industry & regulatory standards throughout system development lifecycle, including ARP4754A/B, ARP4761A, DO-178B/C, AC 20-189, & SAE/RTCA/EUROCAE. Prepare, review & submit audit reports & other documentation to regulatory agencies. Anticipate & resolve complex issues creatively & effectively, developing standards & guidelines for diverse system engineering activities. Continuously improve existing systems engineering processes & promote adoption across future projects & programs. Establish & maintain open communication channels with aircraft system owners & management to ensure processes are clearly understood & followed in alignment with program objectives. Set up & manage requirements databases using tools such as IBM DOORS, Siemens Teamcenter, & MATLAB ensuring alignment with program needs & systems engineering guidelines. Support periodic assessments of aircraft systems to verify compliance with requirements management processes & ensure development assurance. Collaborate on development & integration of new technologies to drive Continuous Improvement (CI) in systems engineering practices. Develop & maintain standards & guidelines for systems engineering processes & methodologies. Define specific milestones & deliverables that integrate seamlessly with overall program plans & schedules. Maintain current knowledge of developments in field of specialty &/or other related aircraft fields to recommend innovations to improve quality & effectiveness of products. Perform additional responsibilities as assigned to support organizational goals & project needs.

REQUIREMENTS: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Science and Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field required. Ten years of experience in aircraft embedded systems required; including any experience with: systems engineering principles including Requirements Management, Validation, Verification, Change Management, Process Assurance and Functional Integration; conducting and/or participating in ARP4754A/B Development Review (DR) audits; the FAA/EASA certification process; MATLAB and systems modeling techniques; programming languages including C, C++, Python, UML, Assembly, ADA, TCL, VBS, and GRP; and with development and debugging tools for embedded system development (i.e., IBM DOORS/DOORS NextGen, Siemens Teamcenter, S32 Design Studio, Jira, DevOps, Eclipse, Visual Studio, MATLAB, CAN Analyzer, Wind River, LDRA, and RTRT). In lieu of a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Science and Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field and ten years of experience, Employer will accept a Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Science and Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field and eight years of the above-requested experience or a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Information Science and Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field and six years of the above-requested experience. Must have legal authority to work in the U.S. EEOE.

Resume to: Franklin D. Mayers, Jr., Director, People Mobility, Gulfstream Aerospace Corp., 30 Innovation Drive, Mailstop D-03, Savannah, GA 31407 or to people.mobility@gulfstream.com. Please reference VC25 + job title in cover letter or subject line.

Education and Experience Requirements

Bachelor's Degree in engineering or technical related curriculum applicable to the respective job position required or equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. 10 yrs in specific technical discipline or 15 yrs broad eng experience in several technical disciplines with Bachelors. Experience credit considered for related adv degrees limited to 2 yrs for Masters and 4 yrs for PhD in fields applicable to this job.

Position Purpose:

Guides successful completion of major engineering programs, or conceives research in areas of considerable scope and complexity supporting the development and production of Gulfstream products and services

Job Description

Principle Duties and Responsibilities:

Essential Functions:
  1. Selects appropriate methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria to resolve complex engineering issues .

  2. Is consulted extensively by associates and others as a recognized authority within the field .

  3. Anticipates and resolves complex issues in creative and effective ways, developing standards and guides for diverse engineering activities .

  4. Approach to problem solving balances technical product, cost and schedule .

  5. Works without appreciable direction; work is reviewed from a long-range perspective for desired results .

  6. Exercises latitude in determining technical objectives of assignments, and makes decisions and recommendations that are recognized as authoritative .

Additional Functions:
  1. Maintains a current knowledge of developments in the field of specialty and/or other related aircraft fields in order to recommend innovations to improve quality and effectiveness of company product .

Perform other duties as assigned.

Other Requirements:
  1. Advanced degree in engineering, or related curriculum preferred.

  2. The level of technical skill and abilities appropriate for this grade will be established by each discipline.
This job requires one to be able to read, write, speak, and understand the English language.

title: Senior Auditor, Office of Audit and Compliance - UT System Administration
description:
The Senior Auditor manages projects and leads project teams of professional staff to conduct audits, consulting projects, investigations, and other projects that provide objective and independent evaluations to reduce the university’s risk and improve its operations. The purposes of these projects are generally to determine: effectiveness of operational policies and procedures; efficiency of operations; compliance with internal policies or external regulations; or existence of fraud, waste, or abuse. Occasionally, the Senior Auditor will conduct projects autonomously or join with project teams to perform duties as assigned by the project’s in-charge or supervisor.

POSITION IS LOCATED IN CHATTANOOGA, TN

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Project Planning and Management

Develops or oversees development of project plans to achieve objectives, including all areas of the unit’s operations to be examined, the data and information to be gathered, and the methods of data/information gathering to be used. Conducts or oversees risk analyses to define the project objectives, scope, and methodologies. The risk analyses considers the financial, operational, compliance, and/or strategic risks associated with an organizational unit’s operations. Coordinates the work of other team members. Provides needed guidance and instruction to other team members. Assigns work, monitors time budgets and target dates for team member assignments, and monitors project budget and deadlines. Informs supervisor, when applicable, about status of the audit work performed, potential issues and solutions, and client feedback.

Fieldwork Execution and Documentation

Collects and analyzes appropriate types of information, data, and evidence to achieve the objectives of project steps by 1.) Compiling data from the university’s information systems and other sources internal and external to the university, 2.) Applying appropriate sampling techniques, 3.) Collecting documents, 4.) Observing processes and controls, 5.) Preparing for and conducting interviews, 6.) Using questionnaires and surveys 7.) Utilizing data analytics or other methodologies, as needed

Prepares thorough, well-organized, and self-explanatory work papers to support conclusions reached and demonstrate achievement of objectives.

Quality Assurance and Improvement Activities

Provides first or final review of work papers generated by other team members. Reviews reports drafted by other team members to ensure reports are clear, concise, and convey needed information. Evaluates the effectiveness of the audit process at the conclusion of each project. Provides formal feedback to team members at the end of projects. Participates in long-range planning, development of audit tools, and improvements to office practices.

Issue Identification and Resolution

Analyzes data and information gathered or oversees analysis to identify issues, such as ineffectiveness of policies and procedures in addressing risks, areas of noncompliance, inefficiencies of operations, or evidence of fraudulent acts. Identifies potential solutions for significant issues that address any deficiencies or offer operational improvements, ensuring the solutions are cost-effective and feasible to implement.

Client Communication and Audit Reporting

Negotiates with audit clients to arrive at sound/effective recommendations. Apprises client of project status, barriers to progress, and potential issues. Leads entrance and exit conferences. Drafts project reports or reviews reports drafted by team members. Evaluates client’s written responses to recommendations. Clearly conveys information and ideas in a manner that engages the listener or reader, helps them understand and retain the message, and invites response and feedback. Composes and/or modifies communication depending on the targeted audience.

Bachelor's degree in accounting or other relevant field and more than two years experience in internal auditing, information systems auditing, consulting, investigations, or other applicable experience which involves evaluating controls over business processes, the efficiency and effectiveness of operations, and compliance with policies/regulations/laws. Experience developing project plans to achieve risk-based project objectives in a complex environment. Professional certification required, such as CIA, CPA, CISA, CFE, etc.

Additional required qualifications include:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Knowledge of current internal audit philosophy and practices, including knowledge of internal control testing techniques
  • Skill in preparing clear and concise workpapers and comprehensive reports, interpreting and applying policies and regulations, and conducting interviews
  • Ability to organize work; to conceptualize and prioritize objectives; to evaluate evidence; and to exercise independent judgment based on University of Tennessee policies and regulations
  • Ability to coach, motivate, and provide performance feedback to team members
  • Knowledge and awareness of necessity to maintain confidentiality and objectivity
  • Ability to maintain a sense of urgency in approaching internal audit responsibilities
  • Competent in Microsoft Office Word and Excel and ability to use other audit software
  • Ability to handle multiple ongoing projects and independently establish priorities to meet deadlines
  • Ability to exercise independent and mature professional judgment when evaluating audit evidence and formulating recommendations

Preferred

Master's degree and experience leading audit teams, reviewing work papers, and managing multiple ongoing projects. Experience in an internal audit function. Experience with data analytics tools. Experience auditing in higher education or working in an administrative role in higher education. Supervisory and project management experience.

Additional preferred qualificators included:

  • Ability to determine team priorities and allocate time and resources effectively.
  • Knowledge of administrative operations of a higher education institution.
  • Competency in data analysis software. Familiarity with rules and regulations involving externally sponsored research.

title: Apple TV Social Lead, Sports
description:
As a part of the broader Apple TV Marketing Organization, our team’s purpose is to build big word of mouth, conversation, fandoms, and love for our brand, titles, sports, and talent. This role owns social strategy and social creative development across the Apple Sports slate: Formula 1, MLS, and MLB Friday Night Baseball. You are embedded in cross-functional sports marketing teams as the social authority, responsible for developing and driving campaigns that build deep fandoms, earn cultural conversation, bring audiences to Apple TV to watch live, and deliver real business impact.

You are an extraordinary leader who is highly plugged into the internet and popular culture. You keep your finger on the pulse of conversation across the full scope of the sports world, from race weekends and match days to the fan communities, athletes, and creators who drive the culture around them. You know what it means to listen, participate, and spark thoughtful discussions with fans. You move seamlessly between crafting strategies for broad viewership as well as targeted, passionate fan audiences. You are a storyteller and creative with a cutting-edge understanding of internet culture, memes, and zeitgeist content who can also demonstrate real ROI. You have a passion for and knowledge of the sports landscape, and the unique social marketing approaches that fuel it, from live-moment content to long-form fandom building. You are a driven, proactive self-starter who executes and elevates work. This role builds upon briefs, evolves ideas, and takes full strategic and creative ownership of campaigns from concept through completion. You balance conviction with humility, aren’t afraid to both lead and follow, and bring a team-first mindset to everything you do.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in social media, entertainment, sports, or big consumer brand marketing, with a strong track record of developing and driving world-class campaigns with big impact across reach, engagement, and cultural conversation
  • Fluent in social media best practices. You know what content, creative, and formats work across platforms, have experience in multi-channel distribution, and proactively develop a point of view on platform evolution and optimization
  • Strong command of social analytics and publishing tools. You use data and intuition together to make smart content decisions and iterate toward creative and strategic excellence
  • Deep expertise in sports marketing and fan culture, including the live-event, real-time, and rights-holder considerations unique to sports content

Preferred Qualifications

  • A storyteller and creative with a cutting-edge understanding of internet culture, meme ecosystems, and zeitgeist content, and the ability to connect that instinct to real ROI
  • Experience leading social marketing for sports properties, leagues, or live sports programming at a streaming service, studio, broadcaster, or league
  • Clear, effective communicator and strong creative collaborator. You pitch with conviction and clarity, read the room, balance confidence with humility, and bring peers and stakeholders along on the journey
  • Highly driven self-starter with an excellent sense of prioritization and the ability to move large amounts of work forward in a fast-paced, fluid environment
  • Experience working directly with talent, athletes, creators, and league and team partners. You bring the right creative energy and the right level of professionalism and discretion to those relationships
  • Adept at taking accountability without having direct control and using influence without authority
  • Cross-functionally excellent. You build strong, trusted relationships and work effectively across a highly matrixed marketing organization
  • Demonstrates learning agility and embraces change, evolving alongside the organization and the platforms

title: Mgr, Materials
description:
The group you’ll be a part of

At Lam Research, the Pilot Factory Support SPOC team is part of the Pilot Purchasing organization. This group actively manages component shortages for Pilot Manufacturing; working with Buyers, Expeditors, Logistics, Order Fulfillment, Supply Chain, Pilot Manufacturing and Suppliers to mitigate component shortages and issues. They help Lam deliver industry-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam’s business.

The impact you’ll make

As a Pilot Factory Support SPOC Manager, you will serve as a crucial link between pilot manufacturing, order fulfillment and pilot purchasing departments. Your role involves consistent interaction with all sectors to minimize shipment shortages and risks. This is achieved by managing the Pilot FST SPOC team and in ensuring solutions to component shortages. This position offers a unique opportunity to gain experience in Supply Chain Management while maintaining an understanding of manufacturing and purchasing operations. Your contributions will be pivotal in enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of our operations.

What you’ll do

  • Managing a team of Pilot FST SPOCs that are actively participating in Pilot Manufacturing CFT material shortage meetings. The Pilot FST SPOC Manager will attend the primary shortage meetings and be the first escalation point for their team.
  • The candidates most successful in this role have management experience and are self-starters, that can thrive both independently day-to-day and as a part of collaborative teams as they are a vital part of expediting material to meet manufacturing and customer delivery dates.
  • Analyzing Data: This position requires analyzing data in SAP and internal shortage tools to identify, validate, mitigate, and roll up material risk.
  • Supporting Pilot Manufacturing and Delivery: Support expediting key material to meet manufacturing and customer delivery dates. The person will act as an interface to cross-functional teams consisting of manufacturing, order fulfillment, logistics, and engineering to ensure the manufacturing production and customer delivery are met.
  • Risk Management: The pivotal function of this job is managing the activity of the Pilot FST SPOCs, identifying material shortages and escalating shipment risks.
  • Collaboration: Requires collaboration with Global Operations team consisting of Buyers, Expeditors, Supplier Business Managers, Manufacturing, Engineering, and leadership to find all possible solutions to mitigate material allocation priority. Develop and deliver clear and concise communications for leadership teams and stakeholders.
  • Develop and monitor risk mitigation strategies and coordinate root cause corrective actions.
  • Lead and participate in projects to resolve problems or to support continuous process improvement.
  • Run departmental meetings with direct reports to identify support that is needed and manage the continuous improvement tracker.
  • Develop timely reports and key performance indicators to identify/monitor material delivery challenges.

Who we’re looking for

  • Proficient in MS Excel and other standard Office programs (i.e. Outlook, Team, Word, etc.)
  • Excellent communication (verbal and written) and negotiation skills
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail
  • Ability to lead and manage the Pilot FST SPOCs
  • Strong management skills; mentoring, writing procedures, providing clear direction for the team
  • Possess a robust comprehension of purchasing and manufacturing operations and processes
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in the field of Supply Chain, manufacturing or related discipline, and a combination of both preferred
  • Minimum 5 years’ purchasing experience
  • Minimum 3 years’ SAP experience
  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in managing people

Preferred qualifications

  • BA, BS/BSE level degree in business, supply chain, engineering, materials science, logistics or related technical discipline
  • Experience as escalation level/single contact person for multiple commodities material shortages
  • Understanding of purchasing and planning
  • Experience in chairing meetings with attendees located in different countries and at different levels of the organization, including executives

This posting is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and responsibilities but constitutes a general definition of the scope and function of the position.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

title: Manufacturing Lab Systems Engineer - Data Center Hardware
description:
As a Manufacturing Lab Systems Engineer, you will support critical test environments at Apple's Taiwan manufacturing facility for our new product introduction (NPI) development process. You will own the cross-functional lab environment that serves as the on-ramp for silicon validation, software, hardware test, and reliability teams to access newly produced systems weeks ahead of deployment to our U.S.-based hardware labs.

Working closely with in-region EE teams, you will debug, triage, and manage newly manufactured hardware deployed in these labs, while coordinating with U.S.-based Lab Engineering and Systems EE teams to support remote lab access. This role demands equal parts technical depth and operational ownership -- grounded in systems engineering with electrical, software, and integration experience -- with teams counting on you across every time zone. Come join us!

Leveraging your expertise in server platforms and electrical engineering, you will work closely with the in-region System Electrical Engineering team on debugging and triaging hardware issues, serving as the on-site directly responsible individual (DRI) for the labs at this facility. You will be the execution arm for NPI programs, coordinating with our CM partner to move assets from the manufacturing line into lab environments under the direction of the System EPM. This requires hands-on ability to lead root cause analysis, rework, and change management with in-region teams.

You will coordinate and track the movement of factory servers from the manufacturing line to all lab environments, partnering with U.S.-based System EPMs and in-region team members spanning software, reliability, diagnostics, test, and EE.

This is a highly collaborative role requiring partnership with cross-functional organizations, including U.S.-based teams in Hardware Engineering, Reliability, Software, Test, Validation, Thermal, Product Design, Diagnostics, and Engineering Program Management.

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, CS, or equivalent practical experience
  • 4-8 years in systems engineering, hardware integration, or manufacturing engineering in a server or HPC environment
  • Demonstrate capability in circuit and ARM system architecture, schematic, layout, BOM analysis
  • Technical knowledges in low/high speed signal protocols
  • Experience in I2C, USB, PCIE, Ethernet failure analysis
  • Hands-on experience with SOC troubleshooting, board-level debug/diagnostics, firmware, low- and high-speed system interconnects, and power management and distribution
  • Demonstrated ownership of a lab or production hardware environment: asset tracking, configuration management, and system disposition
  • Experience directing CM or vendor teams in a manufacturing or lab environment
  • Ability to operate effectively across time zones in a globally distributed, matrixed organization
  • On-site at Taiwan manufacturing facility as primary work location
  • Written and verbal communication fluency in English and Mandarin

Preferred Qualifications

  • M.S. degree with a minimum of 3-5 years of experience
  • NPI experience on data center server hardware, custom ASICs and SOCs, or high-density server environments
  • AI Scripting or automation skills (Python, Bash) applied to asset management, system monitoring, or lab tooling
  • High-touch lab or early-access hardware environment experience
  • Experience troubleshooting elusive issues that manifest as software problems but originate in server hardware or firmware, including debugging interactions between high-speed buses, firmware, and OS behavior
