title: Medical Liaison -Sickle Cell Disease / Hemoglobinopathies   - South Central
description:
About the Department

The Clinical, Medical and Regulatory (CMR) department at Novo Nordisk is one of the most diverse and collaborative groups within the organization. From healthcare provider interactions and developing and implementing regulatory strategies with the FDA to providing medical education and collecting data to support efficacy and new product development, CMR is involved. The one thing that keeps us all marching to the same beat is our patient centered focus. At Novo Nordisk, you will help patients around the world. As their needs evolve, so does our challenge to find better and more innovative ways to improve their quality of life. We’re changing lives for a living. Are you ready to make a difference?

The Position

Builds relationships with HCPs and demonstrates the clinical outcomes of NNI Hemoglobinopathies portfolio. Educates and demonstrates the safety and efficacy of key products to HCPs. Provides medical information and coordinates educational workshops, round tables, medical forums, etc.. May explore and identify sites for clinical trials in all stages of development. Incumbents have a deep scientific and clinical education and experience. Within Field Medical Affairs, this position functions as a scientific liaison between NNI and key external customers to further scientific exchange. S/he provides advanced product and scientific and medical field support to Medical, Sales and Marketing, as well as Managed Care and Government by using academic/professional credentials and scientific expertise to communicate with health care providers, organized providers/accounts and other relevant healthcare organizations. Strategic determination of change of territory prioritization will be based on customer need and analytics which identify need for change. This may occur at any time throughout the annual performance cycle. Develops and maintains medical (territory and account) plans in coordination with his/her Field Director.

Relationships

Position reports to Field Director/Sr Field Director. Serves as organization spokesperson on advanced medical and technical projects with the ML teams, Clinicians, Marketing, Market Access & Government and Sales personnel. External relationships include key opinion leaders (KOL’s), academic institutions, physicians, nurse practitioners, diabetes educators, pharmacists, blood bank staff, organized providers/IDNs and MCOs as needed based on territory archetypes.

Essential Functions

  • Administrative Duties:
    • Completes administrative duties in an accurate manner and on a timely basis, in line with current SOPs and working practices
    • Complies with all guidelines, policies, legal, regulatory and compliance requirements
    • Ensures effective administrative management of regional business as well as operational budgets
    • Maintains thorough understanding of all relevant Novo Nordisk processes and procedures and proactively assists other FMA members to further their understanding with these as needed
    • Provides monthly reports on scientific support activities in region to Director including budget expenditures as directed
    • Records all activities within a customer response management system (e.g. VEEVA) and all expenses within Concur in accordance with FMA procedures
  • Advocacy & Professional Relationship Development:
    • Attends assigned medical and scientific meetings: a) ensures and maintains awareness of current issues and new data pertaining to NNI products; b) develops and maintains relationships with key health care providers and IHNs; c) develops appropriate use of NNI products and greater utilization of its services d) supports and assists representatives and managers in answering questions from health care providers and IHNs
    • Combines account management skills, business acumen and scientific expertise to enhance value and develop collaborative relationships
    • Establishes the medical account strategy/plan through the identification and cultivation of key relationships and brings forth appropriate collaboration opportunities
  • Field-Based Clinical Support:
    • Collaborates with Health Economics & Outcomes Research (HEOR) team to deliver scientific value proposition of NNI’s products and devices to key customers and formulary decision makers. Delivers HEOR presentations upon request
    • Collaborates with Marketing and Sales management to inform the development of scientific strategies to optimize NNI’s products and development activities in the medical community
    • Collaborates with trial/study investigation sites; ensuring effective coordination and facilitation of studies to ensure timely review, initiation and completion, as well as publication of study results. Provides clinical support in cooperation with other Novo Nordisk groups to ensure investigators demonstrate appropriate knowledge of studies, support patient recruitment and retention activities, answers responsive requests from investigators and provides feedback to sites to other groups
    • Coordinates and collaborates with regional FMA team members to ensure integrated comprehensive coverage of regional clinical and scientific needs
    • Coordinates with key internal stakeholders to provide customized and dedicated system-wide clinical education and support within respective IHNs and coordinate and manage professional relations of Novo Nordisk within these Networks from an overall “account management” level
    • Coordinates with respective HSM to provide scientific and clinical education to Chief Executives, Medical Directors and formulary stakeholders to secure proper access to NNI’s products and services in respective IHNs
    • Develops and presents product and scientific updates as requested, including Formulary presentations within IHNs, using approved material

Physical Requirements

• 50-75% overnight travel required.
• The territory for this position is: LA, AR, OK.
• Position is Field Based and the ideal candidate must live within the territory or in a bordering state located near a major airport.
• Driver must maintain a valid driver’s license. Must be in good standing by not exceeding the Novo Nordisk points threshold assigned based on review of Motor Vehicle Records.

Qualifications

  • Doctoral degree required
  • At least two years’ experience in a health-related system, pharmaceutical company, or managed care environment required
  • Relevant clinical and/or therapeutic experience preferred
  • Displays business acumen/knowledge based on experiences such as participation in formulary process decisions
  • Extensive experience in diabetes strongly preferred
  • Strong communication skills

This position is part of a job family. Title and level within the job family are evaluated based on a number of factors, such as years of experience, scope of work, proficiency, and business need. Candidates will be assessed for the most appropriate title and level within the job family during the recruitment process. The base range of pay for each title in this job family are as follows:

• Medical Liaison - $170,000 to $215,000
• Senior Medical Liaison - $198,000 to $245,000

In addition, this position is eligible for a company bonus based on individual and company performance. Novo Nordisk offers long-term incentive compensation and or company vehicles depending on the position's level or other company factors.

Employees are also eligible to participate in Company employee benefit programs including medical, dental and vision coverage; life insurance; disability insurance; 401(k) savings plan; flexible spending accounts; employee assistance program; tuition reimbursement program; and voluntary benefits such as group legal, critical illness, identity theft protection, pet insurance and auto/home insurance. title: Lead Frontend Engineer
description:
About FormPhil

FormPhil is part of CORTO, a cutting-edge software company dedicated to revolutionising the legal industry. Our mission is to empower legal practitioners with AI-driven solutions that streamline their workflow, boost productivity, and provide more efficient client service. Working alongside our Sydney-based team of passionate high achievers, you’ll join a fast-growing technology business where things rarely stay the same for long - and if you’re smart, caring, and ambitious, you’ll be in great company.

AI is transforming the legal industry and CORTO is at the forefront of this change. There is a huge opportunity for law firms to save time, money and to add more value to their client base. This is where FormPhil comes in. FormPhil is a startup product transforming the way legal work is done to unlock new value for law firms and their clients. We will be utilising our in-house expertise and the power of AI to save hours of work and transform the way law firms provide access to legal justice.

Our goal is to automate the filling in of any legal form in the world. We’ll start by integrating seamlessly with LEAP Legal Software’s ecosystem, then the rest of ATI’s well-known platforms (Infotrack, Smokeball etc).

About the role

We’re looking for a hands-on lead front-end developer who is able to take the Figma designs from the team, understand the requirements, interact and give the designer feedback and them bring the designs to life by combining an eye for responsive design, a clear understanding of what makes software enjoyable to use, and strong front-end engineering skills.

Working within FormPhil team, as a part of CORTO, in ATI, one of the world’s largest legal technology companies, you’ll partner closely with our UX/UI Lead and full-stack developers to turn functional interfaces into polished, usable, intuitive user experiences.

You’ll contribute ideas, explore alternative approaches, and bring thoughtful details to the finished product, from the way an interaction responds to how an application guides users through a complex task. You’ll understand the intent behind a design and know how to carry that intent through to a working application.

How you’ll work with the team

For cross-functional features, our full-stack developers will typically build the backend and an initial frontend implementation. You’ll take that implementation further: refining the interface, improving interactions, strengthening the frontend code, and ensuring the experience feels cohesive and complete.

You’ll also collaborate early with the UX/UI Lead and developers to shape interactions, identify reusable patterns, and resolve design and technical questions before they become rework.

This is a hands-on engineering role with responsibility for both the quality of the interface and the code behind it.

﻿

What you’ll do

  • Partner with the UX/UI Lead. Understand the user problem and design intent, contribute fresh ideas, and help explore what is possible. Discuss trade-offs constructively and suggest improvements that make the product clearer, simpler, and easier to use.
  • Bring designs to life. Translate Figma designs into high-quality React interfaces, with careful attention to layout, typography, spacing, responsive behaviour, and interaction details. Use subtle transitions and feedback where they make the experience more useful.
  • Complete the experience beyond the design. Identify and resolve gaps between static designs and a working application, including loading, empty, error, validation, focus, and disabled states. Exercise sound judgement and collaborate with the UX/UI Lead where decisions need further design input.
  • Elevate frontend implementations. Work alongside full-stack developers to refine initial implementations into production-ready experiences. Improve component structure, state handling, usability, and consistency while preserving the functionality and business requirements of the feature.
  • Build reusable components and patterns. Develop and maintain shared component libraries and frontend conventions. Make common interactions easy to implement consistently, document their use, and help the wider engineering team adopt them.
  • Improve performance and reliability. Identify and address slow loading, unnecessary rendering, and unresponsive interactions. Write maintainable, tested code, participate in code reviews, and build accessibility and cross-browser reliability into the implementation.

﻿

What you’ll bring

  • Strong visual and interaction judgement. You notice when spacing, hierarchy, feedback, or behaviour feels wrong, and can explain how to improve it. You understand that good user experience is about clarity, predictability, and ease of use as much as appearance.
  • Experience working closely with designers. You’re comfortable interpreting Figma designs, discussing design intent, prototyping ideas, and resolving the details that only become apparent during implementation.
  • Strong React and TypeScript skills, supported by a solid understanding of JavaScript, semantic HTML, CSS, and modern frontend frameworks and tooling. You can build and maintain substantial applications, not just isolated screens.
  • Sound frontend engineering practices. You have experience with reusable components, application state, API integration, responsive design, accessibility, testing, and performance optimisation. You can improve existing code without introducing unnecessary complexity.
  • A proactive, collaborative approach. You raise issues, propose solutions, and follow through. You’re comfortable refining another developer’s implementation, giving and receiving constructive feedback, and sharing ownership of the finished product.

title: CC Rotating Equipment Engineer
description:
CITGO PETROLEUM CORPORATION

CITGO Petroleum Corporation is a recognized leader in the refining industry and operates under the well-known CITGO brand. CITGO owns and operates three refineries located in Lake Charles, LA.; Lemont, IL.; and Corpus Christi, TX, and wholly and/or jointly owns 43 active terminals, nine pipelines and three lubricants blending and packaging plants. With approximately 3,300 employees and a combined crude capacity of approximately 829,000 barrels-per-day (bpd), positions CITGO as one of the best-branded supplier companies in the industry.

At CITGO our people are our most important resource. Our core values are Safety, Integrity, Respect, Accountability, and Care.

Job Summary

CITGO Corpus Christi Refinery is seeking Rotating Equipment Engineers to join our Reliability department. The Rotating Equipment Engineer position provides technical expertise and recommendations for rotating equipment mechanical integrity, repairs, and reliability improvements. Responsible for maintaining the safe operation and reliability of the refinery rotating equipment by applying standard engineering principles, theories, concepts, and techniques in providing solutions to a variety of rotating equipment problems that develop during operation, maintenance repair and/or turnarounds, as well as performing root cause failure analysis in order to make recommendations for equipment that will eliminate the causes for equipment unreliability. This position collaborates closely with the Inspection, Maintenance, Operations, Turnaround, and Capital Projects teams to ensure the safe, compliant, and reliable operation of the refinery. This is an on-site position based at the CITGO Refinery in Corpus Christi, Texas.

Minimum Qualifications

    • Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or other related engineering degree with one year or more of job-related experience.
    • Familiarity with relevant industrial standards related to rotating equipment and monitoring equipment/system (ASME, API, PIP, ANSI)
    • Practical knowledge of API standards and industry best practices
    • Ability to manage assigned projects under limited supervision.
    • Microsoft Office proficiency.
    • Valid Driver's License.
    • Ability to obtain a TWIC (Transportation Worker's Identification Credential).

Preferred:

    • Five years or more of direct experience working as a Rotating Equipment Engineer in a refinery or petrochemical plant.
    • Vibration Analysis Level II Certification
    • Familiarity or experience with API 610 and 682 for centrifugal pumps and mechanical seals
    • Experience with performing RCA
    • Experience applying Cause Mapping Technique
    • Familiarity or experience with SAP
    • Familiarity or experience with standard for critical equipment repairs, and monitoring

Job Duties

  • Provide rotating equipment engineering reliability support to refinery operations and maintenance for the purpose of improving safety, environmental compliance, mechanical availability and reducing long-term maintenance costs.
  • Provide rotating equipment maintenance support to refinery operations and maintenance to plan, schedule, troubleshoot and repair rotating and reciprocating equipment in accordance with industry accepted practices.
  • Utilize condition monitoring tools such as vibration, oil analysis, and operational data for recommending corrective actions, in addition to performing failure analysis of equipment.
  • Develop and implement ideas, initiatives, and programs to improve unit performance, increase equipment reliability/availability, and reduce rotating equipment maintenance costs.
  • Utilize API standards and Industry Best Practices for analysis and recommendations.
  • Analyze and determine appropriate spare parts and quantity for Rotating Equipment.
  • Support and mentor less experienced Rotating Equipment engineers.
  • Some travel may be required for training and surveillance inspection/witnessing. It may involve traveling to other states or outside the United States.

description:
PROPERTY MANAGER – LEAD THE WAY HOME

Are you a natural leader with a passion for people, performance, and properties that shine? If you know how to turn a building into a community and a team into a high-performing force, we want to meet you.

As a Property Manager at Two Coast Living, you’ll be at the helm of one of our multifamily communities, leading daily operations, managing on-site teams, and delivering an exceptional living experience for residents. You’ll own the numbers, the experience, and the culture, all while driving occupancy, resident satisfaction, and revenue.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Run the Show – Oversee all day-to-day operations, from leasing and resident relations to work orders and vendor coordination.

  • Market Like a Pro – Work with your team and marketing partners to promote your property, attract new residents, and renew existing leases.
  • Drive Financial Performance – Manage budgets, control expenses, maximize revenue, and ensure rent collection stays on track.
  • Be Resident-Focused – Serve as the go-to contact for your community, resolving concerns, welcoming new residents, and creating a place people are proud to call home.
  • Keep It Looking Great – Conduct regular property inspections, support unit readiness, and oversee maintenance standards and capital improvements.
  • Stay on Top of It All – Submit accurate financial reports, manage payroll/commissions, and stay compliant with all local, state, and federal requirements.
  • Stay Plugged In – Engage with your local apartment association, keep up with competitors, and build a strong reputation in the community.

What We Offer:

  • A Leadership Role That Matters – Step into a full-time, on-site leadership position with visibility and impact.
  • Top-Tier Benefits – Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, plus a 401(k) plan with auto-enrollment after 60 days.
  • Time to Recharge – 40 hours of vacation in your first year, plus paid sick leave (based on location) and paid holidays.*
  • Tools to Succeed – Training, support, and technology to help you and your team thrive.
  • A Team That Has Your Back – Collaborate with supportive regional leaders and cross-functional teams across the company.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Experienced Leader – You’ve got at least 4 years of multifamily property management experience and 2+ years leading a team.
  • Detail-Obsessed & Organized – You stay on top of deadlines, follow through on commitments, and know how to prioritize.
  • Clear Communicator – Whether it's a resident concern, a staff meeting, or a budget presentation, you keep it clear, calm, and professional.
  • Customer-Focused – Residents feel heard, valued, and supported because of you.
  • Financially Savvy – You understand the business side: rent rolls, budgets, reporting, and expense management.
  • Tech-Comfortable – You’re confident using property management systems (i.e., Entrata), Microsoft Office, and digital tools that keep things running smoothly.
  • Positive & Proactive – You lead by example, stay cool under pressure, and bring solutions, not drama.

This is a full-time leadership role based on-site at one of our beautiful communities. If you’re ready to lead with heart, hustle, and know-how, we’re ready for you. Bring your experience, your standards, and your drive, and let’s build something great together.

Apply now and help us make coming home the best part of someone’s day.

title: Financial Services - Technology Consulting - Product Designer - Senior - NYC
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

EY is a leader in serving the global financial services marketplace and the only professional services firm with a separate business unit dedicated to the financial services industry – the Financial Services Organization (FSO). Our focused model and bold ambition have put us at the center of the events that continue to reshape and redefine our industry, working side by side with a range of clients from our most venerable institutions to dynamic new entrants across Banking and Capital Markets, Wealth and Asset Management, Insurance, and Real Estate, Hospitality and Construction. Our purpose is to help build a financial services industry in which financial institutions are trusted and flourish, and the global economy is healthy, growing, and secure. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve complex challenges, then join our dynamic FSO team!

The opportunity

The Product and Experience Design (PxD) Team, part of the Platforms competency within FSO Technology Consulting, works collaboratively with clients to transform their businesses through disruptive innovation and human-centered design. Our designers, researchers, technologists and strategists work together to create superior apps, websites and software, supported by research, brand strategy, and a clear understanding of business and user needs.

Our clients are at different points in their AI adoption journey, but we design AI first. Our work starts in an LLM, moves quickly into prototypes, and lands in Figma for systems and polish. We also design the AI-enabled and agentic experiences our clients are bringing to market.

We’re looking for a talented and collaborative Senior Product Designer who loves working with and learning from a multidisciplinary team, creates exceptional experiences, and excels at communicating with clients.

Your key responsibilities

As a Senior Product Designer, you are the design lead for a workstream. You work within a multidisciplinary team of researchers, technologists, product managers, and engagement team members. You own the design of a workstream end to end, from framing the problem with the client to writing specifications engineers can build from. You are the designer the client works with day to day, and you mentor junior designers. You use AI to move faster through framing, options, prototypes and synthesis, and stay accountable for every decision that reaches a client. Outside client engagements, you have experience supporting business development activities, such as pursuits and proposals, and practice-building activities such as mentoring colleagues and developing or delivering training.

Skills and attributes for success

  • AI-first design craft: Take work from research, problem framing, user flows and high-fidelity design to production-ready Figma files with end-to-end coverage. Use LLMs and AI-assisted prototyping tools such as Claude, Cursor or Figma Make to frame problems, generate first-pass options, build live-coded prototypes, iterate collaboratively with users and stakeholders, and speed up synthesis. Judgment stays with you: decide which problem is worth solving, which option is right and why, and review everything for accuracy, accessibility, bias and brand before a client sees it.
  • Designing AI-enabled and agentic experiences: Design how people hand work to an AI or agentic system, supervise it, and check and correct what it produces. Design how they decide whether to trust it with a financial decision. Treat uncertainty, confidence, error, correction and handoff as states that need designing. Do not simply add a chat window to an existing flow. Build explainability, transparency and human-in-the-loop control into the design from the start, and know when to bring risk, compliance or technology owners into the conversation.
  • Design systems: Leverage, contribute to, and evolve client design systems and brand guidelines.
  • Complexity: Design data-heavy, role-based experiences that are used by various client internal and external teams.
  • Agile delivery and collaboration: Deliver in Agile teams using Jira and other collaborative software platforms. Write clear specifications and acceptance criteria, and flex into requirements of definition when delivery demands it.
  • Research, evidence, and outcomes: Run lean research to keep work moving. Drive consensus on success measures with product owners and client stakeholders. Follow how features actually perform in use and propose improvement ideas, as necessary.
  • Client communication: Own the day-to-day client relationship for your workstream. Present clearly to engineers, product owners, and senior business stakeholders. Adjust the level without diluting the argument and taking challenges and feedback well.
  • Making the case for design: Explain to client stakeholders and internal engagement teams why the design work is needed. Explain what it costs to skip it and what it returns. Use their language, especially with people who have not worked with designers before.
  • Meeting clients where they are: Assess a client’s design and technology maturity, then tailor your approach. That can range from foundational UX to AI-enabled products. Facilitate workshops and coaching client teams, so the work is sustainable after we leave.

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • Bachelor's degree in graphic design, UX Design, Interaction Design, Industrial or Product Design or related field, and 3 years of progressive, post-baccalaureate work experience. Alternatively, will accept a master's degree and 2 years of work experience.
  • A portfolio that shows end-to-end product design: problem framing, interaction design, visual craft and outcomes. Not only finished screens.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, including prototyping, components, and design system contribution.
  • Regular use of LLMs in your design process. Comfort working in AI-assisted design and prototyping tools such as Claude, Cursor or Figma Make, even if you do not write production code by hand.
  • Experience designing complex, data-heavy or workflow-driven products. Experience delivering in Agile teams using Jira or equivalent tool.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. The confidence to present and defend design decisions to senior client stakeholders. The ability to multitask in a fast-paced, collaborative team environment.
  • Requires domestic and regional travel up to 80% to serve client needs.

Ideally, you’ll also have

  • Experience in financial services: banking and capital markets, wealth and asset management, insurance, or real estate, hospitality and construction.
  • Experience designing AI-powered or agentic product features that reach production.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) as they affect design decisions.
  • Experience coaching client teams or building design capability in another organization.

What we look for

A designer who is as comfortable framing a problem with a client as finishing the screens. Someone who uses AI daily and can show how it changed their work, while staying accountable for every decision in it. Someone who can explain a design choice to an engineer, a product owner and a managing director, and adjust the level without diluting the argument.

What we offer you
At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at

  • We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $120,200 to $180,600
    • Bay Area California offices – $125,300 to $188,100
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $100,200 to $165,400

In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Job Summary

The Ultrasound Technologist performs high-quality diagnostic ultrasound examinations to assist physicians in the evaluation and treatment of patients. This role requires independent judgment, technical expertise, and a commitment to patient safety and comfort. The Ultrasound Technologist ensures all procedures are appropriately ordered, patient identification is verified, and imaging protocols are followed to produce accurate and reproducible results.

Essential Functions

  • Performs all ultrasound procedures independently, adhering to department protocols and ensuring high-quality, diagnostic imaging results.
  • Verifies patient identification and ensures the appropriate procedures are ordered and acknowledged prior to conducting imaging.
  • Recognizes and documents pathologies during scanning for interpretation by the radiologist, following established protocols.
  • Assumes responsibility for patient care, safety, and comfort during all imaging procedures.
  • Maintains a clean, safe, and organized work environment, ensuring compliance with safety and infection control guidelines.
  • Operates ultrasound equipment safely and effectively, following departmental policies and manufacturer guidelines.
  • Accurately documents imaging procedures and patient information in the electronic health record system, ensuring all associated documents are scanned into PACS for radiologist interpretation.
  • Monitors and maintains an adequate supply of imaging materials and coordinates inventory replenishment as needed.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • 1-3 years of clinical experience as an Ultrasound Technologist required
  • 2-4 years of clinical experience as an Ultrasound Technologist preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Proficiency in ultrasound imaging techniques and equipment operation.

title: Data Management Architect
description:

The Data Management Architect will support enterprise data management, ensuring data integrity, quality, governance & security using AIDP platform. Must Have Skills:

  • 10+ years experience.

Nice to Have Skills:

title: Regional Property Manager (48968)
description:
REGIONAL PROPERTY MANAGER – LEAD THE PEOPLE. DRIVE THE PORTFOLIO.

Are you an experienced multifamily leader who knows how to turn strategy into results? Do you know how to walk onto a property, quickly understand what's working—and what isn't—and build a plan to move it forward? If you love developing strong leaders, improving property performance, and taking ownership of results across an entire portfolio, we want to meet you.

As a Regional Property Manager at Two Coast Living, you'll lead a portfolio of multifamily communities and the teams behind them. You'll partner closely with Property Managers, Asset Management, and corporate leadership to drive financial and operational performance while ensuring our communities deliver an exceptional resident experience.

This isn't a desk job. You'll be present at your properties, developing your teams, understanding your markets, and making sure strategy translates into execution.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Lead the Portfolio – Oversee the operational and financial performance of multiple multifamily communities, ensuring each property is positioned to achieve its goals.

  • Develop Great Leaders – Coach, mentor, and hold Property Managers accountable while building strong, high-performing teams throughout your region.

  • Turn Strategy into Action – Partner with Asset Management and corporate leadership to translate asset objectives into clear property-level priorities and ensure consistent execution.

  • Stay Close to the Properties – Spend meaningful time on-site inspecting communities, reviewing operations, meeting with teams, identifying challenges, and ensuring standards are consistently met.

  • Build Winning Teams – Partner with Talent Acquisition and property leadership to identify staffing needs, recruit strong talent, address performance concerns, and build teams capable of delivering results.

  • Know Your Markets – Stay ahead of competitors, pricing, traffic, occupancy, and market trends across your region to help properties make informed operational and leasing decisions.

  • Raise the Standard – Identify performance gaps, establish action plans, and follow through until results improve. You're not afraid of difficult conversations or challenging properties.

  • Protect the Assets – Ensure properties maintain strong physical standards, address maintenance priorities, manage capital initiatives, and remain compliant with company policies and applicable regulations.

  • Connect the Dots – Serve as the bridge between on-site teams, Asset Management, and corporate departments, ensuring challenges are escalated appropriately and communication never becomes a roadblock to execution.

What We Offer:

  • A Leadership Role with Reach – Your decisions directly influence multiple communities, teams, and markets across your portfolio.

  • A Seat at the Table – Partner closely with Asset Management and senior leadership on property strategy, performance, staffing, and operational priorities.

  • A Role That Gets You Into the Field – This isn't management from behind a computer. You'll spend significant time at your communities, working directly with the people and properties you lead.

title: Aeroelasticity and Dynamics Engineer
description:
Share

58636BR

## Aeroelasticity and Dynamics Engineer

General Atomics Aeronautical Systems

Poway

California

Job Summary

General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI), an affiliate of General Atomics, is a world leader in proven, reliable remotely piloted aircraft and tactical reconnaissance radars, as well as advanced high-resolution surveillance systems.

We have an exciting entry level career opportunity for a highly motivated Dynamics Engineer within our Airframe Integrity Group located in Poway, CA. This position will report to the Aeroelasticity and Dynamics Supervisor and will focus on structural dynamics modeling, analysis, and test of components, subsystems, assemblies, and full air vehicles. This position supports air vehicle design, payload integrations, and air vehicle modifications throughout all product phases. Primary duties include analysis using both classical and finite element methods, model life cycle management, supporting test planning, test execution, and post-processing. This position includes support for ground vibration and static testing, creation of test models, and model correlation.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

- Develop structural dynamic models using classical and finite element models (FEM)
- Modeling and analysis of composite and metallic structures, flight control mechanisms, landing gear assemblies, isolated systems, and propulsion systems.
- Model management and tracking using PLM
- Working knowledge of FAR-23, FAR-25, JSSG-2006, STANAG-4671, MIL-HDBK-516, MIL-STD-8591, and other applicable requirements/specifications.
-  Must be able to develop detailed structural design criteria, verification requirements, and documentation to support airworthiness and certification efforts.
- Support the definition of test requirements and correlation of analytical models with ground and flight test data. Includes modal surveys, ground vibration test, and flight testing.
- Process test data, including time history data containing shock, vibration, and acoustic noise signals. Develop FFTs, PSDs, SRS, and other signal processing output.
- Establish, maintain, and improve analysis methods, tools, and best practices for dynamics, promoting standardization and quality across programs.
- Generate technical engineering deliverables, including reports, dynamic response assessments, and design recommendations.
- Participate in reviews (PDR, CDR, safety reviews, etc.), presenting analysis results, risks, and mitigation plans to internal leadership and external customers as required.
- Identify technical risks related dynamic behavior, develop mitigation strategies, and support trade studies that balance performance, weight, cost, and safety.
- Support proposals and new business activities by defining scope, estimating effort, and developing technical content related to dynamics.

We recognize and appreciate the value and contributions of individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences and welcome all qualified individuals to apply.

Job Qualifications

title: DCS Design Systems Engineer
description:
This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for a Full-Time Communications Network System Engineer to support the 6th Avenue / 63rd Street Communications Based Train Control (CBTC) Project in New York. The position will work under Project Management Consultant (PMC)’s Data Communications Systems (DCS) Design Manager and will provide technical leadership, coordination, and oversight of the Design-Builder’s DCS design, procurement, installation, testing, commissioning, and closeout activities.

The role will help ensure that the Design-Builder’s Train Control Systems (TCS) communications work is coordinated with CBTC/TCS system, signals, track, traction power, operations, safety, quality, and maintainability requirements.

The ideal candidate combines multidisciplinary design-management experience with practical knowledge of rail-transit infrastructure and design-build delivery. The candidate must be able to direct discipline reviewers, assess interfaces and constructability, identify risks early, and provide clear recommendations to the Program Management Team and MTA stakeholders.

Your Impact

  • Provide technical and managerial leadership for all TCS Data Communications System (DCS) elements of the 6th Avenue / 63rd Street Project, under the direction of TCS Design Manager.
  • Direct and coordinate multidisciplinary technical reviewers and other subject-matter experts; consolidate comments and confirm that review responses are clear, consistent, timely, and aligned with contract requirements.
  • Review Design-Builder submittals, design packages, calculations, specifications, drawings, shop drawings, RFIs, technical memoranda, construction work plans, test procedures, and closeout documentation for technical completeness and compliance.
  • Confirm conformance with applicable Project Requirements and Design Criteria (PRDCs), Design-Build
  • Contract requirements, MTA/NYCT technical standards, codes, regulations, permits, and Authority Having Jurisdiction requirements.
  • Manage interfaces among TCS disciplines and with CBTC/train control, communications, track, traction power, operations, safety, systems assurance, testing and commissioning, and existing infrastructure.
  • Identify design gaps, clashes, scope boundaries, constructability concerns, operational constraints, long-lead items, and integration risks; develop practical recommendations and track issues through resolution.
  • Assess the Design-Builder’s design approach, technical deviations, substitutions, value-engineering proposals, and proposed changes, including potential impacts on safety, quality, cost, schedule, operations, maintainability, and system performance.
  • Support requirements traceability, interface-control documentation, design maturity assessments, configuration management, and verification and validation for non-TCS systems.
  • Coordinate with MTA C&D, NYCT user and maintenance groups, MTA Code Compliance, FCC, utilities, and other Authorities Having Jurisdiction as required for reviews, approvals, and issue resolution.
  • Facilitate or participate in design-progress meetings, multidisciplinary coordination workshops, constructability reviews, risk reviews, submittal/RFI reviews, schedule reviews, and Design-Builder progress meetings.
  • Monitor the Design-Builder’s DCS Communications design, corresponding construction and integration schedule, submittal status, procurement activities, installation readiness, testing progress, and completion milestones; promptly elevate issues that may affect overall project delivery.
  • Coordinate with contract-compliance, quality, safety, commercial, project-controls, operations, and testing and commissioning teams to maintain a consistent oversight position.
  • Support field verification, installation reviews, nonconformance resolution, punch-list development, testing, commissioning, systems turnover, operations and maintenance manuals, training, as-built documentation, spare parts, and final acceptance.
  • Maintain accurate technical records, decision logs, interface and issue logs, action trackers, and supporting documentation for change management and potential claims.
  • Prepare concise technical briefings, recommendations, status reports, and escalation materials for project leadership.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline with a focus on Communications technologies.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in Network Communications or IT experience.
  • Experience implementing and integrating redundant, multi-client server environments.
  • Experience applying cybersecurity principles, including secure multi-zone to trusted conduit architectures models.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Visio and PowerPoint.
  • Technical writing, analytical and communication skills.
  • Detail-oriented with an emphasis on quality work products.
  • Project management experience leading initiatives from review to completion, including schedule integration, testing, and network system commissioning.
  • The selected candidate must have the ability to work in the United States immediately.
  • Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
  • Basic leadership abilities, capable of coordinating cross-functional teams and delivering on schedule.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in engineering, architecture, construction management, or a related field.
  • Strong grasp of Communications/Network engineering principles, including requirements management, architecture design, and system validation.
  • Solid knowledge of network designs in support of the CBTC deployment and their practical applications.
  • General Knowledge of Cellular Networks and general Cellular network core implementation using software-defined, cloud-native, and virtualized functions to provide essential services like user authentication, policy enforcement, and data routing
  • Experience supporting MTA Construction & Development and New York City Transit projects.
  • Experience on complex brownfield rail-transit projects with active passenger service, constrained access, multiple interfaces, and staged cutovers.
  • Experience leading technical teams on design-build programs and supporting change management, risk management, claims avoidance, and schedule recovery.
  • Familiarity with requirements-management, document-control, and project-management systems used on major infrastructure programs.
  • Familiarity with NY area transportation agencies such as MTA, Amtrak, LIRR, MetroNorth, NJT, NYCT, PANYNJ and their technical approach.

  • Relocation assistance is not available for this position.
  • This position is subject to and contingent upon client approval of candidates put forth for consideration by WSP.
  • This position requires min. 4 days, on-site either at the client’s office and/or the project office for the duration of the program. The project is located in New York City.
  • Occasional travel may be required depending on project-specific requirements.

Compensation and Benefits

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings focused on a providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career.

Expected Salary: $119,000- $209,100

title: Sr. CPQ Process Architect
description:
Job Summary

As a Senior Business Process Architect on the CPQ Platform team, you will serve as the senior strategic individual contributor and primary representative for CPQ across NetApp’s most critical enterprise initiatives. Reporting directly to the Sr. Director of CPQ Platform, you will operate as the team’s right hand — driving governance, shaping configuration strategy, and ensuring CPQ readiness across New Product Introductions (NPI), major platform transformations, and cross-functional programs.


This is not a people management role. It is a leadership role. You will lead through expertise, influence, and execution — representing CPQ at the table where strategic decisions are made and ensuring those decisions translate into scalable, supportable commercial operations. You must bring deep familiarity with how sellers actually sell, how deals are structured, and how configuration and quoting processes enable (or block) revenue.


Strong business acumen, CPQ domain expertise, AI fluency, and a storage industry background are essential. You will operate at the intersection of product, sales, operations, and technology — driving outcomes across PSRR, PRC, and enterprise governance processes in a fast-paced, high-visibility environment.

Job Responsibilities

• Serve as the CPQ platform’s senior strategic representative on major cross-functional initiatives including NPI launches, business model transitions, and commercial operations programs
• Lead CPQ readiness assessments for PSRR and PRC gates — identifying configuration risks, launch blockers, process gaps, and cross-functional dependencies before they become downstream problems
• Drive configuration governance across the product lifecycle — from initial product definition through quoting, ordering, fulfillment, and post-sale support
• Translate complex product and commercial strategies into actionable CPQ requirements, rules, and process designs that sellers can execute against
• Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Sales Operations, IT, Support, and Services to ensure end-to-end operational readiness for new offerings and business model changes
• Leverage AI tools and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for CPQ process automation, intelligent configuration, and decision support
• Conduct analysis of seller workflows, deal structures, and quoting patterns to identify friction points and drive configuration improvements that accelerate sales velocity
• Define and drive CPQ-related business requirements, solution designs, and implementation roadmaps in alignment with enterprise architecture
• Develop and present executive-level recommendations, risk assessments, and governance proposals to stakeholders from Staff to Vice President level
• Establish and maintain CPQ governance frameworks, standards, and decision criteria that scale across product lines and business models
• Survey and analyze industry practices, competitive CPQ approaches, and emerging commercial models for consideration in NetApp’s configuration strategy
• Provide mentorship and thought leadership to Business Process Analysts and cross-functional partners on CPQ best practices, governance principles, and configuration strategy
• Develop metrics and dashboards that provide visibility into CPQ operational performance, NPI readiness, and governance compliance

Job Requirements

• Deep, hands-on expertise in CPQ platforms, configuration logic, pricing models, and quoting/ordering processes — not theoretical, practical
• Intimate understanding of how enterprise sellers sell — deal structures, quoting workflows, channel dynamics, discount frameworks, and the configuration decisions that impact win rates
• Demonstrated proficiency with AI tools and platforms (e.g., AI-assisted analysis, automation, generative AI for process optimization) — must be a practitioner, not just aware
• Strong subject matter expertise in storage, data infrastructure, or adjacent enterprise technology markets
• Proven ability to lead without authority — influencing decisions, driving alignment, and holding cross-functional teams accountable through expertise and credibility
• Experience with NPI processes, stage-gate governance, and commercial launch readiness
• Excellent facilitation, communication, and presentation skills — ability to command a room from working sessions to executive reviews
• Effective cross-functional collaboration with Engineering, Product Management, Sales, Operations, Finance, Support, and Services
• Strong aptitude for learning new technologies and applying them to business process challenges
• Creative, pragmatic approach to problem solving — biased toward action and outcomes over process theater
• Ability to manage multiple high-priority, concurrent initiatives with minimal supervision
• Tasks are largely unstructured, strategically significant, and have wide-reaching implications across commercial operations, product launch, and seller experience
• This individual will apply broad CPQ expertise and unique subject matter knowledge to solve problems that are complex, ambiguous, and high-stakes given time, budget, and resource constraints
• Demonstrates leadership and vision in determining and driving high-impact, cross-functional decisions — particularly at governance gates and strategic inflection points
• Operates as the primary CPQ voice in rooms where product, sales, and technology strategy converge
Interaction:
• Must work effectively with Staff to Senior Vice President level employees within the function, across functions, and with external partners and vendors
• Limited supervision is provided — this individual operates, drives results, and sets priorities independently as a trusted extension of the CPQ Platform leadership
• The ideal candidate is a proactive contributor, subject matter expert, and strategic thought partner — not someone who waits for direction
• Success requires demonstrating favorable results through leadership and influencing multiple individuals, teams, and executive stakeholders
• Acts as mentor, facilitator, and the go-to authority on CPQ governance and configuration strategy


Education


• A minimum of 5 years of experience in business process architecture, CPQ, commercial operations, or related disciplines is required
• A Bachelor of Arts or Science Degree is required, or equivalent experience
• Demonstrated track record of leading complex, cross-functional programs focused on CPQ, configuration governance, and/or commercial operations in enterprise technology
• Storage, data infrastructure, or enterprise hardware/software industry experience strongly preferred
• Demonstrated experience applying AI and automation tools to business process optimization

Compensation:
The target salary range for this position is 147,900 - 220,000 USD. The salary offered will be determined by the candidate's location, qualifications, experience, and education and may be outside of this range. The range is based on 'On Target Earnings’ (OTE) representing the total potential earnings, which is the sum of the base salary and potential commission earned when performance targets are achieved. title: Medical Liaison - Sickle Cell Disease / Hemoglobinopathies  - Mississippi Valley
description:
About the Department

The Clinical, Medical and Regulatory (CMR) department at Novo Nordisk is one of the most diverse and collaborative groups within the organization. From healthcare provider interactions and developing and implementing regulatory strategies with the FDA to providing medical education and collecting data to support efficacy and new product development, CMR is involved. The one thing that keeps us all marching to the same beat is our patient centered focus. At Novo Nordisk, you will help patients around the world. As their needs evolve, so does our challenge to find better and more innovative ways to improve their quality of life. We’re changing lives for a living. Are you ready to make a difference?

The Position

Builds relationships with HCPs and demonstrates the clinical outcomes of NNI Hemoglobinopathies portfolio. Educates and demonstrates the safety and efficacy of key products to HCPs. Provides medical information and coordinates educational workshops, round tables, medical forums, etc.. May explore and identify sites for clinical trials in all stages of development. Incumbents have a deep scientific and clinical education and experience. Within Field Medical Affairs, this position functions as a scientific liaison between NNI and key external customers to further scientific exchange. S/he provides advanced product and scientific and medical field support to Medical, Sales and Marketing, as well as Managed Care and Government by using academic/professional credentials and scientific expertise to communicate with health care providers, organized providers/accounts and other relevant healthcare organizations. Strategic determination of change of territory prioritization will be based on customer need and analytics which identify need for change. This may occur at any time throughout the annual performance cycle. Develops and maintains medical (territory and account) plans in coordination with his/her Field Director.

Relationships

Position reports to Field Director/Sr Field Director. Serves as organization spokesperson on advanced medical and technical projects with the ML teams, Clinicians, Marketing, Market Access & Government and Sales personnel. External relationships include key opinion leaders (KOL’s), academic institutions, physicians, nurse practitioners, diabetes educators, pharmacists, blood bank staff, organized providers/IDNs and MCOs as needed based on territory archetypes.

Essential Functions

  • Administrative Duties:
    • Completes administrative duties in an accurate manner and on a timely basis, in line with current SOPs and working practices
    • Complies with all guidelines, policies, legal, regulatory and compliance requirements
    • Ensures effective administrative management of regional business as well as operational budgets
    • Maintains thorough understanding of all relevant Novo Nordisk processes and procedures and proactively assists other FMA members to further their understanding with these as needed
    • Provides monthly reports on scientific support activities in region to Director including budget expenditures as directed
    • Records all activities within a customer response management system (e.g. VEEVA) and all expenses within Concur in accordance with FMA procedures
  • Advocacy & Professional Relationship Development:
    • Attends assigned medical and scientific meetings: a) ensures and maintains awareness of current issues and new data pertaining to NNI products; b) develops and maintains relationships with key health care providers and IHNs; c) develops appropriate use of NNI products and greater utilization of its services d) supports and assists representatives and managers in answering questions from health care providers and IHNs
    • Combines account management skills, business acumen and scientific expertise to enhance value and develop collaborative relationships
    • Establishes the medical account strategy/plan through the identification and cultivation of key relationships and brings forth appropriate collaboration opportunities
  • Field-Based Clinical Support:
    • Collaborates with Health Economics & Outcomes Research (HEOR) team to deliver scientific value proposition of NNI’s products and devices to key customers and formulary decision makers. Delivers HEOR presentations upon request
    • Collaborates with Marketing and Sales management to inform the development of scientific strategies to optimize NNI’s products and development activities in the medical community
    • Collaborates with trial/study investigation sites; ensuring effective coordination and facilitation of studies to ensure timely review, initiation and completion, as well as publication of study results. Provides clinical support in cooperation with other Novo Nordisk groups to ensure investigators demonstrate appropriate knowledge of studies, support patient recruitment and retention activities, answers responsive requests from investigators and provides feedback to sites to other groups
    • Coordinates and collaborates with regional FMA team members to ensure integrated comprehensive coverage of regional clinical and scientific needs
    • Coordinates with key internal stakeholders to provide customized and dedicated system-wide clinical education and support within respective IHNs and coordinate and manage professional relations of Novo Nordisk within these Networks from an overall “account management” level
    • Coordinates with respective HSM to provide scientific and clinical education to Chief Executives, Medical Directors and formulary stakeholders to secure proper access to NNI’s products and services in respective IHNs
    • Develops and presents product and scientific updates as requested, including Formulary presentations within IHNs, using approved material

Physical Requirements

  • 50-75% overnight travel required.
  • The territory for this position is: TN, KY, MS.
  • Position is Field Based and the ideal candidate must live within the territory or in a bordering state located near a major airport.
  • Driver must maintain a valid driver’s license. Must be in good standing by not exceeding the Novo Nordisk points threshold assigned based on review of Motor Vehicle Records.

Qualifications

  • Doctoral degree required
  • At least two years’ experience in a health-related system, pharmaceutical company, or managed care environment required
  • Relevant clinical and/or therapeutic experience preferred
  • Displays business acumen/knowledge based on experiences such as participation in formulary process decisions
  • Extensive experience in diabetes strongly preferred
  • Strong communication skills

This position is part of a job family. Title and level within the job family are evaluated based on a number of factors, such as years of experience, scope of work, proficiency, and business need. Candidates will be assessed for the most appropriate title and level within the job family during the recruitment process. The base range of pay for each title in this job family are as follows:

• Medical Liaison - $170,000 to $215,000
• Senior Medical Liaison - $198,000 to $245,000

In addition, this position is eligible for a company bonus based on individual and company performance. Novo Nordisk offers long-term incentive compensation and or company vehicles depending on the position's level or other company factors.

Employees are also eligible to participate in Company employee benefit programs including medical, dental and vision coverage; life insurance; disability insurance; 401(k) savings plan; flexible spending accounts; employee assistance program; tuition reimbursement program; and voluntary benefits such as group legal, critical illness, identity theft protection, pet insurance and auto/home insurance. The Company also offers time off pursuant to its sick time policy, flex-able vacation policy and parental leave policy.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and defeating diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by local, state or federal laws, rules or regulations.

title: Sr. Project Manager- Power & Energy
description:
This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for a part-time Sr. Project Manager- Power & Energy for our Denver, CO office. The following location will also be considered: New Orleans, LA. We can also offer this position remotely from a mutually acceptable location within the United States and must have the ability to travel to a WSP and/or Client office for periodic face-to-face meetings.

Provides situational administrative and technical project management guidance for the development, execution, management, and monitoring of designated projects within a specific geography or discipline in support of company, regional, and national business line goals. Ensures responsibilities throughout the project lifecycle (proposal phase, planning and project startup, project execution, reporting, and project closeout) are adhered to, delivered, and audited with a level of quality that meets or exceeds corporate project excellence and delivery standards. Provides innovation, administration, and pragmatic direction to address current and future project management challenges in a rapidly changing and complex business and operations climate.

Your Impact

  • Provide PM leadership for larger scale/more complex projects ensuring contributors know what they are required to do and by when, preparing and overseeing relevant project budgets, forecasts, margins and KPIs, monitoring external events and risk contingencies, tracking hours and expenses, ensuring satisfactory performance, and managing the contractual obligations to deliver the project or assigned portfolio of assigned project(s) as defined in the contract.

  • Provide guidance with pursuit/initiation activities for projects meeting defined criteria or risk profile; including “Go / No-Go” decisions, contract reviews, risk mitigation strategies, pricing reviews, etc.
  • Participate in the technical aspects of contract negotiation, presentations, and meetings.

  • Provide verbal and/or written inputs to multi-disciplinary project teams and contribute to providing high level strategic advice to clients.
  • Mentor staff to support their growth and professional development.

  • Coordinate with area/technical managers to address project resource and subcontracting requirements in a timely manner.
  • Maintain regular communications with the client including reporting on monthly status, safety incidents, and major issues together with scope and budget impacts.
  • Participate in and oversee problem project reviews, providing input about root cause issues and potential solutions. Assist with developing project recovery plans.

  • Monitor accounts receivable (AR) and unbilled revenue, working to address issues as needed.
  • Complete formal project closeout activities, along with facilitating and documenting a lessons-learned meeting with key project staff.

  • Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, or a related major, or equivalent experience in a technical or engineering firm.
  • Essential project management certification required (e.g., PMP, CAP-M).
  • 12+ years of relevant post education experience in a project management role within our industry.
  • Highly proficient understanding of project delivery process within the A/E/C industry and strong background and experience in project management.
  • Advanced proficiency with analytical and organizational skills, with business acumen to bridge the business and project management.
  • Advanced proficiency with critical thinking and problem-solving skills to make assessments and calculations involving the application of project management principles, with a sound understanding of intent, impact, and optimal outcomes.
  • Advanced proficiency with interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively, persuasively, and tactfully with leadership, subcontractors, and employees at all levels of the organization.
  • Excellent self-leadership with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and adjusting readily to the changing prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment.
  • Works independently and provides guidance and leadership to mid-level to senior level team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.
  • Advanced proficiency with technical writing, office automation, relevant software, MS Office suite products (e.g., Word, Excel, Visio, Project, SharePoint), technology, spreadsheets, and PM tools.
  • Strong experience in managing the review and approval of documents and discipline-specific project deliverables, processes, and plans in a multi-project environment is highly desirable.
  • Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including senior management, subcontractors, consultants, and company-wide staff, including those with whom no formal hierarchical relationship exits.
  • Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
  • Strong ability to quickly adapt to change and demonstrate flexibility to a variety of schedules and hours to meet project-specific needs.
  • Up to 25 % travel may be required depending on project-specific requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.
