title: Director, Finance
description:
This position description incorporates the core responsibilities of the job. It is recognized that other related duties not specifically mentioned might also be performed, and that not all responsibilities may be carried out depending on operational needs.

POSITION PURPOSE

Under the general direction of Executive Director, the Director of Finance and Administration will provide oversight and management for FSFSC operations that include the following functions: Accounting, Human Resources, Information Technology, Facilities, Contracts and Vendor Relations. The incumbent directs and coordinates all agency operational functions to assist in the development and implementation of short and long range planning and forecasting. He/she will create structures, processes and systems necessary to manage the agency’s current operational activities and its projected growth. The incumbent will establish and maintain a “customer service” model that provides quality service and provides an opportunity for evaluation. He/she will manage and maintain effective relationships with internal customers, contractors, business partners, external auditors and a variety of stakeholders. He/she will assist the Executive Director in establishing processes and procedures that are aligned with the agency’s core values and facilitates achieving desired outcomes. The incumbent supervises the Accountant, HR Specialist, Bookkeeper, and other staff as deemed appropriate.


PRINCIPLE ACCOUNTABILITIES



Operations Management -In collaboration with the Management team, develop, implement and maintain a customer service model to ensure timely and adequate responses to customers’ needs through ad hoc management reporting, committees, and operational policies and procedures. Periodically review management systems and processes and adjust appropriately for continuous improvements. In collaboration with the Executive Director and Program Directors assist in the development and implementation of a reasonable operating budget with measurable goals and objectives to ensure fiscally sound operations. Monitor operational performance results; follow up on variances to ensure financial integrity.



Facility Management -Manage use and care of FSFSC space. Develop systems, processes and procedures for FSFSC facility inspection to ensure structural and operational soundness. Provide monthly and/or quarterly status reports on facility operations to the Executive Director to keep staff apprised of changes to operations and facility issues. Make written recommendations relating to the use of and cost analyses on repairs or installation services to ensure facility and/or FSFSC equipment is operational and in compliance with all applicable OSHA regulations and requirements.


Contract Oversight - Develop and implement a standard contract bidding process and/or purchasing system and procedures in relation to the overall operations of the agency that may be used to procure contractors/vendors and/or vehicle maintenance and technology needs to ensure continuity, quality assurance and cost effectiveness. Obtain and review bids and proposals from all contractor/vendors for conformance to agency policy and best interests and ensure contractors/vendors have appropriate licensures and select a vendor according to organizationally established criteria and product-specific criteria. Track bids, proposals and work orders for expiration and/or renewal and completion of work; coordinate closeout or renewal with appropriate staff. Resolve complex difficult issues concerning price, terms or delivery dates.


Supervision - Maintain overall accountability for the department’s human resource requirements for HR, F&A, IT and Operations including development and monitoring of staffing models and scheduling plans; recruiting and selecting employees, conducting performance evaluations within required time-frames, initiating disciplinary actions as needed and identifying compensation levels for team members. Provide continuous feedback that enriches job experience and stimulates staff growth and development. Provide ongoing training and development opportunities through on the job training, cross-training, special project, and in-house learning sessions.



Organizational Development - In collaboration with the Executive Director, develop and promote positive employee relations employing best practice methodologies to increase employee morale and employee involvement that may include but is not limited to: identifying management training needs. Provide support and counsel managers and employees on employee relations’ issues and problems to ensure compliance with standards, legal requirements, employment laws, and discipline/discharge, practices and procedures. Interpret policies and procedures to ensure staff is fully apprised of methods in which conflicts are resolved. Conduct internal investigations (as necessary) relating to discipline and discharge and/or grievance processes to ensure fair and equitable outcomes for involved parties and to reduce legal exposure for claims.

title: Projectmanager wegen
description:
Dit ga je doen

Wil jij de leiding nemen over beeldbepalende onderhoudsprojecten in het noordelijke wegennet? Als projectmanager wegen bij Rijkswaterstaat in Leeuwarden stuur jij het A-wegenteam voor Noord-Nederland aan. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de realisatie van het vast en variabel wegenonderhoud in deze regio. Herken jij jezelf in deze opgave? Solliciteer direct of neem contact met ons op voor een eerste kennismaking.

Hoe jij bijdraagt

Als projectmanager draag jij de verantwoordelijkheid voor een effectief assetmanagement en het behalen van de projectdoelstellingen. Je geeft richting aan het projectteam en borgt de kwaliteit, het draagvlak en de risicobeheersing. Daarbij denk je inhoudelijk mee over procesmatige en organisatorische vraagstukken. Je stemt voortdurend af met de beheerder, ketenpartners en marktpartijen om te zorgen dat het hoofdwegennet in Noord-Nederland veilig en goed bereikbaar blijft.

Jouw werkzaamheden

  • Je stelt het multidisciplinaire A-wegenteam functioneel aan en bewaakt de dagelijkse voortgang van het wegenonderhoud.
  • Je werkt aan de voorbereiding en aanbesteding van nieuwe basisonderhoudscontracten en raamovereenkomsten.
  • Je beheerst de lopende prestatiecontracten en het DBFM-contract voor het wegenareaal.
  • Je stemt het assetmanagement, de onderhoudsplanning en de afhandeling van calamiteiten af met alle betrokken partners.
  • Je bewaakt de samenhang met andere regio's en vertaalt de opgave van Rijkswaterstaat in heldere doelstellingen.

Jouw team

Je maakt onderdeel uit van het A-wegenteam voor Noord-Nederland, dat is ingericht volgens het integraal projectmanagementmodel. Binnen dit multidisciplinaire team werk je intensief samen met zowel interne als externe medewerkers en de vaste rolhouders voor techniek, contracten, omgevingsmanagement en projectbeheersing. Samen vormen jullie het operationele hart van de opgave en zijn jullie de spil tussen Rijkswaterstaat, de beheerder en de marktpartijen.

Interesse?

Solliciteer direct via de sollicitatieknop op de pagina. Om het sollicitatieproces efficiënt en doelgericht in te richten, vragen we niet om een traditionele motivatiebrief. In plaats daarvan ontvangen we graag jouw beknopte reactie van maximaal 200 woorden per vraag op de onderstaande vragen:
  1. Wat spreekt je aan in de functie van projectmanager wegen en het werken bij Rijkswaterstaat?
  2. Omgevingsbewustzijn: kun je een voorbeeld geven van hoe je het krachtenveld tussen de interne organisatie, marktpartijen en externe partners effectief hebt gemanaged om een goed resultaat te bereiken?
  3. Aansturen: kun je een voorbeeld geven van hoe jij een multidisciplinair team waarin uiteenlopende belangen en expertises samenkwamen, hebt gemotiveerd en aangestuurd om gezamenlijke doelen te behalen? Wat was jouw specifieke rol hierin?
We raden je aan om een concreet voorbeeld te meenemen in je antwoord. Het kan je helpen de vraag te beantwoorden volgens de STARR-methode (Situatie, Taak, Actie, Resultaat, Reflectie).

Eerst meer weten?

Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over deze functie? Bel of app met Jorrit Nieuwenhuis, portfoliomanager, via 06 27 06 15 46. Hij staat je graag te woord.

Dit bieden we nog meer

Bij ons werk je aan mooie en betekenisvolle projecten voor heel Nederland, in een organisatie die jouw ontwikkeling serieus neemt en je waardeert als professional. Dat zie je ook terug in de arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • 144 vakantie-uren per jaar (bij 36 uur per week)
  • volledige OV-vergoeding of een km-vergoeding van € 0,07 of € 0,23 p/km (zie voorwaarden)
  • mobiele telefoon en laptop
  • budget van € 750 voor inrichting thuiswerkplek + thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,45 p/dag
  • pensioenregeling via ABP

Een omgeving die jou ondersteunt en kansen biedt

  • hybride werken is mogelijk, afgestemd op jouw werkzaamheden en in samenspraak met je leidinggevende
  • persoonlijke groei – opleidingen en loopbaanbegeleiding

Stel je arbeidsvoorwaarden zelf samen, passend bij jouw leven

  • Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) gebruik je IKB-budget van 16,5% van je salaris voor bijvoorbeeld de aflossing van je studieschuld, een (elektrische) fiets inclusief accessoires, bedrijfsfitness, verduurzaming van je woning of andere fiscaalvriendelijke doelen
  • flexibele verlofregelingen (zorg-, ouderschaps-, adoptie- en pleegzorgverlof)
Bekijk hier de volledige CAO van het Rijk.

Dit vragen wij

  • Je beschikt over een wo-werk- en denkniveau, aantoonbaar door minimaal een afgeronde bacheloropleiding.
  • Je hebt ruime ervaring met het leidinggeven aan projectteams en ervaring met de verhoudingen binnen een politiek complexe omgeving.

Aan competenties breng je mee

  • Omgevingsbewustzijn: je hebt herkenning en respect voor de verschillende belangen van stakeholders en handelt hiernaar.
  • Netwerken: je bouwt en onderhoudt een sterk en relevant netwerk met interne en externe partners.
  • Verbindend leiderschap: je inspireert en motiveert teamleden, stelt duidelijke doelen en haalt het beste uit een multidisciplinair team.

Hier kom je te werken

Over Rijkswaterstaat

Rijkswaterstaat

Rijkswaterstaat is de uitvoeringsorganisatie van het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en bestaat uit 6 landelijke en 7 regionale organisatieonderdelen. Al meer dan 225 jaar werken we dagelijks aan een veilig, leefbaar en bereikbaar Nederland. We beheren en ontwikkelen de rijkswegen, -vaarwegen en -wateren en zetten in op een duurzame leefomgeving. Samen met anderen werken we aan een land dat beschermd is tegen overstromingen. Waar voldoende groen is, en voldoende en schoon water. En waar je vlot en veilig van A naar B kunt. Samenwerken aan een veilig, leefbaar en bereikbaar Nederland: dat is werken bij Rijkswaterstaat.

Talent als basis, diversiteit als kracht

Rijkswaterstaat is een inclusieve organisatie. Een organisatie die ruimte biedt aan iedereen en die de kracht van de diversiteit van medewerkers gebruikt om samen betere resultaten te halen voor Nederland. Inclusief betekent dat iedereen zich betrokken en gewaardeerd voelt; niet ondanks, maar dankzij de verschillen. Daarom nodigen wij jou graag uit, als jij je herkent in deze vacature, om te solliciteren.

Rijkswaterstaat Programma’s, Projecten en Onderhoud

Wil jij werken bij Rijkswaterstaat binnen Programma’s, Projecten en Onderhoud (PPO)? Dit organisatieonderdeel is verantwoordelijk voor het complete onderhoud van alle rijkswegen, vaarwegen, tunnels, bruggen, waterkeringen, sluizen en de bedieningsinstallaties in heel Nederland.

Naast het reguliere onderhoud wordt er onder andere gewerkt aan de renovatie van de IJsselbruggen en de Velsertunnel, de aanleg van de Markerwadden en het onderhoud aan de Maeslantkering. Verder zijn er testprojecten op het gebied van smart mobility, intelligente transportsystemen en het hergebruiken van grondstoffen.

Bij PPO werken onder andere inhoudelijke adviseurs en managers op het gebied van techniek, inkoop, contracten, projectbeheersing en projecten. PPO’ers delen hun kennis onderling en werken elke dag aan de verbetering van hun werkwijzen. Deze organisatie werkt actief samen met de andere onderdelen van Rijkswaterstaat en de diverse externe partners, zoals gemeenten, provincies, waterschappen en marktpartijen.

In totaal werken er ruim 1.200 mensen binnen PPO in 7 verschillende regio’s, verspreid over 4 directies: Inkoop- en Contractmanagement, Productie en Projectmanagement, Techniek en Technisch Management en Bedrijfsvoering en Projectbeheersing.

Bijzonderheden

  • Om bij ons te werken, moet je een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) kunnen overhandigen, ook als je een interdepartementale transfer maakt. De kosten voor het aanvragen van een VOG worden door ons vergoed.
  • Je wordt ingeschaald op basis van ervaring.
  • Het inwinnen van referenties kan deel uitmaken van het sollicitatieproces, dit doen we altijd in overleg met jou.

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Are you ready to drive innovative software solutions for our electrical vehicle chargers? Do you thrive in fast-paced environment where you can make a difference every day?

We're looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer for a key role, with deep expertise in complex charging systems and a track record of delivering robust solutions. You'll challenge unnecessary complexity, champion smarter architectures, and navigate tough engineering trade-offs — taking ownership of complex features from design through implementation while guiding your team with technical excellence and proactive leadership.

You'll shape the software backbone of our next-generation EV charging infrastructure — leading the design and implementation of comprehensive test frameworks and testing solutions across the full product lifecycle, from architecture and requirements through implementation, integration, verification, release, and field support. Working independently on critical features while elevating the entire team's technical capabilities, you'll help build the charging technology that will power tomorrow's mobility.

What will you do:

  • Lead the design and implementation of comprehensive test frameworks and solutions, owning the full lifecycle from requirements and architecture through execution, integration, verification, release, and field support.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership by building and architecting low-level Python and C++ testing solutions, challenging assumptions, reducing unnecessary complexity, and proposing smarter approaches to enhance product quality.
  • Drive timely decisions when teams are blocked, requirements are unclear, or architecture and implementation trade-offs need to be resolved in test automation.
  • Work closely with requirements engineers, product owners, hardware engineering, and field support to define high-quality requirements and deliver reliable testing solutions for complex hardware/software products.
  • Define testing scope, estimates, plans, and delivery priorities for new testing capabilities and improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure testing practices, documentation, and knowledge sharing enable maintainable frameworks and effective test execution across the team.
  • Remain hands-on with development while guiding other engineers to implement, improve, and automate tests, setting a high bar for technical quality and ownership.

What you will bring:

You are a seasoned software professional with a passion for owning solutions from design to implementation. You enjoy cross-functional collaboration, and you are genuinely excited about driving innovative and impactful decisions. Furthermore, we ask for:

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, Informatics, Computer Science, Industrial Science, or a related technical field, with a strong understanding of embedded systems and the ability to see the overall solution.
  • Proficiency in embedded Python and C/C++ programming, with hands-on experience building and architecting test solutions and frameworks across complex systems.
  • Strong ownership and a proactive mindset, with the ability to work independently on complex technical challenges, translate requirements into technical designs, and drive them through implementation with precision.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps, test frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and software development practices that enable scalable, maintainable solutions.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and align stakeholders.
  • Ability to write Shell scripts in Linux and work effectively in Unix-based environments (considered an advantage).
  • Familiarity with EVSE charging protocols and interfaces such as ISO 15118, DIN 70121, CCS, and CHAdeMO, demonstrating understanding of industry-specific challenges (considered an advantage).
  • Knowledge of Rust programming language (considered an advantage).

What’s in it for you?

Work with the best specialists in their field, in a diverse environment with unparalleled global reach. Feel inspired by our strong strategy and laser focus on the market and the leading portfolio in the EV charging world. See our latest product here: OM X-Series | ABB E-mobility

We expect you to take strong ownership and accountability for the scope you work on enabling you to strongly contribute and make a difference and be a part of the transformation into a future of sustainable and efficient mobility.

A competitive compensation package in line with your capabilities and experience, in an environment where you can grow and learn. This package also comes with choice of IT equipment, healthy and freshly served food in the lunch area, and the best coffee breaks with our inhouse barista!

Our individual differences make us successful. Diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities are at the core of what we do. We celebrate different experiences and perspectives, and we aim to empower everyone in the creation of sustainable solutions for people all over the world.

This is a unique opportunity to make a difference in a rapidly growing sector. If you're ready to take on exciting challenges and shape the future of E-mobility, apply today!

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated).

About ABB E-Mobility

ABB E-mobility is a world leader in EV charging technology and a partner of choice for the world’s biggest electric vehicle OEMs and nationwide EV charging network operators. With a strong R&D pipeline, our robust product portfolio of innovative holistic solutions – from grid to charge point and domestic installations to large fleet depots – means we are actively enabling the future of E-Mobility, not just predicting it.

title: Night Supervisor, Manufacturing
description:

Coke Canada supplies some of Canada’s favourite beverage brands, and we want to continue to be the leading beverage partner in Canada, creating a better future and delivering optimism by bringing sustainable value to our employees, customers, consumers, and communities.

Advancing a high-performing, collaborative and inclusive culture is at the core of our vision to be the World’s Greatest Bottler, Built by the Best People, and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help get us there.

The Manufacturing Supervisor is a full-time position located at Bottling Production Facility in Brampton. Responsibilities

Why work with us?

This includes a competitive compensation package, access to retirement and saving programs, family and employee assistance program, paid vacation and floater days.
  • We have close, local connections with the communities in which we operate across Canada. We’re determined to make a positive difference in our communities; this includes opportunities for employee volunteerism.
  • We’re building our business responsibly and our mission is to work Toward a Better Future Together. We have a plan that outlines how we are reducing, reusing, recycling, decreasing our carbon footprint, and using water responsibly. For more information visit cokecanada.com/sustainability/

Coke Canada has been recognized as one of Canada’s Best Employers for Diversity, and we’re committed to fostering a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace. Together we are creating a workplace culture that values diversity, enables inclusivity and ensures everyone feels like they belong. We are aiming to ensure our diverse workforce is reflective of the communities in which we operate. Research shows that women-identifying and other marginalized individuals often hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the listed qualifications. If this role excites you, even if you don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply. Your unique experience and perspective could be what we’re looking for. Unless otherwise specified, this job post is for an existing vacancy.

Our hiring process is human-driven and does not involve AI tools for screening, assessment, or selection. For individuals requiring accommodations or support throughout the recruitment process please call 1-844-383-2653 or email HR@cokecanada.com.

title: Operating Room Tech (Full Time Days) 6:30a-3:00p
description:
Job Summary

The Anesthesia Technician supports the anesthesia team in delivering safe and efficient patient care by preparing equipment, assisting with procedures, and maintaining anesthesia supplies. This role involves working under the supervision of anesthesiologists and Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetists (CRNAs) to facilitate smooth and effective operations in areas requiring anesthesia. The Anesthesia Technician plays a vital role in maintaining a sterile and organized environment, troubleshooting equipment, and ensuring readiness for a variety of procedures across all patient populations.

Essential Functions
  • Prepares anesthetizing locations by setting up, calibrating, and maintaining monitoring devices and anesthesia equipment for scheduled procedures.
  • Assists anesthesia providers with aseptic or sterile techniques during non-invasive and invasive procedures, including airway management and intravenous or arterial line placement.
  • Monitors and reports abnormal changes in patient vital signs or physical appearance to anesthesia providers.
  • Obtains and stocks anesthesia supplies in operating rooms, labor and delivery suites, and other procedural areas to ensure readiness.
  • Assists with laboratory tests and results, including arterial blood gases (ABGs), activated clotting times (ACTs), and other point-of-care tests.
  • Prepares, obtains, and delivers blood products and pharmaceuticals as requested by the anesthesia team.
  • Provides technical guidance and instruction to other anesthesia technicians, and team members as needed.
  • Assists with patient transport, positioning, and application of monitors under the supervision of the anesthesia team.
  • Troubleshoots equipment malfunctions, ensuring timely resolution by coordinating with the appropriate repair departments.
  • Maintains immediate availability to assist with routine and emergency procedures as directed.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.
Qualifications
  • Completion of an accredited Anesthesia Technician program preferred or
  • College or coursework in Biology, Physiology, Anatomy, or related scientific fields preferred
  • 0-2 years of experience as an Anesthesia Technician in a hospital or surgical setting preferred
  • 1-2 years of experience as a Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) preferred
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • Proficiency in setting up, calibrating, and maintaining anesthesia equipment and monitoring devices.
  • Knowledge of aseptic and sterile techniques for assisting with invasive and non-invasive procedures.
  • Strong organizational skills to manage supplies and maintain readiness across multiple procedural areas.
  • Effective communication skills to interact with anesthesia providers, nurses, and other healthcare team members.
  • Ability to remain calm and responsive in high-pressure and emergency situations.
  • Familiarity with patient care protocols and safety standards.
Licenses and Certifications
  • BLS - Basic Life Support required
  • Cer.A.TT - Certified Anesthesia Technologist preferred

title: Data Management Senior Associate
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.


Pay and Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
  • Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
  • Pension / Retirement benefits
  • Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
  • DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).


The Impact you will have in this role:

As a core member of the Data Management Team within Enterprise Data Solutions, a Senior Associate will be responsible for driving projects forward, managing key deliverables, and helping to drive alignment with key stakeholders. Data Management is a high-impact, fast paced team focused on strategic data solutions, supporting data-driven transformation and modernization efforts, and establishing, maturing, and driving the implementation of industry-leading data management practices for the enterprise. The ideal candidate for this position is a self-starter with strong analytical skills and a demonstrated ability to prioritize, own and drive projects, and quickly learn new concepts and frameworks. Success in this role demands the ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to shifting priorities.

You will provide critical support for the management of Data Domains aligned to the team, including support of enterprise-wide Data Management initiatives. You will need to work effectively within an agile framework as part of a cross functional team that includes Product Managers, Product Owners, Business Architects, Operations and Information Technology Subject Matter Experts, Data Architects, Data Modelers, Enterprise Test Engineers, Data Governance and Data Quality Leads, IT Business System Analysts, and other Data Management Analysts. You should also be able to work independently with the appropriate initiative-taking and problem-solving, even in ambiguous situations. This role requires the ability to access, profile and analyze data, understand and document business requirements, and communicate clearly and concisely with a broad range of technical and business stakeholders.

Your primary responsibilities:

Project & Delivery Ownership

  • Own and manage multiple data initiatives across the full lifecycle from engagement and requirements discovery through execution and close‑out ensuring outcomes remain aligned with business objectives.
  • Support project planning activities including scope definition, effort estimation, dependency management, and delivery tracking.
  • Define, track, and report KPIs and delivery metrics aligned to business outcomes and use cases.
  • Identify, track, and manage data‑related issues and risks, ensuring timely escalation, remediation planning, and clear stakeholder communication.
  • Serve as a key contributor within agile squads, actively participating in stand‑ups, grooming sessions, delivery reviews, and other agile ceremonies.

Business Analysis & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Business, Operations, Product Owners, and Technology/IT stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document data requirements for business processes, including downstream consuming use cases.
  • Define and document clear business rules to support consistent data usage and decision‑making.
  • Translate business needs into clear, actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlogs for agile delivery teams.
  • Lead high‑impact workshops and working sessions to drive alignment, clarify scope, and resolve open questions with senior stakeholders.
  • Produce clear, concise analysis, reporting, and status updates to support stakeholder and leadership decision‑making.
  • Develop and deliver high‑quality presentations tailored to executive, business, and delivery audiences.

Data Management & Stewardship

  • Perform preliminary data analysis to assess data availability within DTCC, identify Authoritative Data Sources (ADS), and support onboarding approaches for new or enhanced data.
  • Proficient in using Excel and SQL to conduct targeted data analysis, profiling, validation, lineage review, and issue investigation to support requirements definition, impact analysis, and informed decision‑making.
  • Collaborate with business and operational partners to define and document business data elements, including standardized names, clear definitions, valid values, and associated business rules.
  • Support data modelers by providing business context, data analysis, and source‑system insight to inform conceptual and logical data models.
  • Proactively monitor data quality controls and support data quality initiatives through data profiling, definition, creation and documentation of data quality and validation rules, root‑cause analysis, and support of data remediation and data cleansing efforts.
  • Maintain required metadata for critical and prioritized data elements in enterprise repositories, ensuring consistency, traceability, and governance.
  • Mitigate risk by adhering to established procedures and controls, identifying potential issues early, and demonstrating strong ethical judgment.

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in a Business Analyst, Data Steward, or Delivery‑focused role, preferably within financial services.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong expertise in business requirements analysis, stakeholder engagement, and agile delivery.
  • Proven experience using advanced SQL and Excel to analyze data and support business decisions.
  • Solid understanding of how data supports business processes, reporting, and operational use cases.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to clearly articulate complex topics to non‑technical audiences. With good analytical, problem‑solving, and organizational skills.

title: PAS - Microsoft 365 AI Solution Architect-  Consulting - Senior - Multiple Locations
description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

EY advises clients on how to architect, migrate, and modernize their digital workplace using Microsoft 365 and the Power Platform. Our work spans strategy and technical architecture, solution delivery, and technical advisory services, with a strong emphasis on SharePoint modernization, large-scale content and workload migrations, and adoption of the Power Platform.

Role summary

In this role, you will lead and deliver enterprise SharePoint Server (on-premises) to Microsoft 365 migrations and build modern SharePoint Online intranets. You will shape target information architecture, migration waves, and modernization approaches (including workflow/forms modernization to Power Platform), and you will partner closely with client stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and supportable solutions.

As a senior consultant, you will bring deep experience across SharePoint Server, SharePoint Online, and Microsoft 365 administration (including Entra ID, Teams, and OneDrive). You will lead and participate in full project lifecycles—discovery, assessment, target-state design, build/configuration, testing, migration execution, and deployment—and you will contribute to high-quality client outcomes through solution blueprints, design reviews, and cross-workstream collaboration.

As an M365 SharePoint Engineer, you will have in-depth knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management which enable you lead and participate in enterprise solution implementations, including all project phases such as discovery, definition, build, test and deploy. You will be an integral part of the delivery team to ensure the solutions built for our clients meet their needs to help drive their success through various methods such as solution blueprints, design reviews and cross-workstream collaborations to provide a total solution.

You will focus on the design, customization and optimization of digital workplace solutions, particularly with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, and Power Platform. You will collaborate with various EY groups with digital capabilities to pursue and deliver digital engagements and deliver solutions that will bring our client’s digital vision, strategy and roadmap to life.

Key responsibilities

You will focus primarily on (1) SharePoint on-premises to SharePoint Online migrations, (2) implementing modern SharePoint Online intranets, and (3) modernizing legacy customization patterns to the Power Platform. You will collaborate with internal EY teams and client stakeholders to shape and deliver complex enterprise engagements, balancing user experience, governance, and security/compliance requirements.

  • Assess & plan migrations: run discovery/inventory, define migration scope and waves, estimate effort/complexity, and establish cutover and hypercare plans.
  • Design the target intranet: define information architecture, hub/site strategy, navigation, search approach, metadata/content types, and permissions model.
  • Execute migrations: configure and operate Microsoft and third-party migration tooling, manage pilots, remediate issues, and drive successful cutovers.
  • Modernize solutions: map legacy workflows/forms (e.g., SharePoint Designer/InfoPath/Nintex/K2) to Power Automate and Power Apps patterns where appropriate.
  • Enable operations & governance: establish standards, provisioning/lifecycle controls, and operational reporting (including SharePoint Advanced Management where applicable).
  • Lead stakeholders: run workshops, produce client-ready deliverables, and communicate risks, tradeoffs, and decisions clearly to technical and business audiences.

Your experience with enterprise tenant-to-tenant migrations (M&A, divestitures, consolidations) and on-premises to cloud migrations will be critical to success in this role.

Skills and attributes for success

  • Delivering work across project phases (discovery, requirements, design, build, test, migration/cutover, and post-migration stabilization) with strong project governance and risk management.
  • Creating client-ready deliverables (assessments, target-state architectures, migration plans, runbooks, and executive communications) and contributing to reusable assets and accelerators.
  • Applying broad technical depth across SharePoint Server/Online, Microsoft 365 identity and collaboration services, and the Power Platform to solve real client problems.
  • Working effectively with client technologists and strategic partners/vendors to deliver an integrated solution.
  • Building trusted relationships with stakeholders through clear communication, practical recommendations, and reliable delivery.
  • Communicating effectively with client executives, product owners, business stakeholders, and engineering teams; translating requirements into actionable designs and plans.
  • Interacting and communicating effectively with teammates, clients, stakeholders, and executives

Qualifications (must-have)

  • 3+ years of consulting experience delivering SharePoint solutions and/or migrations using Microsoft technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with SharePoint Server (2013/2016/2019) and SharePoint Online administration and configuration.
    • Proven experience planning and executing SharePoint migrations (assessment, waves, pilots, remediation, cutover, and hypercare).
    • Experience with at least one major migration toolset (e.g., Microsoft Migration Manager, ShareGate, AvePoint, Quest, or similar).
    • Experience implementing modern SharePoint Online intranets (IA, hubs, navigation, search, metadata, and permissions).
    • Working knowledge of the Power Platform (Power Apps and Power Automate), especially for forms/workflow modernization patterns.
    • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills; ability to lead workshops and present recommendations to technical and executive audiences.
    • Experience delivering in regulated or security-conscious environments, incorporating identity, governance, and compliance requirements into designs.
    • Prior enterprise consulting experience (client-facing delivery).

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • At least 2 years of professional enterprise technical consulting experience designing and implementing collaboration offerings leveraging the Microsoft stack including some or all of: Microsoft SharePoint Server, SharePoint Online, SharePoint Hybrid, and SharePoint administration. Candidate possesses a deep understanding of SharePoint migration process and tools (Migration Manager, Mover, etc.), SharePoint Server farm administration, SharePoint Online (and OneDrive and Teams) administration, solution packaging and deployment, troubleshooting.
  • Working with enterprise clients to implement enterprise programs and possess a deep understanding and enterprise experience with some or all of:
    • SharePoint Server, SharePoint Online and OneDrive configuration, administration, and architecture
    • M365 platform governance and design – identity, security, and compliance
    • Power Platform integrations with SharePoint
    • SPO Content services with AI for SharePoint, Search, and Copilot enablement
    • Application Modernization programs - SharePoint Server On-Premises to SharePoint Online
    • Migration programs - mergers and acquisitions and divestiture programs, Cloud and digital workplace transformation programs
    • SharePoint enterprise governance with SharePoint Advanced Management or third-party tools like AvePoint
  • One or more of the following Microsoft certifications:
    • MS-900: Microsoft 365 Fundamentals
    • MS-102: Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert
    • MS-700: Managing Microsoft Teams
    • SC-100: Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect (Critical)
    • AI-900: Azure AI Fundamentals
    • Microsoft Certified: AI Agent Builder Associate (beta)

Additional Qualifications (nice-to-have)

  • Microsoft certifications (preferred), such as Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, Teams Administrator Associate, and Security Administrator Associate.
  • Experience modernizing legacy workflows/forms using SharePoint Designer, InfoPath, Nintex, K2, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with additional migration and modernization tools (e.g., BitTitan, SkySync, Metalogix, or similar).

What we look for

We’re looking for leaders who combine strong Microsoft 365/SharePoint technical depth with practical consulting skills—people who can assess complex environments, make clear recommendations, and deliver outcomes. If you have the architecture, migration, and modern intranet experience described above and a passion for helping clients transform their digital workplace, this role is for you.

In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, both pension and 401(k) plans, a minimum of 18 days of vacation plus twelve observed holidays and 10 personal care days, and a range of programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. title: AI-Native Product Engineer - Senior
description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

Turn emerging AI capabilities into products people choose to use, trust, and rely on. You will work as an end-to-end builder, close to users, product decisions, and production code, connecting the pieces that turn an AI demonstration into a durable product.

This role suits an engineer with founder-like ownership and the discipline to test assumptions early. You may move from a user conversation to a working prototype, from that prototype to a secure service, and from a production failure to a better evaluation in the same product cycle. Speed matters, but so do accessibility, maintainability, and the willingness to simplify when the evidence calls for it.

About Challenger

Challenger is a new EY program focused on building the firm’s next generation of services. It pursues opportunities where AI enables a fundamentally different service and way of delivering it, including rethinking existing offerings and developing new ones.

Small, dedicated teams build and test ideas in real conditions. Solutions that demonstrate clear business value and operational readiness transition to the business for adoption and scale.

Challenger Core develops and maintains the shared technology, methods, and risk and quality guardrails that support this work. Each team contributes reusable tools and practices, helping make the next service faster and less costly to build.

Your key responsibilities

  • Start with the user. Work directly with users and domain experts to understand real workflows, observe friction, and identify where AI can create distinctive value.
  • Test assumptions quickly. Turn product hypotheses into concise specifications, prototypes, and small releases that generate useful evidence early.
  • Own complete product slices. Build coherent verticals across the experience, services, data, AI behavior, and enterprise integrations rather than optimizing a single layer.
  • Shape AI behavior. Design instructions, context, retrieval, structured outputs, and tool use, choosing adaptation or tuning only when evidence supports it.
  • Build the evidence system. Create representative tasks and automated evaluations that show whether the product is useful, correct, safe, accessible, and improving.
  • Connect outcomes to behavior. Instrument user journeys so the team can relate adoption and task success to system behavior, latency, failures, and cost.
  • Engineer for responsible use. Build clear permission boundaries, secure data handling, human checkpoints, graceful degradation, recovery, and rollback into the experience.
  • Own production quality. Release incrementally, monitor live behavior, respond to incidents, and turn failures into durable product and engineering improvements.
  • Make practical trade-offs. Balance experience, quality, speed, reliability, and cost, using deterministic software when it is the more dependable choice.
  • Contribute reusable patterns. Share proven components and evaluation assets with the broader platform while remaining accountable for their performance in the product workflow.

Skills and attributes for success

  • Full-stack engineering: Strong ability to build maintainable production software across modern interfaces, services, APIs, data, and integrations.
  • AI application depth: Practical knowledge of model APIs, context design, retrieval, tool use, structured outputs, and agentic patterns.
  • Product judgment: Ability to find the real user problem, frame clear hypotheses, and simplify the solution when evidence challenges the original idea.
  • Evaluation discipline: Experience designing representative tests and experiments for systems whose behavior is not fully deterministic.
  • Production ownership: Strong instincts for observability, accessibility, security, performance, reliability, recovery, and responsible use.
  • High-agency collaboration: Comfort working across product, design, domain, platform, and control teams while staying accountable for the outcome after launch.

To qualify you must have

  • 5+ years of relevant experience.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field.
  • End-to-end delivery: A record of taking customer- or employee-facing software from an unclear concept through launch, learning, and adoption.
  • Technical breadth: Strong full-stack capability across modern frontend, backend, API, data, and cloud technologies, demonstrated through shipped work.
  • Applied AI experience: Hands-on experience building products with large language models, retrieval, tools, or comparable AI application patterns.
  • Evaluation experience: Evidence of automated testing and behavioral evaluation for systems with variable or probabilistic outputs.
  • Live-service ownership: Demonstrated responsibility for telemetry, debugging, reliability, incident response, recovery, and performance improvement.
  • User-centered practice: Experience working directly with users, designers, and product leaders to turn evidence into better product decisions.
  • Engineering craft: A consistent record of clear specifications, maintainable code, thoughtful review, and sound technical trade-offs.
  • Travel and On-site requirements: This role requires up to 50% travel and flexibility to go into the office in a hybrid capacity.

Ideally, you’ll also have

  • Agentic products: Experience building workflow automation or collaborative AI products that interact with real business systems.
  • Enterprise environments: Experience with identity, knowledge systems, permission-sensitive information, or regulated and confidential settings.
  • Design sensibility: A strong instinct for clear interactions, accessibility, and reducing user effort in complex workflows.
  • Efficiency at scale: Experience improving the quality, latency, reliability, or economics of production AI applications.
  • Builder track record: Startup experience, open-source contributions, or another clear example of high-agency product building.

We welcome exceptional candidates from product, service design, operations, transformation, policy, domain, and entrepreneurial backgrounds; no particular degree or certification is required.

What we offer you
At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at

  • We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $128,400 to $192,500
    • Bay Area California offices – $133,600 to $200,600
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $106,900 to $176,500
  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
  • Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

  • To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
  • EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
  • For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
  • At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

All in to shape the future with confidence.

About Us: Haydon, Kerk and Pittman are three world class AMETEK brands that supply advanced linear and rotary motion solutions to a diverse mix of global customers. We are recognized as a leading manufacturer of brushed and brushless DC motors, stepper motor based linear actuators, precision Acme lead screw and anti-backlash nut assemblies, linear rail and guide systems, gearmotors, drives and complete custom automation sub-systems.

We are looking for the right individual to join our team as a Tool Builder. This exciting role is responsible for building molds for the molding machines per the molding schedule, operating molding machines and maintaining a clean and organized work area.

What will you do?

On any given day, your responsibilities would include:

  • Building molds for molding machines by assembling tooling components into the mold bases per the blueprint instructions

  • Performing inspection of mold bases and components

  • Following blueprint when selecting appropriate molds and components

  • Consulting and following the production schedule for molds to be built

  • Using measurement tools i.e. snap gage, digital calipers, and other measuring instruments

  • Organizing and maintaining the tool storage area

  • Coordinating tool repairs with the tool shop

  • Assisting with preventive maintenance (PM) of the tools and mold bases

  • Operating molding machines as needed

  • Disassembling and cleaning molds at end of run and returning components to appropriate locations

  • Following established procedures as well as quality and safety standards

You are a great fit if you have the following:

  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints

  • A demonstrated strong mechanical aptitude

  • Experience in the use of hand tools i.e.. screwdriver, hammer, drill, wrench

  • Good organizational skills

  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills

  • Attention to detail

  • Experience with measuring equipment i.e. snap gage, digital calipers, and other measuring instruments

  • Team player who works in cooperation with others

  • HS Degree or GED

  • 1+ years manufacturing experience preferred

  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and to reduce costs. The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.

Work Environment:

  • Continuously required to stand and use hands to finger, handle or feel and reach with hands and arms

title: Technisch manager
description:
Dit ga je doen

Nederland staat voor een grote instandhoudingsopgave waar onderhoud, renovatie en vervanging onderdeel van uitmaken. Wil jij als ervaren technicus inhoudelijk sturen op de grote vast en variabele onderhoudsopgave van onze wegen in Oost-Nederland? Als technisch manager bij Rijkswaterstaat neem je de inhoudelijke regie op de technische keuzes én geef je leiding aan een team van adviseurs. Samen met partners werk je aan de infrastructuur van morgen. Klinkt dit interessant? Lees snel verder!

Hoe jij bijdraagt

In deze rol geef je leiding aan een multidisciplinair team van technisch adviseurs en ben je tegelijkertijd inhoudelijk verantwoordelijk als het technische geweten binnen jouw opgavecluster. Volgens het Integraal Projectmanagement (IPM)-model vertegenwoordig je de technische discipline in multidisciplinaire projectteams. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met andere IPM-rollen, beheerders en opdrachtnemers. Samen zorgen jullie dat besluiten standhouden op de bouwplaats en in bestuurlijke overleggen.

Jouw werkzaamheden

  • Je bent het technische geweten van de projecten. Je vertaalt organisatiedoelen, kaders en technische eisen naar de opgave binnen jouw projecten en geeft richting aan de technische besluitvorming waarbij je integraal afweegt tussen prestaties, risico's, kosten en duurzaamheid.
  • Je geeft leiding aan een multidisciplinair team van technisch adviseurs en brengt kennis uit verschillende disciplines samen.
  • Je bewaakt de technische kwaliteit van projecten van voorbereiding tot en met oplevering. Daarbij borg je dat technische risico's tijdig worden onderkend en beheerst en dat projectresultaten voldoen aan de gestelde eisen.
  • Veiligheid zit verweven in alles wat je doet. Je zorgt ervoor dat mensen hun werk veilig kunnen uitvoeren en dat gebruikers kunnen vertrouwen op veilige en betrouwbare infrastructuur. De rol van Coördinator Ontwerp in het kader van Arbo-veiligheid is daarbij bij jou belegd.

Jouw team

Je werkt binnen de afdeling Technisch Management van organisatieonderdeel Programma's, Projecten en Onderhoud (PPO). Binnen PPO werk je samen met technisch adviseurs, projectmanagers, contractmanagers en andere specialisten aan het onderhoud, de renovatie en vervanging van de Nederlandse infrastructuur. Afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring kun je worden ingezet op verschillende projecten en in verschillende regio's. Het opgavecluster waar je op zal starten is het wegen cluster in Oost-Nederland. Er wordt gewerkt vanuit Arnhem. De afdelingsbijeenkomsten technisch management zijn in Utrecht.

Interesse?

Wil jij als technisch manager de inhoudelijke regie nemen op onze wegen? Solliciteer direct via de sollicitatieknop op deze pagina. Een traditionele motivatiebrief is niet nodig. We horen liever hoe jij naar de praktijk kijkt via de antwoorden op deze vier vragen (maximaal 200 woorden per vraag):
  1. Motivatievraag: wat maakt deze functie als technisch manager voor jou uniek of aantrekkelijk in vergelijking met andere functies?
  2. Aansturen organisatie: kun je een situatie beschrijven waarin je moest bepalen wat écht belangrijk was binnen een complexe hoeveelheid informatie? Hoe heb je hoofd- en bijzaken gescheiden en wat was het effect?
  3. Bestuurssensitiviteit: wanneer heb je te maken gehad met uiteenlopende belangen of perspectieven? Hoe heb je deze bij elkaar gebracht en anderen overtuigd?
  4. Motiveren: kun je een situatie beschrijven waarin je een team of groep professionals moest meenemen in een verandering, nieuwe werkwijze of technische keuze? Wat heb je gedaan om draagvlak te creëren en wat was het resultaat?
We raden je aan om een concreet voorbeeld te gebruiken in je antwoord. Het kan je helpen de vraag te beantwoorden volgens de STARR-methode (Situatie, Taak, Actie, Resultaat, Reflectie).

Wil je eerst meer weten?

Neem contact op met afdelingshoofden Leonie Bolwidt via 06 12 99 53 15, met Lieke Vrancken via 06 55 74 51 96 of met Dave Salawan Bessie via 06 52 84 45 81. Zij staan je graag te woord!

Dit bieden we nog meer

Bij ons werk je aan mooie en betekenisvolle projecten voor heel Nederland, in een organisatie die jouw ontwikkeling serieus neemt en je waardeert als professional. Dat zie je ook terug in de arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • 144 vakantie-uren per jaar (bij 36 uur per week)
  • volledige OV-vergoeding of een km-vergoeding van € 0,07 of € 0,23 p/km (zie voorwaarden)
  • mobiele telefoon en laptop
  • budget van € 750 voor inrichting thuiswerkplek + thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,45 p/dag
  • pensioenregeling via ABP

Een omgeving die jou ondersteunt en kansen biedt

  • hybride werken is mogelijk, afgestemd op jouw werkzaamheden en in samenspraak met je leidinggevende
  • persoonlijke groei – opleidingen en loopbaanbegeleiding

Stel je arbeidsvoorwaarden zelf samen, passend bij jouw leven

  • Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) gebruik je IKB-budget van 16,5% van je salaris voor bijvoorbeeld de aflossing van je studieschuld, een (elektrische) fiets inclusief accessoires, bedrijfsfitness, verduurzaming van je woning of andere fiscaalvriendelijke doelen
  • flexibele verlofregelingen (zorg-, ouderschaps-, adoptie- en pleegzorgverlof)
Bekijk hier de volledige CAO van het Rijk.

Dit vragen wij

  • Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor-opleiding in een technische richting, zoals civiele techniek, technische bedrijfskunde, elektrotechniek of werktuigbouwkunde.
  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een leidinggevende functie.
  • Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met vernieuwings- of onderhoudsprojecten in de infrastructuur en kennis van assetmanagement, SCB, SE of RAMS.

Aan competenties breng je mee

  • Aansturen: je houdt overzicht in een complexe omgeving, vertaalt organisatiedoelen naar concrete projectresultaten en geeft richting aan technisch adviseurs.
  • Omgevingsbewustzijn: je begrijpt uiteenlopende belangen, neemt deze mee in technische keuzes en komt tot oplossingen die zowel technisch als bestuurlijk standhouden.
  • Coachen: je geeft richting aan professionals, brengt verschillende disciplines samen en creëert een werkomgeving waarin medewerkers hun expertise optimaal inzetten.

Hier kom je te werken

Over Rijkswaterstaat

Rijkswaterstaat

Rijkswaterstaat is de uitvoeringsorganisatie van het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en bestaat uit 6 landelijke en 7 regionale organisatieonderdelen. Al meer dan 225 jaar werken we dagelijks aan een veilig, leefbaar en bereikbaar Nederland. We beheren en ontwikkelen de rijkswegen, -vaarwegen en -wateren en zetten in op een duurzame leefomgeving. Samen met anderen werken we aan een land dat beschermd is tegen overstromingen. Waar voldoende groen is, en voldoende en schoon water. En waar je vlot en veilig van A naar B kunt. Samenwerken aan een veilig, leefbaar en bereikbaar Nederland: dat is werken bij Rijkswaterstaat.

Talent als basis, diversiteit als kracht

Rijkswaterstaat is een inclusieve organisatie. Een organisatie die ruimte biedt aan iedereen en die de kracht van de diversiteit van medewerkers gebruikt om samen betere resultaten te halen voor Nederland. Inclusief betekent dat iedereen zich betrokken en gewaardeerd voelt; niet ondanks, maar dankzij de verschillen. Daarom nodigen wij jou graag uit, als jij je herkent in deze vacature, om te solliciteren.

Rijkswaterstaat Programma’s, Projecten en Onderhoud

Wil jij werken bij Rijkswaterstaat binnen Programma’s, Projecten en Onderhoud (PPO)? Dit organisatieonderdeel is verantwoordelijk voor het complete onderhoud van alle rijkswegen, vaarwegen, tunnels, bruggen, waterkeringen, sluizen en de bedieningsinstallaties in heel Nederland.

Naast het reguliere onderhoud wordt er onder andere gewerkt aan de renovatie van de IJsselbruggen en de Velsertunnel, de aanleg van de Markerwadden en het onderhoud aan de Maeslantkering. Verder zijn er testprojecten op het gebied van smart mobility, intelligente transportsystemen en het hergebruiken van grondstoffen.

Bij PPO werken onder andere inhoudelijke adviseurs en managers op het gebied van techniek, inkoop, contracten, projectbeheersing en projecten. PPO’ers delen hun kennis onderling en werken elke dag aan de verbetering van hun werkwijzen. Deze organisatie werkt actief samen met de andere onderdelen van Rijkswaterstaat en de diverse externe partners, zoals gemeenten, provincies, waterschappen en marktpartijen.

In totaal werken er ruim 1.200 mensen binnen PPO in 7 verschillende regio’s, verspreid over 4 directies: Inkoop- en Contractmanagement, Productie en Projectmanagement, Techniek en Technisch Management en Bedrijfsvoering en Projectbeheersing.

Wil je zien welke gave projecten we doen, bekijk dan deze video!

Bijzonderheden

  • Je standplaats is Arnhem.
  • Bij Rijkswaterstaat stimuleren we hybride werken. Werk in overleg met je leidinggevende en collega’s vanuit huis of op kantoor wanneer je functie dit toelaat.
  • Met passende kandidaten gaan we graag direct in gesprek, dus kennismakings- en selectiegesprekken vinden doorlopend plaats.
  • Mochten we de juiste kandidaat hebben gevonden dan zullen we de vacature eerder sluiten.
  • Een referentiecheck, een (online) voorselectietest of een assessment kan onderdeel zijn van het sollicitatieproces.
  • Het maken van een casus en (online) screening, bijvoorbeeld via databanken, kan eveneens deel uitmaken van het sollicitatieproces.
  • Het inwinnen van referenties kan deel uitmaken van het sollicitatieproces.
Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature stellen wij niet op prijs.

title: Government and Infrastructure - Risk Consulting-Enterprise Risk, Controls and Resilience - Senior
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

USA – Consulting – G&I – Risk Consulting – Enterprise Risk, Controls & Resilience – Senior

The opportunity

From strategy to execution, the Government & Infrastructure (G&I) practice of Ernst & Young LLP provides a full range of consulting and audit services to help our Federal, State, Local and Education clients implement new ideas to help achieve their mission outcomes. We deliver real change and measurable results through our diverse, high-performing teams, quality work at the highest professional standards, operational know-how from across our global organization, and creative and bold ideas that drive innovation. We enable our government clients to achieve their mission of protecting the nation and serving the people; increasing public safety; improving healthcare for our military, veterans and citizens; delivering essential public services; and helping those in need. EY is ready to help our government build a better working world.

Within G&I Risk Consulting, we help government organizations understand and manage risks that can affect mission outcomes, financial performance, operations and public trust. Our teams build and operate the programs that strengthen governance and controls, improve resilience, prevent fraud and financial loss, manage grant and relief funds, enhance compliance, and enable better risk-informed decisions. Across our work, we use data, AI, automation and technology platforms to improve how risks are identified, assessed, monitored and managed.

Our Enterprise Risk, Controls & Resilience team helps government organizations govern risk, strengthen controls and stay resilient. Our work spans internal controls management (including OMB Circular A-123 and Federal Managers' Financial Integrity Act requirements), internal audit, integrated and enterprise risk management (ERM), enterprise resilience, third-party risk management (including vendor risk management), and ethics and regulatory compliance. We design, transform and operate these programs, using AI, data analytics and Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platforms to automate control testing and monitoring, so that government organizations can achieve and sustain clean audit opinions and make risk-informed decisions.

As a Risk Consulting Senior in our Enterprise Risk, Controls & Resilience team, you will lead the day-to-day execution of engagement workstreams, supervise and coach Staff and SDC team members, and serve as a trusted point of contact for client stakeholders. You will bring depth in this area and contribute meaningfully to how we grow, by building reusable solutions and helping win and expand work.

Your key responsibilities

Client delivery

  • Lead workstreams on internal controls (including OMB Circular A-123 and audit readiness), internal audit, ERM, third-party risk, compliance or resilience engagements: plan the work, set priorities and manage deadlines.
  • Lead walkthroughs and working sessions with process owners; evaluate process and control design; and develop risk and control matrices and test plans for key controls in accordance with OMB Circular A-123 and relevant state internal control and internal audit statutes.
  • Lead internal audit fieldwork and draft audit reports and findings consistent with IIA Global Internal Audit Standards or GAGAS, as applicable.
  • Lead root cause analysis and help process owners design remediation and corrective action plans and validate that remediation is effective.
  • Facilitate risk identification and assessment workshops, and build and maintain risk registers, risk profiles, risk appetite statements and key risk indicators.
  • Lead third-party risk assessments across the vendor lifecycle: define inherent risk and criticality tiering, scope risk-based due diligence, evaluate SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports and other vendor assurance evidence, assess compliance with contract terms, and design ongoing monitoring, including vendor key risk indicators, fourth party and concentration risk analysis, and offboarding.
  • Assess and design ethics and regulatory compliance and resilience programs, including compliance risk assessments and policy updates, business impact analyses, critical process and dependency mapping, scenario analysis, continuity of operations plans, crisis management planning, tabletop exercises and recovery testing.
  • Delegate, supervise and review the work of Staff, and provide timely feedback and on-the-job coaching.
  • Direct and quality-review testing and documentation delivered by Service Delivery Center (SDC) teams, setting clear requirements and acceptance criteria up front.
  • Monitor workstream scope, schedule and budget, and escalate risks, issues and change requests early.

Practice development

  • Build test-procedure libraries, risk taxonomies, key risk indicator libraries, vendor due diligence questionnaires and tiering models, templates and points of view in internal controls, internal audit, ERM, third-party risk, compliance and resilience.
  • Help train and onboard new team members and share knowledge across the practice.

Business development

  • Contribute to proposals: technical approach sections, staffing and level-of-effort input, and qualifications; support orals.
  • Build relationships with client counterparts, spot follow-on needs (e.g., remediation support, ERM maturity, resilience programs, third-party risk program build or managed vendor assessments) and bring them to engagement leadership.

Skills and attributes for success

  • Understanding of internal control and risk frameworks such as the GAO Green Book, COSO Internal Control and COSO ERM, and OMB Circular A-123, including control testing design and execution and risk and control self-assessment
  • Understanding of enterprise risk concepts such as risk identification, risk appetite and tolerance, key risk indicators, scenario analysis, third-party risk and business continuity planning
  • Knowledge of, or experience with, federal business processes such as funds management, budget formulation and execution, receivables, disbursements, property management, human resources, financial reporting and grants management, or comparable state, local and education processes such as benefits programs
  • Knowledge of working paper documentation standards and internal audit standards (e.g., IIA Global Internal Audit Standards, GAGAS)
  • Working knowledge of third-party risk management practices, including vendor risk tiering, due diligence and ongoing monitoring, and the ability to interpret SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports, including scope, carve-outs, exceptions and complementary user entity controls
  • Strong report-writing skills to communicate findings and recommendations to clients
  • Excellent communication skills to discuss observations and negotiate the acquisition of data for testing and reporting on internal controls
  • Ability to work independently with clients and on project teams, and to lead a workstream
  • Ability and willingness to supervise and develop team members
  • Commercial awareness: an understanding of how scope, budget and staffing drive client value and engagement economics
  • Ability to conduct research on regulatory guidance, current industry standards and trends, and new legislation and requirements
  • Knowledge of how to effectively leverage firm approved AI tools to enhance problem-solving and productivity and the ability to exercise sound judgment around AI-related risks and considerations
  • Ability to assess and articulate the evolving risks that AI presents to clients across multiple risk domains, including AI embedded in vendor products and services

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Risk Management, Public Administration or a related discipline; a master's degree is a plus.
  • A minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in internal audit, internal controls, OMB Circular A-123, financial statement audit, audit readiness and control remediation, enterprise risk management, third-party or vendor risk management, compliance or resilience, with a public accounting firm, a professional services firm, a government organization or within industry.
  • Experience leading a workstream or significant engagement tasks and reviewing the work of others.
  • U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance or higher.
  • Flexibility to travel based on client and project needs. Our staffing model assigns professionals to projects aligned to their office's metropolitan area; for federal roles, flexibility to travel up to approximately 30% is preferred, and state, local and education roles may require more.

Ideally, you'll also have

  • Experience with OMB Circular A-123 assessments, financial statement audit, attestation, audit readiness and remediation.
  • Working knowledge of the US Standard General Ledger (USSGL) and the Statements of Federal Financial Accounting Standards (SFFAS).
  • Experience building or operating ERM, third-party or vendor risk management, or continuity and resilience programs, including application of standards such as ISO 22301, ISO 31000 or NIST SP 800-34.
  • Familiarity with state internal control and internal audit statutes (e.g., Massachusetts Chapter 647 of the Acts of 1989, the New York State Governmental Accountability, Audit and Internal Control Act, Section 215.86 of the Florida Statutes, the Texas Internal Auditing Act and the California State Leadership Accountability Act).
  • Hands-on experience with GRC platforms (e.g., Archer, Optro (formerly AuditBoard), ServiceNow), third-party risk management platforms (e.g., ServiceNow Vendor Risk Management, Archer Third Party Governance, OneTrust, ProcessUnity), vendor risk intelligence tools (e.g., BitSight, SecurityScorecard) and analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx).
  • A relevant certification held or in progress, such as CPA, CIA, CGFM, CDFM, RIMS-CRMP, CTPRP or CBCP.

What we look for

At EY, we know it's your point of view, energy and enthusiasm that make the difference. Top performers have experience delivering project plans on large, complex engagements from analysis through implementation. We also look for Seniors who go beyond delivery: people who have contributed to proposals, built reusable tools or methods, coached others and grown client relationships.

What we offer you
At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at

  • We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $105,400 to $175,400

title: L3 Role - Financial Crime Team Manager - Periodic Review - Risk Management - Perm - Newcastle
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

L3 Role – Financial Crime Team Manager – Periodic Review - Risk Management – Perm – Newcastle

Within the professional services environment, the application of risk management procedures is fundamental to the successful delivery of our client services and promotion of our brand.

At Ernst & Young (EY), Risk Management (RM) is an internal function that promotes and supports EY’s firmwide risk management objectives. RM’s aim is to uphold EY’s business standards, protect its reputation, and ensure Partners and staff comply with their regulatory requirements.

Managing financial crime risks relating to money laundering, terrorist financing, bribery and corruption, financial sanctions evasion and fraud is a high priority for EY. Their central Client Due Diligence (CDD) team are vital to that objective. Their job is to support UK, Ireland and Channel Islands Service Line engagement teams with onboarding and ongoing monitoring of clients and engagements.

The opportunity

There is an opening for a permanent Team Manager. The team have oversight of periodic reviews on existing clients, and we are looking for a manager to manage the team and drive performance. You will play a key role in making sure the team meet quality and efficiency targets, support the onshore and offshore team to ensure they stay focused and motivated and build a positive working relationship with the Service Lines that is built on mutual understanding and shared objectives.

This role will report to a Senior Manager who has overall responsibility for the new team.

Your key responsibilities

You will, as a Periodic Review Team Manager, manage and develop a group of Senior Analysts. Responsibilities include:

  • Develop and manage the competence and capacity of the Central CDD team, including the management of operations.
  • Assist with Service Line stakeholder management to promote understanding and awareness of respective responsibilities between client-facing engagement teams and the CDD Team.
  • Provide training and technical guidance to raise awareness.
  • Keeping the team up to date with legal, regulatory and industry practice developments through effective change management processes.
  • Deal with exceptions to process escalations and mandated approvals as delegated by the MLRO/ 2nd Line Financial Crime Team.
  • Assist in the review and maintenance of monitoring procedures, assess engagement risk and update and amend as necessary.
  • Support the Senior Manager, Central CDD, as required.

Skills and attributes for success

  • Experience in managing financial crime regulatory compliance at a similar level in a sophisticated business environment.
  • Excellent subject matter expertise in CDD with experience and knowledge in applying appropriate risk-based approach in relation to simplified, standard and enhanced due diligence.
  • Strong communication skills, capable of dealing with a wide range of staff all the way to a senior level.
  • Experience of managing and developing others.
  • Operational excellence skills in managing and improving quality, and effectively managing change into the team.
  • Adopts a ‘can do’ attitude and acts as a role model for more junior members of the team.
  • Ability to establish a high degree of credibility, respect, and trust at all levels.
  • Proven ability to devise and implement appropriate system and process improvements.
  • Project Management and implementation experience is desirable.
  • Ability to take risk-based decisions and provide substantiated arguments.
  • Effective planning and organising skills to prioritise key areas of responsibility, tasks, and projects.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • At least 5 years’ experience working in a regulated firm’s Know Your Customer/ CDD compliance function and previous experience in a similar managerial role.
  • Proven people management skills, able to develop people relatively new and inexperienced in financial crime.
  • Mature understanding of how to apply a risk-based approach.
  • Relevant professional CDD and/ or AML qualification would be highly beneficial.

Who we seek:

We are looking for a Financial Crime Manager with experience working in a large, matrixed environment with a strong track record of success particularly in building and implementing financial crime processes and controls.

EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. description:

Together, we're redefining what it means to travel safely and with confidence. Whether it's a long-awaited holiday, a last-minute business trip, or an unexpected detour, we deliver in the moments that matter.

What you'll be doing:

In this role, you'll strengthen the connection between business strategy and technology priorities across North America. Working closely with senior business and technology leaders, you'll shape demand, establish clear priorities, and help ensure technology investments, resources, and delivery capacity are aligned to the priorities that matter most to the business.

We're committed to helping our people thrive through a comprehensive onboarding experience, continuous professional development, and a supportive work environment that empowers growth at every stage of your career.

Take the time you need, for you and your community. We encourage you to take the time you need when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme.

Investing in your health and your future. We offer a competitive high-deductible health plan, EAP programs and access to health and well-being activities along with a 401(k) program with employer matching to help you plan for your future.

Diversity and inclusion. We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. Wherever life has taken you, we welcome you to bring your whole self to work. Just be you - because that's exactly who we're looking for.
