title: Process Engineering Professional
description:
Process Engineering Professional

Your impact begins here

As Process Engineering Professional in Kalundborg, you will help keep production stable, capable and improving, working on the line rather than behind a desk. You will analyse performance, find the root cause of equipment and production issues, and put improvements in place together with operators and technical colleagues. Your work helps production run reliably, with the quality and capacity needed to support people living with serious chronic diseases.


What you’ll bring

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, such as Mechanical, Electrical or a related field. Mechanical Engineering is particularly relevant.
  • 2+ years of professional experience in engineering, production support or technical improvement within manufacturing, including pharmaceutical, food or other industries.
  • Hands-on production experience and confidence working directly with operators and skilled workers on the production floor.
  • Ability to analyse data, troubleshoot technical issues and apply structured root cause analysis.
  • Ability to plan technical tasks, coordinate stakeholders and follow actions through to completion.
  • Ability to communicate technical information clearly in English and collaborate effectively with local production teams.
  • An analytical, systematic and hands-on approach, with ownership and sound judgement when balancing production, safety and quality needs.


Useful, but not essential:

  • Experience in regulated manufacturing, including knowledge of GMP, change control, deviations, qualification or validation.
  • An advanced degree in Engineering.

What you’ll do

You will connect production data with the production floor, helping identify losses early, solve problems at the source and sustain improvements.

  • Analyse production downtime, rejects and performance trends to identify losses and emerging issues.
  • Troubleshoot process and equipment issues with operators and skilled workers, document findings and verify corrective actions.
  • Apply structured problem solving to identify root causes, plan and run trials and improvements under approved procedures, and confirm sustained results.
  • Contribute to change controls, risk assessments and technical documentation, assessing changes with relevant stakeholders.
  • Provide process input on equipment changes, supplier evaluations, testing and production ramp-up, while communicating progress, risks and dependencies.
  • Follow up on production and maintenance issues and escalate safety, quality, capacity and delivery risks to the appropriate owner.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Maintenance & Engineering in Kalundborg, part of Global Manufacturing & Supply. Your day-to-day partners will be production teams, operators and skilled workers, along with Equipment Responsible colleagues, maintenance, automation, engineering and Quality Assurance. You will also work with the ramp-up team, technical specialists and suppliers. Early, open conversations with these partners help you align priorities and keep work moving.

The role is based in Kalundborg, Denmark. Occasional workshop attendance abroad may be required.

What you can expect here

You will work in a team that values hands-on expertise and trusts you to take ownership within clear priorities and approved procedures. You will learn from experienced colleagues, share your own knowledge, and build new skills through practical work across production, automation, maintenance and quality.

You will be supported to perform at your best and encouraged to speak up when things stall, so that problems are solved and improvements are delivered with pace and care.

What we offer

At Novo, you will join a global healthcare company with a distinctive culture and a strong track record. We offer continuous learning, career development and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary: The annual base salary for this role ranges from DKK 499,600 to DKK 734,400, depending on the level of the position. Placement within the range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits: The compensation package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives, together with other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring problem-solving to the production line and turn data into lasting improvements in Kalundborg, apply for the Process Engineering Professional role by 9 November 2026.

title: AI-Native Security Engineer - Senior
description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

AI systems are moving from generating content to taking action across data, tools, and business processes. You will make that agency defensible by embedding security throughout the lifecycle, turning emerging threats into practical controls that help teams pursue ambitious AI use cases safely.

This is a builder role for someone who enjoys both finding flaws and creating the safer path. You will work alongside product and engineering teams, prove controls under adversarial conditions, and replace one-off reviews with reusable patterns, measurable coverage, clear evidence, and rehearsed ways to respond when systems behave unexpectedly.

About Challenger

Challenger is a new EY program focused on building the firm’s next generation of services. It pursues opportunities where AI enables a fundamentally different service and way of delivering it, including rethinking existing offerings and developing new ones.

Small, dedicated teams build and test ideas in real conditions. Solutions that demonstrate clear business value and operational readiness transition to the business for adoption and scale.

Challenger Core develops and maintains the shared technology, methods, and risk and quality guardrails that support this work. Each team contributes reusable tools and practices, helping make the next service faster and less costly to build.

Your key responsibilities

  • Set the security direction. Own reusable AI security patterns, control objectives, reference architectures, and threat models aligned to the risk and autonomy of each use case.
  • Join builders early. Work with teams before key design choices are fixed, identifying credible attack paths and shaping controls that fit the product and delivery model.
  • Design scoped authority. Create practical patterns for identity, access, isolation, approvals, and recovery so tool-using AI acts within clear and enforceable boundaries.
  • Protect sensitive information. Embed security across the data lifecycle, preserving confidentiality, integrity, provenance, permitted use, and monitored access.
  • Secure the delivery path. Integrate automated security tests, policy gates, trusted artifacts, traceable changes, and safe rollback into engineering workflows.
  • Test adversarially. Run focused red-team exercises against AI-specific abuse cases and convert findings into repeatable tests, stronger platform patterns, and actionable guidance.
  • Build runtime protection. Use end-to-end evidence and behavioral signals to detect abnormal actions, privilege misuse, attempted exfiltration, and degrading controls.
  • Strengthen response. Support vulnerability triage and incidents with clear evidence, containment options, recovery actions, and lessons that improve future designs.
  • Advise on residual risk. Give product, security, evaluation, and risk leaders concise technical recommendations while keeping approval and risk-acceptance decisions with accountable owners.
  • Build shared capability. Create reference implementations, coach engineers, and turn production lessons into reusable controls that make the safer path easier to adopt.

Skills and attributes for success

  • Security engineering depth: Strong foundations in application, cloud, platform, identity, data, and software delivery security.
  • AI threat judgment: Ability to model how prompts, retrieval, agents, tools, users, and external services create new attack paths and failure modes.
  • Control engineering: Experience translating threats into preventive, detective, and responsive measures that engineers can implement and operate.
  • Adversarial mindset: Practical skill in red teaming, reproducible testing, vulnerability analysis, detection, and incident learning.
  • Automation capability: Ability to build security tests, controls, telemetry, and reference components and integrate them into delivery pipelines.
  • Pragmatic influence: Clear communication and product judgment, with the ability to explain risk without drama, vagueness, or implied approval authority.

To qualify you must have

  • 5+ years of relevant experience.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field.
  • Relevant experience: Substantial experience in product, application, cloud, platform, or detection security, including hands-on ownership of production controls.
  • Threat modeling: Demonstrated ability to assess complex systems and turn attack paths into practical engineering measures.
  • Production security: Experience securing modern applications, cloud environments, identities, data, networks, and software delivery pipelines.
  • AI systems knowledge: Working understanding of generative and agentic AI, including retrieval, model access, tool use, evaluation, and runtime behavior.
  • Hands-on automation: Experience building or extending security tests, controls, telemetry, reference implementations, or adversarial assessments.
  • Response experience: Evidence of supporting vulnerability or incident response and translating lessons into stronger technical controls.
  • Cross-functional delivery: A record of partnering with engineers and risk functions to improve security while respecting user value and delivery constraints.
  • Travel and On-site requirements: This role requires up to 50% travel and flexibility to go into the office in a hybrid capacity.

Ideally, you’ll also have

  • Agentic security: Experience securing tool-using agents, AI gateways, model-serving platforms, retrieval systems, or other high-autonomy applications.
  • High-assurance delivery: Experience in regulated, safety-relevant, or multi-region environments with formal evidence and response requirements.
  • Detection engineering: Experience designing behavioral analytics and investigation evidence for distributed or AI-enabled systems.
  • Supplier and supply-chain risk: Experience assessing external AI services, dependencies, trusted artifacts, and exit or containment options.
  • Industry contribution: Practical contributions to AI security research, responsible disclosure, open-source tooling, privacy technology, standards, or professional communities.

At Mitsubishi Power, we’re not just building better clean energy technologies; we’re architecting a better future. Our team is boldly redefining power generation and energy storage to fast-track the world’s energy transition. We operate as one team, pushing toward our vision of the future.

Role Overview

Plan, develop, and implement plans and procedures to achieve the quality strategy and goals.

Lead the implementation and ongoing management of a unified Quality Management System (QMS) across multiple business units.

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and Experience

Personal Traits

Mathematical Skills

Reasoning Ability

  • Ability to influence decisions and compel action in a complex environment

  • Ability to define problems, collect and analyze data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions

  • Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables

Computer Skills

Certifications

title: Embedded Software Intern (m/f/d)
description:
Honeywell is a Fortune 100 technology company that develops innovative solutions to some of the world's most important challenges, including safety, security, sustainability, and energy efficiency.

Within Honeywell Building Technologies, we are shaping the future of connected commercial buildings through intelligent energy management and IoT-enabled solutions. We are looking for an enthusiastic Embedded Software Intern to join our engineering team in Horsham and contribute to the development of next-generation Building Energy Management System (BEMS) controllers.

As part of an Agile Scrum team, you will work alongside experienced software engineers and architects, gaining hands-on experience developing embedded software that powers real-world products. You'll contribute to communication protocols, IoT connectivity, and control algorithms while learning industry best practices in software design and development.

We are particularly interested in students who demonstrate a genuine passion for technology through personal projects, hackathons, open-source contributions, maker activities, or other initiatives outside of their academic studies. We're looking for someone who is curious, eager to learn, and excited to bring their own ideas and creativity to the team.

  • Develop and enhance embedded software features for Honeywell's Building Energy Management System controllers.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, architects, and test engineers within an Agile Scrum environment.
  • Contribute to software design and implementation using object-oriented programming principles.
  • Support the development of communication protocols, IoT connectivity solutions, and control algorithms.
  • Participate in testing, debugging, code reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Share ideas, take initiative, and contribute to technical discussions across the team.
  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Exposure to C++ is a plus; experience with Java, C#, or other object-oriented programming languages is also welcome.
  • Interest in embedded software development and real-world product engineering.
  • Evidence of personal projects, open-source contributions, hackathons, or other extracurricular technical activities.
  • Understanding of object-oriented programming concepts; knowledge of embedded systems, UML, or IoT technologies would be advantageous.
  • Passion for technology, a willingness to learn, and the confidence to share ideas and take initiative in a collaborative team environment.

Posting: 5819

Job Summary

Under supervision of the Recreation Services Manager or designate, this position provides responsive and reliable customer service at recreation facilities.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Reconciles shift revenue collection reports, investigates transaction discrepancies and makes reconciliation adjustments in accordance with established policies and procedures. Maintains an inventory for admission passes, gift certificates, bulk tickets, and parking permits, in accordance with the established procedure.
  • Processes activity-space rental and major event contracts for indoor leisure centres, seasonal sport facilities and special use parks or other recreation facilities; prints rental log-in reports following the established policy and procedure.
  • Investigates, and responds to, related complaints and enquiries in accordance with established policy and procedure, resolves customer problems and directs customers to appropriate civic department.
  • Supervises and trains staff in the performance of customer service duties, cash handling, program registration and facility booking. Assists with scheduling and monitoring work performance of assigned staff at assigned recreation facilities.
  • Processes general admission, pass sales, program registration, activity-space rental payment and locker revenue collection; receives customers entering recreation facilities.
  • Provides program and service information including schedules, program description, policy explanation and facility rental information.
  • Acts as liaison with rental groups and site staff to arrange for rental/event booking, including equipment and activity set-up and take-down.
  • Processes program registrations, including collection of fees, class transfers, withdrawals and refunds; prints program registration reports for distribution. Enters program information into, and modifies information in, the automated program registration system and cancels programs as directed.
  • Processes subsidized facility rental for designated sports groups and informs them, regularly, of the account balance.
  • Provides office support, e.g. photocopying, filing, typing, for program staff, maintains inventory of office supplies and ensures office equipment is working properly.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education, Training and Experience Requirements:

  • Grade 12 education.
  • 1 year certificate in business or related area
  • Three years’ progressive work experience in detailed cash handling and balancing, including one year in a customer service work environment.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills:

  • Thorough knowledge of automated revenue collection systems, e.g. computerized cash register.
  • Considerable knowledge of current office management practices, procedures and systems.
  • Knowledge of customer service principles and practices.
  • Knowledge of accounting principles, concepts and procedures.
  • Demonstrated ability to supervise assigned staff.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships.

  • Ability to resolve customer problems, exercise good judgement and make timely decisions in accordance with established policy and procedure.
  • Ability to interact with customers and remain calm when dealing with all customers during high volume periods.
  • Ability to understand and comprehend moderately complex revenue collection procedures and make accurate arithmetic calculations.
  • Ability to communicate effectively, orally and in writing, including effective interpersonal communications skills.

Acceptable current Criminal Record Check (CRC) upon offer of employment.

Evening and weekend work are involved.

title: QA/QC supervisor
description:
Your Company:
NET Recruit is proud to be partnering with a leading engineering business operating within the renewable energy and electrical infrastructure sectors to recruit a QA/QC Supervisor for its team in the Stourbridge area.
The organisation delivers a range of engineering services across major projects, including project management, design, procurement, construction, commissioning and maintenance. With a focus on quality, safety and technical excellence, the business plays an important role in delivering reliable infrastructure and supporting the continued development of the energy sector.
This is an excellent opportunity for a quality-focused professional to take responsibility for quality assurance and quality control activities, helping ensure engineering works meet the required standards, specifications and regulatory requirements.

Your Role and Responsibilities:
While in this position your duties may include but may not be limited to:
  • Supervising quality assurance and quality control activities across engineering projects to ensure work is completed in line with approved specifications, procedures and quality standards.
  • Developing, reviewing and maintaining quality documentation, inspection plans, test plans and relevant project records.
  • Monitoring project activities to ensure compliance with contractual requirements, technical specifications and applicable industry standards.
  • Coordinating inspections, audits and quality checks throughout project delivery, identifying potential issues and ensuring they are addressed promptly.
  • Working closely with project managers, engineers, site teams and subcontractors to promote a consistent approach to quality.
  • Identifying non-conformances, investigating their causes and coordinating corrective and preventive actions.
  • Maintaining accurate quality records, inspection reports and documentation to support project handover and demonstrate compliance.
  • Supporting internal and external quality audits, ensuring findings are recorded and followed through to completion.
  • Reviewing technical documentation and inspection results to identify areas for improvement and ensure quality requirements are met.
  • Monitoring subcontractor and supplier performance in relation to quality, ensuring delivered materials and completed works meet the required standards.
  • Promoting a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging high standards of workmanship and effective quality management throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Providing guidance to colleagues on quality procedures, documentation and best practice.
  • Working alongside health and safety and project delivery teams to ensure quality requirements are integrated into site activities.
What You Will Need to Apply:
  • Previous experience in a QA/QC, quality engineering, inspection or quality supervision role within an engineering, construction or electrical infrastructure environment.
  • A sound understanding of quality assurance and quality control principles, including inspection, testing, documentation and audit processes.
  • Experience identifying non-conformances and implementing corrective actions to resolve quality issues.
  • The ability to interpret technical specifications, engineering documentation and project requirements.
  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage documentation, inspections and competing priorities effectively.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to work with engineers, project managers, subcontractors and other stakeholders.
  • A proactive and methodical approach, with strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining high standards.
  • The ability to identify opportunities for improvement and support consistent quality practices across projects.
  • A good understanding of relevant industry standards and regulatory requirements.
What You Will Get in Return:
In return, you will receive a competitive salary, dependent on your experience and technical knowledge, alongside the opportunity to join an established engineering business working on important infrastructure and renewable energy projects.
You will have the chance to take ownership of quality activities, collaborate with experienced engineering professionals and contribute to the successful delivery of technically challenging projects. The organisation also offers opportunities for professional development and career progression, with support to expand your knowledge and strengthen your expertise within the engineering sector.

To express interest in this role and have a confidential chat, please reach out to:

Christina Smith - Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist

Works closely with multidisciplinary teams, contractors, and clients to facilitate efficient project workflows and ensure deliverables are completed in accordance with project objectives. Plays a key role in tracking project progress, maintaining documentation, and communicating updates to internal and external stakeholders.

Your Impact

  • Coordinates daily project activities by working closely with internal teams, clients, vendors, and contractors to ensure tasks are completed on schedule and align with project objectives. Provide high level coordination/administrative and analytic support to client.
  • Monitors project progress by tracking key performance indicators, identifying potential risks or delays, and reporting findings to senior team members.
  • Prepares and maintains project documentation, including progress reports, meeting minutes, risk assessments, change orders, and project closeout reports.
  • Supports the management of project budgets by assisting in tracking expenses, reviewing cost estimates, and ensuring expenditures align with approved budgets.
  • Helps identify and address routine challenges during project execution, escalating complex issues to senior staff when necessary. Assess project risks and issues and provide solutions where applicable.
  • Assists in preparing presentations, reports, and status updates for project meetings, senior management, and clients. Facilitate, organize, attend and participate in stakeholder meetings.
  • Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of relevant post-education experience in a project management support role within the architecture, engineering, or construction industry.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, or a related major, or equivalent experience in a technical or engineering firm.
  • Basic understanding of project management principles and processes, with a focus on coordination and communication.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, and familiarity with basic project management software.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with an ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Familiarity with relevant environmental and construction laws, codes, regulations, compliance practices, and record-keeping requirements.
  • Competent interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others, expressing ideas effectively and professionally to an engineering and non-engineering audience.
  • Proficient self-leadership with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to work independently under general supervision, as well as part of a team to meet business objectives.

title: Executive Director, Diversified Industries M&A
description:
Job Summary

The Executive Director will be responsible for supporting the implementation of the M&A strategy within Diversified Industries and providing industry expertise to support client transactions

This role will be responsible for originating and providing Industrials sector expertise to support clients. They will bring coverage and product execution capabilities in order to focus on strategic deals (M&A, Corporate Finance, Financial and Capital Markets). They will also work closely as a team with the Relationship Managers, other M&A bankers and Product Partners to deepen client relationships and drive revenue and returns growth.

Responsibilities:

• Support the M&A Europe business strategy and budget in the context of M&A strategy, and recommending them for approval by the relevant governing body.
• Assist in the implementation of M&A client segment strategy, including a global customer value proposition, as a framework within which the client segments and product groups operate and ensuring the CF marketing strategy supports this.
• Delivery of agreed business performance and cost across the M&A Europe business.
• Maintenance of the integrity of client data which is owned by M&A.
• Support the product development for M&A Europe.
• Strengthen the M&A Process Universe allocated to the Head of M&A, Europe by the Group’s Operational Risk Type Framework (ORTF). Accountable to the risk control owners and/or Group policy owners for implementation of policies and control standards set by them, ensuring compliance and operating within risk tolerance and risk appetite.
• Ensure compliance with regulations, financial crime, escalating material risk in accordance with the Group’s Enterprise Risk Management Framework (ERMF), building a culture of good conduct within M&A Europe, in accordance with the Group’s ORTF.
• Work with the following people who have responsibility for other activities of the business:

Regional teams, who are responsible for overseeing the implementation of regional and country strategies. Each of them is also responsible for ensuring that country regulations are taken into account and complied with and that issues related to regulatory compliance are identified and resolved, country or entity balance sheet management and capital sufficiency, and monitoring, managing and escalating material risks in accordance with the Group's ERMF. Group and Regional Function teams, who are responsible for those policies, procedures and processes that they own that impact M&A Europe.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy
• Support the implementation of M&A Europe client segment strategies, market and positioning strategies, including a global customer value proposition, as a framework within which the client segments and product groups operate and ensuring the M&A Europe marketing strategy supports this. Such strategies must be aligned to the overall strategic direction of CF and the Group as well as the Group Code of Conduct.
• Work with the Regional teams of GB, CB and FM to ensure that the M&A Europe business is aligned with the needs and business plans of Regional and Country operations.
• Work to meet the clear milestones against which the progress of the M&A Europe strategy implementation is measured.

Business

• Support the Head of M&A, Europe in setting achievable M&A Europe business global performance targets relating to revenue and costs.
• Delivery of agreed business performance and cost across M&A Europe.
• Drive financial performance to monitor financial results against targets and manage the cost budget within M&A Europe, including meeting long term economic revenue (ER) goals and RWA targets.
• Develop a culture which understands and evaluates the constant trade-offs between new business, risk and capital deployment.
• Ensure the suitability and appropriateness of products through a robust framework and consider material issues at the appropriate governing committees.
• Maintain and manage a framework to deal with vulnerable clients.

Processes
• Support the Head of M&A, Europe to manage the implementation of policies and control standards set by risk control owners and policy owners, ensuring compliance and operating within risk tolerance and risk appetite. Ensure the adequacy and effectiveness of the systems, controls and procedures relating to M&A Europe, that they are regularly and independently tested, assessed and improved in a timely manner.
• Drive continuous improvement of the operational efficiency and effectiveness of processes to increase the consistency of global systems and processes.
• Ensure that systems, controls and procedures are commensurate with the nature, scale and complexity of the M&A Europe business, taking into account of all relevant circumstances (including the external environment).
• Ensure there is a framework for effective management of operational risks within M&A Europe and compliance with applicable internal policies, and external laws and regulations.
• Support the delivery of the M&A Europe strategy in a safe and well-controlled manner and on an end-to-end basis – incorporating infrastructure requirements and building a business that is fit-for-growth.

People & Talent
• Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations for M&A Europe business and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.

Risk Management
• Support the Head of M&A, Europe to ensure there are appropriate frameworks in place so that the M&A Europe business is carried out within the Group’s risk appetite and reputational and credit risks are appropriately managed in conjunction with direct reports and other stakeholders.
• Comply with the highest standards of regulatory conduct and compliance standards and practices as defined by internal and external requirements. This includes compliance with anti-money laundering regulations and guidelines.
• Ensure any audit and compliance issues relating to the M&A Europe business are resolved in a timely manner.
• Ensure that Risk Management matters that are brought to the job-holder’s attention are subject to direct remedial action and/or escalated, where appropriate to relevant risk committees.

Governance
• Adhere to SCB Governance frameworks

Skills and Experience

• Financial analysis
• Financial modelling
• Valuation
• Transaction documentation (eg SPA etc)
• Negotiation
• Presentation skills

Qualifications

Education in Finance or related discipline
Licenses - FCA Certified

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What we offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.

Day Shift: Monday through Friday, working 8-hour shifts.

We know it's not just about finding a job. It's about finding a place where you are respected, valued, and where your work is purposeful and fulfilling. A place where your talent is recognized, professional development is encouraged and career advancement is possible.

Opportunities for Career Advancement

Rewards & Recognition Programs

Exclusive Discounts and Perks

Job Summary

The Pre-Registration Representative is responsible for pre-registering scheduled patients prior to their appointments, ensuring the accurate collection of demographic, insurance, and financial information. This role supports efficient patient access by verifying insurance coverage, obtaining necessary authorizations, and communicating financial obligations to patients. The Pre-Registration Representative works across multiple registration settings, including the Emergency Department, Outpatient Services, and Admissions, to facilitate smooth check-ins and minimize delays.

Essential Functions

  • Pre-registers scheduled patients by obtaining and verifying demographic, insurance, and financial information before their appointment.
  • Ensures accurate collection of patient deductibles, co-payments, and coinsurance following facility guidelines.
  • Verifies insurance eligibility and benefits using electronic verification systems and contacts insurance companies as needed.
  • Uses the electronic registration system to enter and update patient information, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
  • Obtains informed consent and scans required documents, including patient identification, insurance cards, and physician orders.
  • Protects patient health information (PHI) by adhering to HIPAA and facility policies regarding confidentiality.
  • Communicates financial obligations to patients, provides payment plan options, and documents collection activities.
  • Assists in reducing patient wait times by ensuring all pre-registration steps are completed before arrival.
  • Provides professional customer service by greeting patients, addressing inquiries, and directing them as needed.
  • Ensures compliance with state, Joint Commission (TJC), and other regulatory agency requirements.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • Post secondary education or training in medical office administration or healthcare administration preferred
  • 0-2 years of experience in a customer service role required
  • 0-2 years of experience in a healthcare setting including patient registration, medical office scheduling, or front desk/admissions required

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Proficiency in patient registration systems, insurance verification tools, and financial counseling processes.
  • Strong understanding of medical insurance policies, prior authorization requirements, and payment collection procedures.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills to interact professionally with patients, families, and healthcare staff.
  • Ability to handle sensitive patient information with a high level of confidentiality and compliance with HIPAA regulations.
  • Strong problem-solving skills to resolve registration and insurance-related issues efficiently.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills to manage multiple patient interactions and administrative duties.

title: Shipping Technician II (2nd Shift)
description:
Eaton’s ES AMER ARS division is currently seeking a Shipping Technician II (2nd Shift) to join our team in Greenwood, SC!

This is a 2nd shift role with core hours from 3:30 pm - 11:30 pm, M-F.

The hourly rate for this position is $20.00 per hour + $1 per hour shift premium. .
This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

What you’ll do:

The Shipping & Receiving Associate is responsible for executing all daily outbound and inbound logistics activities to support manufacturing operations. This role ensures accurate, timely, and compliant shipment processing, inventory transactions, documentation, and material handling while maintaining high standards for safety, quality, and operational excellence.

In this function you will:
• Execute daily shipping and receiving activities in alignment with operational priorities and schedules.
• Monitor and prioritize hot shipments using PowerBI and ensure urgent orders are processed on time.
• Prepare, stage, load, and label outbound shipments according to the shipping plan.
• Create and maintain load sheets, shipment records, and documentation in AS400 and Vista.

• Conduct visual inspections to ensure material quality and identify nonconforming items.
• Identify shipping or inventory discrepancies, submit error reports through SharePoint, and follow up as needed.
• Maintain accurate system updates to support inventory control, traceability, and reporting.
• Operate material handling equipment (forklift, pallet jack) and assist with crating, boxing, and packaging activities.
• Communicate daily pass‑down information across shifts to ensure continuity of operations.
• Proactively identify process improvement opportunities and support root cause analysis efforts.
• Comply with all Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) requirements and sustain 5S+ standards.
• Safely lift, move, and transport materials using proper lifting techniques and assistive devices.
• Assist with general clerical duties, including data entry, administrative support, and customer service–related tasks.

Required (Basic) Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent from an accredited institution.
  • Forklift or Pallet Jack Certification OR the ability to be trained upon hire.

  • Ability to read and interpret shipping documents and schedules.

Skills:

  • Ability to lift and carry up to 40 lbs. with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to push or pull up to 100 lbs. with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, and operate material handling equipment for extended periods with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Basic computer skills and ability to navigate enterprise systems (AS400, Vista, PowerBI preferred).

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

EY’s Digital Risk practice is supporting leading Technology, Media & Telecommunications (TMT) companies as they scale cloud-native, AI-enabled, and platform-based operating models. Based in the Northeast Region, this role sits at the forefront of innovation, working with high-growth and global technology organizations operating on microservices architectures and AI-driven engineering environments.

We are seeking a Manager to support risk, compliance, and control transformation across highly automated and continuously evolving ecosystems. This role requires a combination of SOX knowledge, cloud architecture understanding, and familiarity with modern software development practices, including AI-assisted coding and product development lifecycles (PDLC/SDLC).

You will work closely with senior team members and client stakeholders, including finance, technology, and engineering teams, to support the design and implementation of scalable, audit-ready risk and compliance frameworks within complex technology environments.

Your key responsibilities

As a Manager in our Digital Risk practice, you will support the delivery of complex Digital Risk engagements, owning key workstreams and contributing to overall program execution across cloud-native environments. You will work closely with senior leadership and client stakeholders to drive risk and control initiatives within modern technology ecosystems.

In this role, you will:

  • Execute and manage workstreams across cloud platforms, microservices architectures, and AI-enabled development environments, including risk assessments, control design, and testing activities
  • Support client engagement teams by working directly with stakeholders (e.g., finance, IT, engineering) to deliver clear, actionable insights and recommendations
  • Oversee day-to-day delivery, including coordination of team members, tracking progress, and ensuring quality and timeliness of deliverables
  • Contribute to engagement performance, including resource management, status tracking, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities

  • Design and evaluate controls across DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, SDLC/PDLC processes, and distributed platforms, including APIs, microservices, data environments, and AI-enabled systems

Demonstrate strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, and modern engineering practices, applying that knowledge to support the design and assessment of scalable control solutions.

Exhibit an AI-aware risk mindset, with the ability to identify risks introduced by AI-assisted development and automated engineering workflows. Demonstrate architecture fluency, interpreting system interactions and data flows to support control design and evaluation.

Build engineering credibility, partnering effectively with DevOps, platform, and data teams within complex environments. Apply your TMT industry knowledge to understand evolving risks within high-growth, technology-driven organizations.

Communicate clearly and effectively, translating technical risk concepts into practical business insights for client stakeholders while contributing to overall delivery quality.

Operate with attention to detail and accountability, managing competing priorities while contributing to high-quality outcomes and continuous improvement.

To qualify for the role you must have:

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in business, accounting, computer science, engineering, or a related field
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in Digital Risk, IT risk, or technology consulting, with exposure to TMT sector clients
  • Hands-on experience in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS), microservices architectures, DevOps/CI/CD, SDLC/PDLC, and distributed systems
  • Experience supporting:
    • IT general controls (ITGCs) and automated control environments
    • Risk assessments, control testing, and control design activities
    • Technology risk engagements within cloud-native or distributed environments
  • Understanding of how regulatory and control frameworks (e.g., SOX, internal controls) apply within modern engineering environments
  • Exposure to data platforms and AI-enabled development environments
  • Willingness to travel at least 50%, including client-site travel. Flexibility to work extended hours as needed.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

Relevant certifications such as CPA, CISA, CISSP, CISM; cloud certifications (e.g., AWS) or AI-related certifications are a plus

What we look for

We’re looking for individuals who are comfortable operating at the intersection of risk, engineering, and technology, and who are motivated to build technical depth within modern, fast-evolving environments.

The right candidate will be able to work through complex problems, collaborate effectively with both technical teams and business stakeholders, and contribute to delivering clear, actionable insights.

A proactive mindset, strong attention to detail, and the ability to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions in fast-paced, high-growth environments will be key to success.

title: Security Software Engineering Manager, SEAR
description:
The SPEAR team in Apple’s Security Engineering & Architecture organization is hiring a collaborative system software engineering manager with a drive to improve the security of end-user devices.

SPEAR is a dedicated team of software engineers who make highly impactful security improvements across all of Apple’s operating systems. We design and implement security hardening measures that eliminate whole classes of vulnerabilities. This includes accelerating the transition to memory-safe languages and undertaking deep refactors to reorient key system components to build security into their core. Our work results in significant improvements to the security of Apple’s products without compromising the stability and performance that over a billion users rely on every day.

As an engineering manager in SPEAR, you will lead projects in collaboration with other teams across the lower levels of Apple’s software stack to harden the security of our operating systems. Your team will deliver well-designed, robust, and maintainable system software features that meaningfully improve end-user security. The team will be on the leading edge of responsible AI adoption, unlocking new possibilities to achieve ambitious security goals with higher quality than was previously attainable. As a leader in a growing organization, you will hire and develop talented engineers who will help set the standard for cross-functional collaboration and engineering excellence.

As a result of the collective effort of dedicated engineers like yourself, Apple’s products are the most secure consumer devices on the market. Our mission is to continue to advance the state of the art in software security. Our goal isn’t simply to be the most secure: we’re working to ensure the safety of every user’s digital life, even against the most malicious and well-resourced adversaries.

As a Software Engineering Manager in SPEAR, you will:

Lead and manage a team of collaborative software engineers improving the security of critical low-level operating system software. Grow the team by hiring and developing top engineering talent at all experience levels. Manage ambitious software security projects through their entire lifecycle, including concept, design, implementation, testing, and handoff phases. Foster a collaborative team culture, leading by example to approach every challenge as an opportunity to deepen mutual understanding and respect through creative problem solving. description:

The Role at a Glance

We are seeking an experienced Director of Customer Experience to lead and scale Customer Experience capabilities across Workplace Solutions. This leader will bring deep, hands-on CX expertise and a demonstrated track record of building mature, repeatable practices that embed customer-centered decision-making across an organization. In this role, you will set the CX strategy and operating model, strengthen governance and measurement, and create the tools, standards, and ways of working that enable teams across Product, Operations, Technology, Digital, Marketing, and Distribution to consistently improve the experience. You will champion the voice of the customer while connecting customer insights and experience improvements to measurable business outcomes, including growth, retention, efficiency, and differentiation.

This is not a role focused solely on journey mapping or Voice of Customer programs. We are looking for a proven CX leader who has helped an organization move from individual projects to an integrated, enterprise-scale CX capability. You will influence senior leaders, develop talent, build cross-functional commitment, and translate customer needs into clear priorities, investment decisions, and sustained change.

What you'll be doing

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Customer Experience professionals, setting clear expectations and building the strategic, analytical, and influencing capabilities needed to deliver meaningful impact.
• Define and execute a scalable CX strategy and operating model, including governance, standards, roles, decision rights, prioritization, and cross-functional ways of working.
• Build and mature the organization's CX capabilities by establishing repeatable methods, tools, training, and frameworks that enable teams to apply customer-centered practices consistently and independently.
• Partner with senior leaders across Product, Operations, Technology, Digital, Marketing, and Distribution to embed customer needs into business strategy, transformation roadmaps, investment decisions, and solution design.
• Establish an enterprise approach to journey management that identifies priority journeys, clarifies ownership, connects insights across touchpoints, and drives coordinated improvement over time.
• Integrate Voice of Customer, research, behavioral and operational data, market intelligence, and employee insights to identify root causes, size opportunities, and inform strategic recommendations.
• Translate complex customer and business challenges into actionable strategies, business cases, executive-level recommendations, and sequenced roadmaps.
• Define and monitor a CX measurement framework that connects experience outcomes to business results such as growth, retention, utilization, digital adoption, cost, and operational performance.
• Drive adoption and accountability through change leadership, stakeholder engagement, communication, and capability-building across the organization.
• Champion the thoughtful use of AI and emerging technologies to improve customer outcomes, increase efficiency, and create competitive advantage.

What we’re looking for

Must-haves:
• 5+ years of progressive CX experience, including CX strategy, journey management, customer insights, experience measurement, service design, or related disciplines
• Demonstrated experience building, scaling, or maturing a CX practice across a complex organization, including establishing operating models, governance, standards, tools, measurement, and cross-functional adoption
• 3+ years of people leadership experience, with a track record of developing high-performing teams and leading through influence in a matrixed environment
• Experience translating customer insights and journey opportunities into enterprise priorities, funded roadmaps, measurable improvements, and business outcomes
• Strong executive presence and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and gain alignment across functions with competing priorities
• Strong business acumen and the ability to connect CX investments to growth, retention, efficiency, risk reduction, and market differentiation
• Demonstrated change leadership experience, including building organizational commitment, establishing accountability, and driving sustained adoption of new CX practices
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of a Bachelor's degree)

Nice-to-haves:
• Recognized Customer Experience certification, such as CCXP, or comparable certification in human-centered design, service design, design thinking, or change management
• Experience leading CX in financial services, insurance, employee benefits, retirement, or another regulated and complex service environment
• Working knowledge of Group Benefits and/or Retirement Plans
• Experience applying AI, analytics, and emerging technologies to improve customer experiences and operational outcomes

title: Gate-level Noise (Signal Integrity) / STA CAD Engineer
description:
Imagine what you could do here! At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products very quickly. Do you want to bring passion and dedication to your job? There's no telling what you could accomplish at Apple. The people who work here have reinvented entire industries with Apple Hardware products. The same real passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices - we continue to strengthen our commitment to leave the world better than we found it! As a member of the CAD group, you will support the gate-level glitch noise and static timing analysis (STA) methodologies that ensure the signal integrity and robustness of Apple silicon across advanced technology nodes. In this role, you will learn and apply sign-off methodologies, margin models, and production CAD flows for crosstalk glitch and timing closure using industry-standard tools, under the guidance of senior engineers. You will work closely with CAD and physical design teams, assist with tool qualifications, help execute tapeout ECO tasks, and gain exposure to modern automation - including AI-agent workflows - used to scale analysis across our largest SOC designs.

In this highly visible role, your primary responsibilities will include: Define and architect consistent noise and STA analysis methodology, margins, and tool/version qualification strategy, and drive deployment across multiple projects with minimal oversight comprehensive EM/SEB/thermal methodologies and drive deployment across multiple advanced node designs with minimal oversight Own and drive flows and scripts for core gate-level noise and static timing analysis tools end to end, from constraint setup through sign-off, including automation, quality metrics, and continuous improvement Conduct deep root-cause analysis of noise violations and timing-path anomalies, increasingly accelerated with LLM-agent pipelines that auto-triage and classify failures by severity, aggressor pattern, or known failure signature Serve as the technical authority and primary point of contact for design and Physical Design teams on noise/timing constraint, flow, and closure issues, surfacing best practices Drive noise and STA methodology improvements, using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot) to rapidly prototype and harden new analysis methodologies, margin models, and waiver-justification logic Build infrastructure for large-scale noise/timing report mining, QoR extraction, and visualization, including agent- or retrieval-backed natural-language query over report corpora Develop and support noise and timing ECO methodology and custom scripts for project tapeout Apply agentic diffing and summarization to accelerate tool and version qualification and flag regressions, while retaining human-in-the-loop judgment on signoff decisions and waivers Create documentation, guidelines, and specs, structured to also serve as grounding context for internal AI assistants supporting the team Mentor junior engineers on noise/STA analysis techniques and best practices

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline and 10+ years of industry experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with signal integrity analysis tools: Tempus, PrimeTime-SI, ETS/Celtic, or equivalent
  • Solid understanding of STA fundamentals and PrimeTime specifics (Tcl coding, attributes, commands, reports)
  • Strong Perl, Tcl, and/or Python scripting skills and a systematic debugging approach
  • Working knowledge of crosstalk, OCV effects, margins, constraints, aggressor selection, and correlation basics
  • BS or MS in a technical discipline
  • Ability to plan and execute tool/methodology evaluations, qualifying a new tool or tool version in a systematic, repeatable manner
  • Exposure to transistor-level analysis and SPICE simulation
  • Expertise in AI/ML-driven and agentic-workflow innovation for CAD and noise/timing flows (LLM-based triage, debug-copilot workflows, agent-based report mining)
  • Experience wrapping existing Perl/Tcl flow scripts as callable tools within an agent framework for natural-language-driven flow operations
  • Familiarity with noise and timing ECO techniques and implementation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills; ability to coordinate initiatives with design teams and CAD groups with little to no oversight

What you’ll do:

The Painter is responsible for sanding, cleaning, masking, and painting transformer units and fabricated components which require final finishing. All units must be painted before final inspection. The individual must produce an eye-pleasing, durable, painted finished product.

In this function, you will:
• Be responsible for the proper preparation of all surfaces to be sprayed; this includes bare metal areas and the proper sanding, feather edging of previously painted surfaces.

• Adjust and periodically check all pump pressures, heater temperatures, air and fluid pressures to maintain the best possible spraying application condition.

title: Welding Technician
description:
Eaton’s ES AMER ARS division is currently seeking a Welding Technician to join our Fibrebond team in Minden, LA!

The core hours average 54 per week between 6 am - 4:30 pm.

There is overtime every other Saturday from 6 am - 2:30 pm.

The hourly rate for this position is $24.20 per hour.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

What you’ll do:

The Welder Technician is responsible for setting up and performing advanced metal joining and cutting operations on ferrous and non‑ferrous metals, including steel, aluminum, and cast metals, with or without fixtures. This role supports fabrication and welding of structural assemblies, telecommunications shelters, skids, and other modular product lines in support of plant operations, while meeting Eaton’s quality and safety standards.

Fibrebond, an Eaton company, designs and manufactures pre integrated modular buildings and power enclosures that protect mission critical equipment for data center, industrial, utility, and communications customers. Headquartered in Minden, Louisiana, Fibrebond is known for its engineered to order solutions that support complex infrastructure projects across North America. In 2025, Fibrebond was acquired by Eaton, expanding Eaton’s modular solutions portfolio while preserving Fibrebond’s strong engineering expertise, customer focus, and manufacturing operations in Louisiana.

In this function you will:

  • Read and interpret blueprints, drawings, and specifications to perform advanced welding and fabrication of structural and mechanical components, including floors, walls, roofs, and assemblies
  • Set up and operate welding equipment to perform MIG welding and other required welding processes across plant operations
  • Perform high‑quality welds and fabrication tasks in accordance with blueprint requirements and supervisor direction
  • Grind, finish, inspect, and clean welds to ensure quality, accuracy, and conformance to specifications
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment by following safety procedures, performing housekeeping duties, and supporting 5S and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Communicate effectively by reporting equipment malfunctions, quality concerns, or irregularities to leadership
  • Support Eaton’s goals and philosophies through teamwork, professionalism, and continuous improvement
  • Perform other job duties as assigned

Qualifications:

Required (Basic) Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent from an accredited institution
  • Welding certifications in basic welding and MIG welding from a technical college or equivalent program from an accredited institution.
  • Must successfully pass 1G and 3G X‑rayed weld tests.
  • No relocation benefit is offered for this position. Only candidates residing within the immediate area of the Minden, LA facility (50-mile radius) will be considered for this position. Active Duty Military Service member candidates are exempt from the geographical area limitation
  • Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced experience reading and interpreting blueprints
  • Experience using hand tools, power tools, and precision measuring devices (e.g., grinder, saw, tape measure)
  • Experience welding complex structural assemblies or fabricated components
  • Prior welding experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment.

Skills & Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to stand, walk, sit, reach, grip, stoop, lift, carry, push and pull, and use hands for extended periods of time with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs., and push or pull 50 lbs. or more, with or without reasonable accommodation
  • Vision requirements include near and far vision, depth perception, and color discrimination
  • Ability to read a tape measure accurately to within 1/16 of an inch and apply basic math skills to blueprint specifications
  • Ability to communicate effectively, verbally and in writing, and exercise good judgment with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to read, comprehend, and assimilate technical information
  • Ability to maintain effective working relationships with all levels of employees
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of trade secrets, processes, and customer information
  • Required to wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE), including welding helmet, protective eyewear, and steel‑toed boots
  • Demonstrated ability to read and interpret blueprints, manufacturing diagrams, drawings, and operating instruction

title: Product Owner
description:
Dit ga je doen

Wil jij bijdragen aan de digitale transformatie van de werkplek en tegelijkertijd bouwen aan toekomstbestendige, soevereine digitale samenwerking? Krijg jij energie van het verbinden van techniek, gebruikers en stakeholders en weet jij uiteenlopende belangen te vertalen naar concrete resultaten? Dan zijn wij van DICTU op zoek naar jou!

Als Product Owner bij DICTU (afdeling Cloud Werkplekdiensten (CWD)) geef je richting aan de ontwikkeling en doorontwikkeling van de digitale samenwerkingsdiensten voor medewerkers van EZ, LVVN en KGG. Je werkt aan oplossingen waarmee medewerkers veilig en efficiënt digitaal kunnen samenwerken, zoals Microsoft 365, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Exchange, Entra ID en Seclore. Daarbij speel je een belangrijke rol in de digitale transformatie en de beweging naar meer digitale soevereiniteit, onder andere door de inzet van Nextcloud. Je verbindt de behoeften van gebruikers en de organisatie met de technische mogelijkheden en zorgt ervoor dat het team werkt aan de oplossingen die de meeste waarde opleveren.

Als Product Owner vertaal je de bredere visie en koers van CWD naar concrete doelen en prioriteiten voor jouw producten en diensten. Je bewaakt de balans tussen vernieuwing, verbetering en continuïteit van de dienstverlening. Daarbij houd je je onder andere bezig met:

• Het beheren en prioriteren van de backlog en het helder formuleren van backlogitems en gewenste resultaten.
• Het ophalen en vertalen van behoeften van gebruikers en stakeholders naar concrete oplossingen.
• Het begeleiden van de ontwikkeling en doorontwikkeling van digitale samenwerkingsdiensten, met oog voor innovatie, soevereiniteit en de dagelijkse operatie.
• Het creëren van transparantie over prioriteiten, voortgang en resultaten en het actief bijdragen aan Agile/Scrum-events.
• Het afstemmen met andere Product Owners en samenwerken met de Scrum Master, het team, de dienstverantwoordelijke, de Product Manager en andere stakeholders.

Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen strategie, techniek en praktijk. Je helpt het team focus te houden, maakt inzichtelijk waarom bepaalde keuzes worden gemaakt en zorgt ervoor dat iedereen samenwerkt aan hetzelfde doel. Daarbij heb je oog voor klantprojecten, veranderingen in de dienstverlening en de continuïteit van bestaande diensten. Zo draag je bij aan digitale samenwerkingsoplossingen die aansluiten bij de behoeften van vandaag én klaar zijn voor de uitdagingen van morgen.

Dit bieden we nog meer

  • Een salaris in schaal 12 (€ 4.818 - € 7.094 bruto bij 36 uur), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring
  • Een fulltime werkweek van 36 uur, met de mogelijkheid om (meer) uren te werken en extra verlof op te bouwen
  • Contract voor bepaalde tijd (12 maanden) met eventueel verlening
  • Een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) van 16,5% van je salaris dat je kunt inzetten voor extra verlof, uitbetaling op momenten die jij kiest of fiscaal aantrekkelijke doelen zoals een fiets, woningverduurzaming of aflossing van je studieschuld
  • Een goede pensioenregeling op grond van het ABP-pensioenreglement
  • Wij bieden een uitdagende functie met een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé en daarom werken wij hybride. Voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor of een externe locatie komt, ontvang je reiskostenvergoeding of reis je gratis met het OV
  • Uitstekende opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden via DICTU Academy en andere leerprogramma’s, zodat je je kennis continu kunt verdiepen
  • Goede verlofregelingen (onder andere zorgverlof en ouderschapsverlof) en faciliteiten zoals bedrijfsfitness

Dit vragen wij

Om voor deze functie in aanmerking te komen, verwachten we dat je:
• Over HBO werk- en denkniveau beschikt
• Zowel de Nederlandse- als Engelse taal uitstekend beheerst
• Aantoonbare ervaring als Product Owner hebt en bekend bent met een Microsoft 365 omgeving
• Affiniteit hebt met IT en digitale dienstverlening
• Jezelf SAFe POPM gecertificeerd mag noemen
• Ook CSPO- of PSPO gecertificeerd bent, of bereid bent om deze op kort termijn te halen
• Je weg weet te vinden in een omgeving met verschillende belangen en stakeholders
• Ervaring hebt met een Agile/Scrum werkwijze

De competenties die wij zoeken voor deze rol, zijn:

• Communicatief sterk
• Analytisch
• Plannen en organiseren
• Organisatiesensitief

Hier kom je te werken

Meer over jouw toekomstige plek in de organisatie

Met ruim 400 specialisten zorgt de divisie Generieke Diensten ervoor dat zo’n 22.000 collega's hun werk veilig en betrouwbaar kunnen doen. Dat doen we met een breed aanbod aan generieke ICT-diensten, waaronder werkplekken, mobiele apparaten en diensten voor veilige toegang, samenwerking en informatievoorziening.

Binnen deze divisie kom je te werken bij Cloud Werkplekdiensten (CWD). Het team zorgt ervoor dat medewerkers binnen EZ/LVVN/KGG beschikken over een werkomgeving met de benodigde applicaties en onderliggende infrastructuur. De keten Cloud Werkplekdiensten omvat IT-dienstverlening die direct gericht is op eindgebruikers. Daaronder vallen onder andere mobiele en vaste apparatuur, de persoonlijke werkomgeving, de ontsluiting van businessapplicaties, online vergader- en samenwerkdiensten, telefoniediensten en draadloos en mobiel internet. Om zowel een veilige werkomgeving als een goede gebruikerservaring te realiseren, wordt binnen CWD sterk ingezet op Microsoft 365 en de verdere digitale transformatie van het werkplekdomein.

Over Dienst ICT Uitvoering (DICTU)

DICTU is een van de grootste ICT-dienstverleners binnen de Rijksoverheid. Ruim 1.800 gedreven professionals werken in Den Haag, Assen en Zwolle vol enthousiasme en met focus op de klant aan voor Nederland belangrijke IT-systemen.

Wij ondersteunen vooral de ministeries van EZ, LVVN en KGG, inclusief hun uitvoeringsorganisaties zoals de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland en de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit. Daarnaast leveren wij bepaalde ICT-diensten ook aan andere organisaties binnen het Rijk.

DICTU legt zich toe op het ontwikkelen en beheren van systemen en applicaties en de bijbehorende dienstverlening. Dat kunnen bedrijfsvoeringsapplicaties, websites en apps zijn, maar ook digitale werkplekken en applicaties op het gebied van subsidies, inspecties en registers. Wij maken daarbij gebruik van moderne technieken en ontwikkelingen zoals Cloud, Mobile en Big Data.

Wij stellen kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid, continuïteit en informatieveiligheid centraal. Niet voor niets voldoen onze processen en systemen aan de internationale beveiligingsnorm ISO 27001. De Nederlandse burger mag erop vertrouwen dat de data en systemen die DICTU beheert niet in verkeerde handen komen.

DICTU vindt het belangrijk om een diverse en inclusieve organisatie te zijn. Werken in divers samengestelde teams maakt ons effectiever, innovatiever en het werk leuker. We streven naar een cultuur van gelijkwaardigheid en van veiligheid, waar je kunt zijn wie je bent. Waar je ingezet wordt op je unieke kwaliteiten en waar je gestimuleerd wordt om je talenten verder te ontwikkelen. We willen dat onze organisatie een betere afspiegeling van de maatschappij is qua leeftijd en afkomst. Daarom nodigen wij een ieder uit om te solliciteren.

Bijzonderheden

De vacature kan bij voldoende geschikte kandidaten eerder worden gesloten. Na het sluiten van de vacature zullen de vacaturetekst en de gegevens van de vacaturehouder online niet meer zichtbaar zijn. Om te voorkomen dat je deze moet opvragen, verzoeken wij je de vacaturetekst te bewaren

Ben je nieuw bij DICTU (en de Rijksoverheid)? Dan is de intentie om, na de periode van een tijdelijke arbeidsovereenkomst, de overeenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd voort te zetten. Wanneer je al een vaste overeenkomst bij de Rijksoverheid hebt, dan behoud je deze.

Tot slot vinden wij het belangrijk om een diverse en inclusieve organisatie te zijn. Werken in divers samengestelde teams maakt ons effectiever, innovatiever en het werk leuker. We streven naar een cultuur van gelijkwaardigheid en van veiligheid, waar je kunt zijn wie je bent. Waar je ingezet wordt op je unieke kwaliteiten en waar je gestimuleerd wordt om je talenten verder te ontwikkelen. We willen dat onze organisatie een nog betere afspiegeling van de maatschappij is en daarom nodigen wij eenieder uit om te solliciteren!

Sluiten jouw werkervaring en ambities goed aan op deze vacature? Dan zien we jouw sollicitatie graag tegemoet! Bij voldoende geschikte reacties zal de vacature eerder sluiten.

DICTU is groot voorstander van technologische innovaties, waaronder het gebruik van AI. We vragen je daarom transparant te zijn over eventueel gebruik van AI in je sollicitatie. DICTU maakt géén gebruik van AI bij de beoordeling van sollicitaties.

The Ultrasound Technologist performs high-quality diagnostic ultrasound examinations to assist physicians in the evaluation and treatment of patients. This role requires independent judgment, technical expertise, and a commitment to patient safety and comfort. The Ultrasound Technologist ensures all procedures are appropriately ordered, patient identification is verified, and imaging protocols are followed to produce accurate and reproducible results.

Essential Functions

  • Performs all ultrasound procedures independently, adhering to department protocols and ensuring high-quality, diagnostic imaging results.
  • Verifies patient identification and ensures the appropriate procedures are ordered and acknowledged prior to conducting imaging.

  • Maintains a clean, safe, and organized work environment, ensuring compliance with safety and infection control guidelines.
  • Operates ultrasound equipment safely and effectively, following departmental policies and manufacturer guidelines.
  • Accurately documents imaging procedures and patient information in the electronic health record system, ensuring all associated documents are scanned into PACS for radiologist interpretation.
  • Monitors and maintains an adequate supply of imaging materials and coordinates inventory replenishment as needed.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • 1-3 years of clinical experience as an Ultrasound Technologist required
  • 2-4 years of clinical experience as an Ultrasound Technologist preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Proficiency in ultrasound imaging techniques and equipment operation.
  • Knowledge of anatomy, physiology, and pathology relevant to diagnostic sonography.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively with patients and healthcare teams.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills to ensure accurate imaging and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently and make informed decisions within the scope of practice.
  • Commitment to maintaining patient confidentiality and adhering to ethical standards.

Licenses and Certifications

  • (S) - ARDMS or ARRT - Sonography certification or registry eligible required

title: VP, Chief Internal Auditor | Great West
description:
Permanent Full Time

The Chief Internal Auditor, Canada has responsibility for leading the talented, well-respected Internal Audit community team in Canada.

The primary role of Internal Audit is to assist the Board in discharging its governance responsibilities in monitoring and reviewing the effectiveness of systems of internal control, by providing independent reliable assurance that the organization’s governance, risk management and control processes are adequate, effective and sustainable.

The secondary objective is to work in partnership with the leadership team and business executives, developing strong and mutually beneficial relationships, to support and influence continuous improvement in the governance, risk management and control processes and practices through the sharing of best practices. Working as part of a dynamic Global Internal Audit team, the successful candidate will operate as “de facto Head of Audit” for all of the assigned businesses

What you will do

  • Ensure the function drives a best practice approach and has a strong customer focus.
  • Work to support stakeholders’ understanding of issues relating to the governance and risk management framework and ensure Internal Audit leverages the work being led by 2nd Line Risk and Compliance, while still providing the level of independent assurance expected by the Board.
  • Maintain a comprehensive, reliable risk profile across delegated areas that will be derived from high executive visibility/connectivity and a fundamental understanding of the underlying risks.
  • Have the ability to create a flexible plan from a “blank sheet of paper” based on collaboration with executives, management, Internal Audit colleagues, written documentation from Management and most importantly, from their knowledge and experience.
  • Deliver high impact written reports and presentations on pertinent governance, risk management and control issues to the Audit Committee, senior executives, regulators and other key stakeholders.
  • Instill a professional approach to the manner and methodology through which the Audit staff deliver their work.
  • Enhance the function’s performance while improving personal performance and career development to provide a professional and reliable audit opinion with the aim of continuous development of the control environment

What you will bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related discipline; CPA/CA designation is an asset.
