Aecon is seeking a Quality Specialist to support the delivery of utility-scale Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects under an Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) model. Working closely with the project, engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning teams, the Quality Specialist will support the implementation and maintenance of project quality requirements throughout all phases of project delivery.
The role will help ensure work is completed in accordance with contractual requirements, project specifications, applicable codes and standards, and Aecon's quality requirements through construction, commissioning, energisation, turnover, and closeout.
Location: Milwaukee, WI (preferred) or Port Huron, MI
What You'll Do Here:
  • Support the implementation and maintenance of the project Quality Management Plan and associated quality procedures.
  • Coordinate quality activities across engineering, procurement, construction, subcontractors, suppliers, and field teams.
  • Review project drawings, specifications, contracts, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and quality documentation to ensure applicable requirements are understood and implemented.
  • Perform and coordinate field inspections to verify construction activities comply with approved drawings, specifications, codes, standards, and project requirements.
  • Monitor quality requirements associated with BESS equipment, electrical systems, substations, and supporting civil and mechanical scopes.
  • Support supplier and subcontractor quality activities, including documentation reviews, inspections, material verification, and resolution of quality issues.
  • Identify, document, track, and support resolution of non-conformance reports (NCRs), deficiencies, corrective actions, and quality observations.
  • Maintain quality records, inspection reports, testing documentation, deficiency logs, NCR registers, and other project quality documentation.
  • Coordinate with construction teams to ensure required inspections and testing are completed and documented before subsequent work proceeds.
  • Participate in project and quality meetings and track quality-related actions through completion.
  • Support project turnover activities, including review and compilation of quality records, inspection documentation, test reports, turnover packages, and completion documentation.
  • Support commissioning and energisation readiness by ensuring required quality documentation, testing, inspections, and outstanding deficiencies are appropriately tracked.
  • Assist with internal and external quality audits and follow up on identified corrective actions.
  • Monitor quality trends and recurring issues and work with project teams to support corrective and preventive actions.
  • Promote a culture of quality, safety, continuous improvement, and operational excellence throughout project execution.
What You Bring to the Team:
  • Post-secondary education in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Construction Management, Quality Management, or a related discipline.
  • 3–5 years of quality, project coordination, engineering, or construction experience, preferably within EPC, power generation, transmission and distribution, renewable energy, utilities, or industrial construction.
  • Experience with BESS, substations, renewable energy, electrical infrastructure, or utility-scale power projects is considered a strong asset.
  • Knowledge of construction quality processes, including inspections, testing, ITPs, NCRs, deficiency management, corrective actions, and turnover documentation.
  • Understanding of engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and project closeout processes.
  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, technical specifications, inspection requirements, and project documentation.
  • Experience coordinating with engineering teams, construction personnel, subcontractors, suppliers, clients, and inspectors.
  • Strong documentation and record-management skills with attention to accuracy and detail.
  • Strong organisational, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and experience working with electronic project or quality management systems.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in both office and site-based project environments.
  • Ability to identify quality issues, communicate concerns effectively, and follow corrective actions through resolution.
  • This position is based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Regular travel to the Milwaukee project site will be required.

title: Application Support Engineering - SRE
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

Pay and Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
  • Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
  • Pension / Retirement benefits
  • Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
  • DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have in This Role

As an Application Support Engineer (SRE), you will help ensure the availability, reliability, and performance of mission-critical applications supporting DTCC’s Common Data Transfer Services (CDTS) platform.

This role combines hands-on application production support with Site Reliability Engineering principles. You will troubleshoot complex production issues, strengthen monitoring and observability, automate recurring operational tasks, and support the modernization of applications across cloud and container platforms. Working closely with Application Development, Infrastructure, and global Operations teams, you will help reduce operational risk and deliver stable, resilient services.

Your Primary Responsibilities:

  • Support mission-critical applications in production, ensuring availability, stability, performance, and operational readiness.
  • Monitor application and platform health, analyze alerts, and proactively identify reliability risks.
  • Troubleshoot production issues across Java applications, SQL databases, Linux/Unix environments, messaging platforms, and distributed systems.
  • Participate in incident response, root-cause analysis, and problem management, helping implement corrective actions that prevent recurrence.
  • Serve as a liaison among Application Development, Infrastructure, and Production Support teams to coordinate issue resolution and service improvements.
  • Support application releases, deployments, upgrades, change activities, and production validation.
  • Improve monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and observability using tools such as Splunk, Grafana, or Datadog.
  • Automate recurring operational processes to reduce manual effort, improve recovery, and minimize operational toil.
  • Develop and maintain runbooks, support procedures, knowledge articles, and troubleshooting documentation.
  • Support disaster recovery exercises, resiliency testing, operational controls, and audit-readiness activities.
  • Support applications and services across AWS, OpenShift, and containerized environments.
  • Collaborate with globally distributed teams and participate in a rotating shift and 24x7 support model.

Note: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in Application Support, Production Support, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or related disciplines.

Talent Needed for Success

  • Hands-on experience supporting enterprise applications in complex, business-critical production environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting and log-analysis skills across Java applications, Linux/Unix operating systems, and distributed platforms.
  • Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis, production investigation, and issue resolution.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, Grafana, Datadog, or similar platforms.
  • Experience supporting AWS-based applications and cloud services.
  • Familiarity with OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, or other container and orchestration technologies.
  • Exposure to messaging and event-streaming technologies such as Kafka.
  • Experience using ServiceNow or similar IT service management tools for Incident, Problem, and Change Management.
  • Understanding of SRE principles, including reliability, observability, automation, incident prevention, and continuous improvement.
  • Exposure to scripting or automation using Python, Shell, Bash, or a similar language.
  • Strong analytical, communication, ownership, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across Application Development, Infrastructure, Operations, and geographically distributed teams.
  • Ability to work effectively in high-pressure production environments and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume transaction-processing applications or distributed systems.
  • Familiarity with AutoSys or other enterprise job-scheduling platforms.
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and automated deployment processes.
  • Experience supporting Kafka-based applications or event-driven architectures.
  • Exposure to mainframe environments or application-modernization initiatives.
  • Understanding of security fundamentals, including certificates, credentials, access management, and operational controls.
  • Experience within Financial Services, Capital Markets, FinTech, or another highly regulated industry.

title: Materials Operations Assistant Manager
description:
Who We Are

The ONxpress Civils Contractor General Partnership, a partnership between FCC Canada Limited and Aecon Infrastructure Management Inc., is a multidisciplinary Civils Joint Venture (CJV) team with global expertise in delivering innovative solutions for both railway and civil construction projects. Working under Alliance agreements with Metrolinx, the team is helping to modernize railway construction across the GO Transit network.

An Alliance framework, which is relatively new in Canada, is a collaborative partnership between the owner and contractor, who work together with a best-for-project mindset. By streamlining decision making, the Alliance helps ensure that high-quality work is delivered, certified, and transferred in a progressive, transparent, and risk-managed manner.

The Alliance operates with a core focus on safety, efficiency, and sustainability, while fostering strong relationships with stakeholders and rights-holders and contributing positively to local communities as a good neighbour. Through this collaborative approach, the Alliance is helping drive the modernization of key sections of the rail network as part of the GO Expansion Program.

If you're passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a progressive and modern way of working, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Do

The Material Assistant Manager leads the planning, receipt, storage, preservation, control and distribution of construction materials across project material yards, laydown areas and work fronts. The role is accountable for material availability, inventory accuracy, yard organization, logistics coordination, traceability, cost control and safe material-handling practices, with particular focus on rail and track materials used in a complex, multi-contractor delivery environment.

  • Provide overall leadership for material management activities across project yards, warehouses, laydown areas, satellite storage locations and active work fronts.

  • Develop and maintain the project material management plan, including receiving, inspection, identification, storage, preservation, inventory control, kitting, issue, transfer, return and disposal processes.

  • Plan material yard layouts, storage zones, traffic routes, lifting areas, quarantine locations and controlled-access areas to support safe handling, efficient retrieval and future construction sequencing.

  • Coordinate forecast demand, procurement status, delivery schedules and installation priorities with Construction, Track, Logistics, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, Commercial and Planning teams.

  • Manage the receipt and verification of materials against purchase orders, packing lists, delivery tickets, specifications and inspection requirements, and promptly resolve shortages, damage, non-conformance or documentation gaps.

  • Maintain accurate inventory and chain-of-custody records for project materials, including lot, heat, batch, serial or asset identifiers where traceability is required.

  • Ensure appropriate storage, protection and preservation of rail, track and civil materials, including rail, turnouts, ties, fasteners, insulated joints, drainage products, cable, precast elements and other long-lead or sensitive items.

  • Establish material status controls for accepted, pending inspection, quarantined, non-conforming, surplus, returned and scrap materials, with clear physical identification and system records.

  • Coordinate unloading, internal movements, loading and final-mile delivery using approved lifting plans, competent operators and suitable cranes, forklifts, loaders, trucks or specialized rail-material handling equipment.

  • Align material release, picking, kitting and delivery with short-interval plans, work packages, possession requirements and site access constraints to prevent disruption to field production.

  • Lead cycle counts, stock reconciliations and periodic audits; investigate variances and implement corrective actions to protect inventory accuracy and project cost.

  • Monitor material consumption, waste, surplus, obsolescence and damaged stock, and support recovery, reallocation, return-to-vendor or approved disposal strategies.

  • Manage material yard personnel and service providers, including onboarding, daily coordination, competency verification, work allocation, coaching and performance follow-up.

  • Provide clear dashboards, shortage reports, delivery forecasts, risk updates and escalation of critical material constraints to project leadership and affected work-package owners.

  • Champion continuous improvement in yard organization, visual controls, digital inventory practices, handling methods and material flow across the project.

  • Set and adjust material priorities based on the construction sequence, work-package demand, available inventory, delivery constraints, yard capacity and approved project priorities.

  • Stop or reject unsafe unloading, lifting, storage or transport activities, and quarantine damaged, unidentified or non-conforming materials pending formal disposition.

  • Control the release, transfer and allocation of project materials in accordance with approved authorization, traceability and documentation requirements.

  • Escalate shortages, late deliveries, inventory variances, storage constraints and competing material demands with impact analysis and recommended recovery actions.

What You Bring:

  • 5–10 years of experience in materials management, procurement, logistics, or project coordination roles within railway, transit, civil, or large infrastructure construction projects.

  • Progressive experience in construction material management, warehousing, logistics or supply-chain operations, including direct responsibility for material yards or large laydown areas.

  • Demonstrated experience managing receiving, storage, preservation, inventory, traceability, material issue and field distribution in a complex project environment.

  • Railway, transit, trackwork or heavy civil construction experience is strongly preferred, including familiarity with rail and track materials and the constraints of active railway or possession-based work.

    Strong knowledge of safe material handling, lifting and rigging interfaces, yard traffic management, storage planning and environmental controls for outdoor materials.

  • Proven ability to coordinate suppliers, subcontractors, transport providers, quality inspectors and multiple construction teams while managing changing priorities.

  • Experience with inventory audits, shortage management, material reconciliation, surplus control and cost-conscious decision-making.

  • College diploma or university degree in supply chain, logistics, construction management, engineering, business or a related discipline is preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.

  • Valid driver’s licence required. Relevant equipment, lifting, hazardous-material or railway-access training is considered an asset.

  • Progressive experience in construction material management, warehousing, logistics or supply-chain operations, including direct responsibility for material yards or large laydown areas.

    Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel, material registers, inventory dashboards, document-control systems and enterprise resource planning or warehouse-management applications. Experience with SAP or comparable procurement and inventory platforms, barcode or QR-code tracking, and digital reporting tools is an asset.

    Ability to work a primarily day-shift schedule with flexibility for early deliveries, nights, weekends or urgent material requirements when project activities demand.

    Work is performed in offices, warehouses, outdoor material yards, laydown areas and active construction or railway environments and requires regular field presence, walking on uneven ground, situational awareness and compliance with site access and personal protective equipment requirements.

As a Senior RF Engineer you will provide technical leadership across the design, development, test and documentation of communications products and their manufacturing test systems, for an established manufacturer of mission-critical equipment for the aviation and defence sectors. This is a hands-on senior role: you will own RF circuit design from architecture through to detailed design, prototyping and troubleshooting, support hardware integration and test, and act as project technical lead where assigned. You will also mentor the wider design team, bringing others on while keeping quality and standards high.   • Ensuring product quality and maintaining standards across the team

To succeed as a Senior RF Engineer you will need:
  • Significant experience of RF circuit design, simulation, prototyping and development
  • Experience across the full product development lifecycle
  • Ideally a 1st or 2:1 degree, or equivalent, in a relevant technical subject
  • Knowledge of communications systems equipment specification, design or test, which is an advantage
  • An understanding of communications modulation techniques, which is an advantage

  • Experience delivering complex products to market to customer timescales, and managing project scope to deliver on time
  • Practical experience of analogue and digital electronics and of introducing new products into manufacturing
  • A basic understanding of network technologies
  • A positive mindset, flexible approach, high aptitude to learn and excellent problem-solving skills

title: Quality Auditor (Contract)
description:
Fantastic challenges. Amazing opportunities.

GKN Aerospace is reimagining air travel: going further, faster and greener! Fuelled by great people whose expertise and creativity sets the standards in our industry, we’re inspired by the opportunities to innovate and break boundaries. We’re proud to play a part in protecting the world’s democracies. And we’re committed to putting sustainability at the centre of everything we do, opening up and protecting our planet. With over 16,000 employees across 32 manufacturing sites in 12 countries we serve over 90% of the world’s aircraft and engine manufacturers and achieved sales of £3.6bn in 2025. There are no limits to where you can take your career.

Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-driven and independent Contract Internal Auditor to plan and perform quality management system and product quality audits within an aerospace manufacturing environment. The auditor will evaluate conformity to AS9100, applicable regulatory and customer requirements, and internal procedures; verify that products and production records meet defined requirements; document objective evidence; and support timely, sustainable corrective action. The role partners across Quality, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Document Control while maintaining auditor objectivity and confidentiality.

Job Responsibilities

  • Plan, prepare, and conduct risk-based internal audits of the quality management system, processes, and supporting functions in accordance with the approved audit program.
  • Perform product quality audits using drawings, specifications, work instructions, inspection plans, acceptance criteria, and customer requirements to verify product and documentation conformity.
  • Review manufacturing records such as work orders, inspection and test records, first article documentation, nonconformance records, certifications, and traceability records for accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
  • Collect and document objective evidence through interviews, observation, record review, and sampling; maintain clear audit trails and working papers.
  • Classify and write audit findings that clearly identify the requirement, objective evidence, and observed nonconformity or opportunity for improvement.
  • Conduct opening and closing meetings, communicate results professionally, and issue concise audit reports within established timelines.
  • Enter, track, and follow up on corrective actions; evaluate containment, root-cause analysis, planned actions, implementation, and evidence of effectiveness.
  • Identify recurring issues and systemic trends, and communicate risk-based recommendations without assuming process ownership.
  • Coordinate audit schedules and evidence requests with process owners while minimizing disruption to operations.
  • Support customer, registrar, and regulatory audits by retrieving records, explaining the internal audit program, and assisting with response coordination as requested.
  • Protect proprietary, export-controlled, customer, employee, and supplier information obtained during audits.
  • Perform other quality assurance and compliance activities within the agreed contract scope.

Job Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in aerospace, defense, or other highly regulated manufacturing quality, including direct audit, inspection, quality engineering, or quality systems experience.
  • Working knowledge of AS9100 and ISO 9001 requirements and the ability to translate requirements into an audit plan and objective-evidence trail.
  • Demonstrated experience reviewing manufacturing and inspection documentation, technical drawings, specifications, and product acceptance records.
  • Ability to write clear, factual, and defensible audit findings and reports.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and electronic quality/document management systems.
  • Strong communication, organization, analytical judgment, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to remain independent and objective when auditing assigned activities.
  • Must meet applicable U.S. Person requirements for access to export-controlled information under U.S. ITAR regulations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, Business, or a related field.
  • Recognized auditor training or certification, such as ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), Exemplar Global, or an AS9100 internal/lead auditor course.
  • Experience with AS9102 First Article Inspection, product/process auditing, aerospace customer requirements, FAA-regulated operations, or Nadcap special processes.
  • Experience evaluating corrective action using structured methods such as 5 Whys, fishbone analysis, 8D, or similar root-cause tools.
  • Experience with statistical sampling, trend analysis, and risk-based audit planning.

Compensation Data

title: AI-Native Product Engineer - Manager
description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

Turn emerging AI capabilities into products people choose to use, trust, and rely on. You will work as an end-to-end builder, close to users, product decisions, and production code, connecting the pieces that turn an AI demonstration into a durable product.

This role suits an engineer with founder-like ownership and the discipline to test assumptions early. You may move from a user conversation to a working prototype, from that prototype to a secure service, and from a production failure to a better evaluation in the same product cycle. Speed matters, but so do accessibility, maintainability, and the willingness to simplify when the evidence calls for it.

About Challenger

Challenger is a new EY program focused on building the firm’s next generation of services. It pursues opportunities where AI enables a fundamentally different service and way of delivering it, including rethinking existing offerings and developing new ones.

Small, dedicated teams build and test ideas in real conditions. Solutions that demonstrate clear business value and operational readiness transition to the business for adoption and scale.

Challenger Core develops and maintains the shared technology, methods, and risk and quality guardrails that support this work. Each team contributes reusable tools and practices, helping make the next service faster and less costly to build.

Your key responsibilities

  • Start with the user. Work directly with users and domain experts to understand real workflows, observe friction, and identify where AI can create distinctive value.
  • Test assumptions quickly. Turn product hypotheses into concise specifications, prototypes, and small releases that generate useful evidence early.
  • Own complete product slices. Build coherent verticals across the experience, services, data, AI behavior, and enterprise integrations rather than optimizing a single layer.
  • Shape AI behavior. Design instructions, context, retrieval, structured outputs, and tool use, choosing adaptation or tuning only when evidence supports it.
  • Build the evidence system. Create representative tasks and automated evaluations that show whether the product is useful, correct, safe, accessible, and improving.
  • Connect outcomes to behavior. Instrument user journeys so the team can relate adoption and task success to system behavior, latency, failures, and cost.
  • Engineer for responsible use. Build clear permission boundaries, secure data handling, human checkpoints, graceful degradation, recovery, and rollback into the experience.
  • Own production quality. Release incrementally, monitor live behavior, respond to incidents, and turn failures into durable product and engineering improvements.
  • Make practical trade-offs. Balance experience, quality, speed, reliability, and cost, using deterministic software when it is the more dependable choice.
  • Contribute reusable patterns. Share proven components and evaluation assets with the broader platform while remaining accountable for their performance in the product workflow.

Skills and attributes for success

  • Full-stack engineering: Strong ability to build maintainable production software across modern interfaces, services, APIs, data, and integrations.
  • AI application depth: Practical knowledge of model APIs, context design, retrieval, tool use, structured outputs, and agentic patterns.
  • Product judgment: Ability to find the real user problem, frame clear hypotheses, and simplify the solution when evidence challenges the original idea.
  • Evaluation discipline: Experience designing representative tests and experiments for systems whose behavior is not fully deterministic.
  • Production ownership: Strong instincts for observability, accessibility, security, performance, reliability, recovery, and responsible use.
  • High-agency collaboration: Comfort working across product, design, domain, platform, and control teams while staying accountable for the outcome after launch.

To qualify you must have

title: Summer 2027 - Process Simulation Engineering Intern - MS/PhD
description:
The group you’ll be a part of

The Office of the CTO is where innovation takes center stage. We inspire our global technical community to take on grand challenges, understand emerging trends, identify the critical inflections, and drive our sustainability, Environment, Social, and Governance (ESG) practices that will define the next generation of semiconductors and continued impact.

The impact you’ll make

As a Process Simulation Engineer Intern, you’ll help build a virtual twin of plasma etch processes. You’ll develop physics-based models of how plasma etching works and fast machine-learning surrogate versions of those models, together connecting tool settings to predicted feature profiles. Your work will directly support data-driven process development for Lam’s etch products.

What you’ll do

  • Build and refine models of how plasma etches a surface: ion and neutral species interactions with the wafer, sticking and reaction probabilities, redeposition, and ion energy and angle effects.
  • Calibrate model parameters against measured profiles (CD vs. depth from SEM/TEM images).
  • Design simulation experiments (parameter sweeps, design of experiments) to generate training data.
  • Build and validate fast surrogate models of the slower physics simulations, including checks on accuracy and uncertainty.
  • Use surrogates to explore which settings matter most and to optimize process conditions.
  • Write Python tools to automate simulation runs, data processing, and plotting.
  • Document the workflow and present results at the end of the internship.

Who we’re looking for

  • Currently pursuing an MS or PhD in chemical engineering, physics, materials science, chemistry, or a related field.
  • Strong Python skills, including hands-on experience building and training models in PyTorch (or a similar framework such as JAX or TensorFlow).
  • Background in reaction kinetics, transport phenomena, or surface/plasma science.
  • Hands-on experience building machine-learning or regression models.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, and the ability to work effectively in a team.
  • Note this is an onsite-flex position (3+ day in the office).

Preferred qualifications

  • Coursework or research in plasma physics or plasma-surface interactions.
  • Experience with surrogate modeling methods: Gaussian processes, neural networks, polynomial chaos, or reduced-order models.
  • Experience with GPyTorch/BoTorch, physics-informed neural networks, or uncertainty quantification.
  • Experience with design of experiments, sensitivity analysis, Bayesian calibration, or optimization.
  • Experience with physics-based simulation tools (finite element, Monte Carlo, or feature-scale/profile simulators).
  • Familiarity with semiconductor etch processes or SEM/TEM image analysis.

description:
PROPERTY MANAGER – LEAD THE WAY HOME

Are you a natural leader with a passion for people, performance, and properties that shine? If you know how to turn a building into a community and a team into a high-performing force, we want to meet you.

As a Property Manager at Two Coast Living, you’ll be at the helm of one of our multifamily communities, leading daily operations, managing on-site teams, and delivering an exceptional living experience for residents. You’ll own the numbers, the experience, and the culture, all while driving occupancy, resident satisfaction, and revenue.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Run the Show – Oversee all day-to-day operations, from leasing and resident relations to work orders and vendor coordination.

  • Drive Financial Performance – Manage budgets, control expenses, maximize revenue, and ensure rent collection stays on track.
  • Be Resident-Focused – Serve as the go-to contact for your community, resolving concerns, welcoming new residents, and creating a place people are proud to call home.
  • Keep It Looking Great – Conduct regular property inspections, support unit readiness, and oversee maintenance standards and capital improvements.
  • Stay on Top of It All – Submit accurate financial reports, manage payroll/commissions, and stay compliant with all local, state, and federal requirements.
  • Stay Plugged In – Engage with your local apartment association, keep up with competitors, and build a strong reputation in the community.

What We Offer:

  • A Leadership Role That Matters – Step into a full-time, on-site leadership position with visibility and impact.
  • Top-Tier Benefits – Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, plus a 401(k) plan with auto-enrollment after 60 days.
  • Time to Recharge – 40 hours of vacation in your first year, plus paid sick leave (based on location) and paid holidays.*
  • Tools to Succeed – Training, support, and technology to help you and your team thrive.
  • A Team That Has Your Back – Collaborate with supportive regional leaders and cross-functional teams across the company.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Experienced Leader – You’ve got at least 4 years of multifamily property management experience and 2+ years leading a team.
  • Detail-Obsessed & Organized – You stay on top of deadlines, follow through on commitments, and know how to prioritize.

At Mitsubishi Power, we're not just building better clean energy technologies; we're architecting a better future. Our team is boldly redefining power generation to accelerate the world's energy transition. We operate as one team, pushing toward our vision of the future. The Director, Quality Management - Construction & Commissioning, leads the enterprise-wide construction quality strategy across all power generation projects, including Simple Cycle, Combined Cycle, and Combined Heat & Power facilities.   • Define and enforce Inspection Test Plans, NCR processes, and turnover requirements.
  • Drive adoption of digital tools, analytics, and reporting systems to improve quality visibility and performance.
  • Lead executive-level quality reviews highlighting trends, risks, and corrective actions.
  • Develop and lead continuous improvement programs leveraging data, lessons learned, and RCA outcomes.
  • Drive zero-defect and zero-escape initiatives to eliminate repeat quality issues.
  • Lead root cause analyses for major quality events and ensure effective corrective actions are implemented.

  • Influence cross-functional teams, suppliers, and EPC contractors through governance, audits, and performance management.
  • Lead and develop quality teams, establish training programs, and build organizational capability.

  • Demonstrated experience leading construction or commissioning quality programs.

  • Experience implementing continuous improvement programs and preventing recurrence of systemic quality issues.

  • Experience developing quality KPIs, executive dashboards, audit programs, and risk reporting.
  • Strong leadership experience with responsibility for mentoring, developing, and directing quality professionals.
  • Ability to communicate technical and quality information effectively to senior leadership, customers, contractors, and project teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and develop corrective actions.
  • Proficiency with databases, project management tools, spreadsheets, word processing software, technical diagrams, flowcharts, and reporting systems.
  • OSHA 10-hour training or related safety experience recommended but not required.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 30%.
  • Ability to stand, walk, and work in moderate-to-loud industrial environments.
  • Ability to frequently lift or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift or move up to 50 pounds.

title: Staff, Platform Engineer AI Compute  (6034)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:

Machine-learning engineers need reliable access to GPUs to train and evaluate models. Shield AI’s AI Factory provides shared compute and development tools for these workflows, both for our engineers and for customer deployments.

We are looking for a Platform Engineer to make that compute platform easier to use, more reliable and more efficient. You will write software, improve how teams share GPUs, help developers troubleshoot workloads and use performance data to guide capacity growth. This is a hands-on software and platform engineering role.

What you'll do:

  • Build and maintain the software and configuration that let developers run GPU workloads on Kubernetes.

  • Design quotas, scheduling priorities, permissions and isolation so multiple teams can share compute predictably.

  • Automate deployment and upgrades of GPU services, including Run:ai, with infrastructure as code and tools such as Terraform and Helm.

  • Investigate why jobs wait, fail or run slowly, and fix recurring scheduling, configuration, storage and networking problems.

  • Build diagnostics that connect queue times, GPU utilization, memory requirements and training throughput to the developer’s experience.

  • Benchmark representative workloads and recommend when to add GPU capacity, how much to add and which hardware fits the workload.

  • Deliver repeatable installations and upgrades across cloud, on-premises and air-gapped environments.

Key Outcomes:

  • Developers can get the GPU resources they need through understandable access and resource policies.

  • Teams can diagnose slow or blocked training jobs and distinguish capacity shortages from configuration problems.

  • GPU expansion decisions reflect measured demand and workload performance.

  • Platform changes improve reliability without disrupting existing training workflows.

Required qualifications:

  • Experience building and supporting production Kubernetes platforms, including GPU or distributed computing workloads.

  • Strong software engineering skills in Python, Go or a comparable language.

  • Experience automating infrastructure deployment, configuration and upgrades.

  • Practical Linux, networking and storage troubleshooting skills.

  • Experience with shared resource scheduling, access controls or workload isolation.

  • Ability to work directly with machine-learning engineers, understand their workloads and turn recurring problems into maintained platform capabilities.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with Run:ai or comparable GPU scheduling and resource-management systems.

  • Familiarity with distributed training and tools such as Ray or PyTorch.

  • Experience delivering on-premises or air-gapped platforms, or contributing to open-source infrastructure.

Why Join Us

The AI Factory is the foundation for how Shield AI develops and deploys autonomy.

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you will help build the reference architecture used internally by our engineering teams and delivered to customers building their own AI capabilities. Your work will directly impact how quickly researchers can iterate, how efficiently compute resources are utilized, and how AI systems move from experimentation to operational deployment.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of modern AI, distributed systems, Kubernetes, and defense, building a platform that enables the next generation of autonomy systems while leveraging the best of the open-source AI ecosystem.

Responsibilities include performing stress analysis and related activities for new and derivative designs of interior furnishings and amenities as part of outfitting new aircraft. This includes review of engineering models and drawings, preparing load calculations, finite element models, and writing stress reports in collaboration with the Structural Engineering group and Structural AR's providing approvals. Additional responsibilities include aircraft level analysis such as decompression and floor loading analysis. The Lead Medical Coordinator is responsible for overseeing health services as well as coordinating the provision of timely, appropriate health services for children in care. Lead Medical Coordinators supervise Medical Coordinators and provide appropriate staff training on medical, dental, and public health topics relevant to pediatrics, adolescent, and migrant health. They are responsible for developing and maintaining policies and procedures for confidential health record management, triage of health concerns, medical emergency response, environmental health and safety, and post-release health care planning/care coordination.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The Lead Medical Coordinator will be responsible for the following:

  • Perform all work in a manner consistent with the National Youth Advocate Program’s mission, values, and philosophies.
  • Provide children with a positive and appropriate medical environment consistent with the National Youth Advocate Program’s mission, values, and philosophies.
  • Responsible for overseeing health services as well as coordinating the provision of timely, appropriate health services for children in care.
  • Supervise other Medical Coordinators and provide appropriate staff training on medical, dental, and public health topics relevant to pediatrics, adolescent, and migrant health.
  • Responsible for developing and maintaining policies and procedures for confidential health record management, triage of health concerns, medical emergency response, environmental health and safety, and post-release health care planning/care coordination.
  • Ensure confidentiality of health records and adhere to NYAP, State, and Funder guidelines for protected health information (PHI).
  • Ensure appropriate communication of health needs to case managers and clinicians.
  • Support in scheduling health care appointments in accordance with NYAP and other policies and procedures.
  • Assist in transportation of children to and from health care appointments and accompanying children during appointments.
  • Assist in obtaining medical clearances from healthcare providers.
  • Preparing Treatment Authorization Requests (TARs) prior to appointments and following up to ensure payments.
  • Ensuring qualified interpretation and translation services are in place.
  • Participate in intakes and discharges of children, preparing medical documentation package, and scanning/uploading documents in portals and health record systems.
  • Collaborate with children’s assigned cross-functional team and medical, mental health, dental, and pharmacy providers to ensure appropriate care to the children, including but not limited to assisting healthcare providers in completing the PCU process to become an approved provider.
  • Report medical emergencies via SIR/CLE process in accordance with ORR/NYAP’s policies and procedures.
  • Elevate issues of medical concern to supervisors, assigned cross-functional team, as appropriate, healthcare providers, and the Division of Health (DoH) for consultation and guidance.
  • Support foster parents by providing education on medical policies, answering questions related to the children’s medical care, assisting them with required medical responsibilities, and supplying them with necessary authorization and ID documents for medical services.
  • Collect forms and health records from medical providers, ensuring they are thoroughly completed and scanned/uploaded into the appropriate portals and health record systems.
  • Complete and submit all assigned documentation within the required timeframe, including placement documents, assessments, medical packages, medication and temperature logs, medical summary forms, medical checklists, and more. Upload documents to the appropriate portals and health record systems and ensure physical health files and records are properly filed in a secure location, in compliance with health record confidentiality requirements.
  • Regularly communicate with the children's care teams and strive to meet continuous quality improvement measures related to medical records and the timelines for uploads.
  • Maintain medicine cabinets and first aid kits by ensuring they are stocked with up to date over the counter (OTCs) medications, first aid supplies, and other essential medical items to promote the health and safety of the children in care.
  • Provide in-service training and ongoing education to staff and foster parents on the health-related needs of children, five rights of medication administration, CPR, and First Aid.
  • Maintain Red Cross CPR/First Aid Trainer’s Certifications
  • Assist and support Program Leadership during auditing processes.
  • Performs other duties as requested.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Licensed Registered Nurse (RN) with a Bachelor's or Higher health-related education qualification
  • Bilingual fluency in English and Spanish is required.
  • Minimum of 1 year of employment in public health or a healthcare setting with demonstrated experience in care coordination, health administration, or direct clinical care.
  • (1) year of experience working in the child welfare field working with children and/or adolescents in a social service setting.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license, excellent driving record, a safe and clean personal vehicle, and current automobile insurance.
  • Must be able to maintain compliance with attending agency required training programs.
  • Proficient use of desktop and laptop computers, smart phones and tablets, printers, fax machines and photocopiers as well as software including word processing, spreadsheet and database programs.

OTHER SKILLS

  • Experience scheduling medical appointments
  • Experience documenting medical appointments
  • Recognizes and understands the needs of the immigrant population, providing support and creating a safe environment for the children in the program.
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain liaisons with community health providers and expand community health network.
  • Must be open to and willing to work non-traditional hours and be available for on-call phone consultations as needed.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Use of manual dexterity, tactile, visual, and audio acuity.
  • Use of repetitive motion, prolonged periods of sitting and standing, and sustained visual and mental applications and demands.
  • Occasional lifting (up to 25 pounds), bending, pulling, and carrying.
  • Ability to travel frequently and drive vehicle while sitting for extended periods, with frequency varying based on program demands.

We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented individual to join our team as a Facilities Administrator. As a Facilities Administrator you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth and efficient execution of our daily operations. Your primary responsibility will be to assign jobs to contractors and service professionals, both at the beginning and end of each workday. In addition, you will be responsible for the following tasks:


Inputting updates onto the Corrigo system and sending emails to service professionals when their assistance is required for a job, whether it be for a callout or a quotation.


Raising Purchase Order Requests (POR) encompassing materials and planned jobs, ensuring that necessary resources are available for successful job completion.


Creating proposals on Corrigo for works over £1k, providing detailed information and pricing for customer consideration. Attaching relevant documents, such as job reports, costs, and funding requests onto Corrigo for easy reference.


Addressing customer queries promptly and professionally via phone, email, or the Corrigo system. Actively following up with service professionals to ensure timely response and resolution of callouts. Booking subcontractors onto job sites using designated booking forms, ensuring their availability and adherence to project timelines.


Inputting all job bookings onto a shared calendar to maintain an updated schedule for efficient coordination. Closing Work Orders (WOs) on the Corrigo system after successful completion of jobs, ensuring accurate recording and documentation. Creating and organizing folders on Sharepoint to store documents and maintain a well-structured and accessible filing system. Raising any remedial actions or follow-ups required following service visits to ensure customer satisfaction and resolution. Ensuring all compliance documents are accurately saved and securely stored according to company guidelines.


Requirements:

  • High level of organisation and attention to detail.
  • Strong communication skills, both oral and written.
  • Ability to effectively prioritise tasks and manage time efficiently.
  • Proficiency in using Corrigo and other relevant software applications.

title: Risk Consulting - Digital Risk (Cloud, AI, & Platforms) - TMT Sector - Senior Manager - Bay Area 1 1
description:
Location: San Francisco, San Jose, and San Mateo

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

EY’s Digital Risk practice is supporting leading Technology, Media & Telecommunications (TMT) companies as they scale cloud-native, AI-enabled, and platform-based operating models. Based in San Francisco, this role sits at the forefront of innovation, working with hyper-growth and global technology organizations operating on microservices architectures and AI-driven engineering environments.

We are seeking a Senior Manager – Digital Risk to lead risk, compliance, and control transformation across highly automated and continuously evolving ecosystems. This role requires a unique combination of SOX expertise, cloud architecture fluency, and a strong understanding of modern software development, including AI-assisted coding and end-to-end product development lifecycles (PDLC/SDLC).

You will partner with CFOs, CTOs, platform engineering leaders, and AI/ML teams to embed scalable, audit-ready frameworks into complex environments—enabling organizations to scale securely, meet regulatory expectations, and build trust with stakeholders.

Your key responsibilities

As a Senior Manager in our Digital Risk practice, you will lead multiple complex Digital Risk engagements, overseeing end-to-end program delivery, engagement economics, and team performance across cloud-native environments. You will act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, driving risk and control transformation within modern technology ecosystems.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead delivery of Digital Risk engagements across cloud platforms, microservices architectures, and AI-enabled development environments, including risk assessments, control design, and transformation initiatives
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders (e.g., CFO, CIO, CTO), delivering executive presentations and actionable recommendations
  • Drive business development, engagement performance, and team leadership, including budgeting, forecasting, staffing, delivery quality, and oversight of technical risk areas
  • Provide technical leadership as a subject matter expert, guiding teams on complex cloud, platform, and engineering risk considerations
  • Design and evaluate controls across DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, SDLC/PDLC processes, and distributed platforms, including APIs, microservices, data environments, and AI-enabled systems

Skills and attributes for success

Demonstrate deep understanding of cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, and modern engineering practices, applying that knowledge to design scalable, practical control solutions and guide teams on complex digital risk challenges.

Exhibit an AI-aware risk mindset, identifying risks introduced by AI-assisted development and automated engineering workflows. Demonstrate architecture fluency, interpreting distributed systems, data flows, and platform dependencies to inform control design

Bring strong engineering credibility, effectively partnering with DevOps, platform engineering, and data teams within complex environments. Leverage deep TMT industry knowledge to anticipate emerging risks in high-growth, platform-based organizations.

Operate with strong executive presence, translating complex technical risks into clear business insights and actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders while maintaining focus on scalable, evolving control frameworks.

Build strong client relationships, manage competing priorities, and consistently deliver high-quality outputs while driving innovation through automation and emerging technologies.

To qualify for the role you must have:

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in business, accounting, computer science, engineering, or related field.
  • A minimum of 8 years of experience in Digital Risk, IT risk, or technology consulting, focused on TMT sector clients with deep industry knowledge.
  • Strong hands-on experience in cloud platforms (AWS), microservices architectures, DevOps/CI-CD, SDLC/PDLC, and distributed systems.
  • Experience designing and assessing ITGCs and automated controls in modern environments.
  • Experience leading risk assessments, control testing, and transformation initiatives in cloud-native ecosystems.
  • Ability to translate regulatory requirements into engineering-aligned controls.
  • Exposure to data platforms and AI-enabled development environments.
  • Willingness to travel at least 50% and work extended hours as needed. A valid passport is required.

Ideally, you’ll also have

Relevant certifications such as CPA, CISA, CISSP, CISM, AWS Certified Solutions Architect/Security with cloud or AI certifications preferred.

What we look for

We’re looking for leaders comfortable operating at the intersection of risk, engineering, and innovation, with the technical credibility to engage meaningfully in modern technology environments. This role is well-suited for individuals who thrive in fast-paced, high-growth, tech-centric settings and are motivated by solving complex, evolving industry challenges.

A forward-looking mindset and bias for action are critical, along with the ability to deliver scalable, high-impact solutions in rapidly evolving environments. Candidates who are naturally curious, adaptable, and energized by continuous change will be highly successful in this environment.

title: Molding Operator - 2nd Shift
description:
Are you looking for a new career that gives you the opportunity to learn and grow in a supportive team environment? Do you want great pay and benefits while also having a good work/life balance? Then this is the job for you!

About Us: Haydon, Kerk and Pittman are three world class AMETEK brands that supply advanced linear and rotary motion solutions to a diverse mix of global customers. We are recognized as a leading manufacturer of brushed and brushless DC motors, stepper motor based linear actuators, precision Acme lead screw and anti-backlash nut assemblies, linear rail and guide systems, gearmotors, drives and complete custom automation sub-systems.

We are seeking to add a motivated Molding Operator to our team, on 1st shift. The Molding Operator/Inspector is responsible for producing machined parts by operating a molding machine. This position will also inspect the product produced and determine if it is acceptable and meets quality specifications.

On any given day, your responsibilities would include:

  • Working from drawings, blueprints, sketches, verbal or written instructions, work orders, and process sheets.
  • Operating injection molding machines.
  • Inspecting parts for surface defects and flaws.
  • Operating the blending machine to combine raw pellets.
  • Positioning and securing threaded cores and/or overmolds into mold.
  • Reporting defective materials, scrap, quality problems, or any other unusual condition or circumstance to technician and/or supervisor.

You are a great fit if you have the following:

  • High school degree or GED
  • 1-3 years of manufacturing experience and/or training
  • Strong fine motor skills
  • Reasonable dexterity in hands to manipulate small parts
  • Ability to read blueprints and measuring equipment such as micrometers and calipers is preferred
  • Ability to work well within a team or independently and a demonstrated initiative to drive for results

title: Projectmanager infrastructuur
description:
Dit ga je doen

Wil jij de leiding nemen over beeldbepalende onderhouds- en renovatieprojecten in het Zuid-Hollandse vaar- en wegennet? Als projectmanager infrastructuur bij Rijkswaterstaat stuur jij complexe instandhoudingsopgaven aan. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de planuitwerking en voorbereiding beweegbare bruggen in Zuid-Holland. Herken jij jezelf in deze opgave? Solliciteer direct of neem contact met ons op voor een eerste kennismaking.

Hoe jij bijdraagt

Als projectmanager draag jij de eindverantwoordelijkheid voor een gestroomlijnd proces en een goed projectresultaat. Je geeft richting aan het projectteam en borgt de kwaliteit, het draagvlak en de afstemming tussen alle betrokken partijen. Daarbij denk je inhoudelijk mee over technische, contractuele en omgevingsvraagstukken. Je stemt voortdurend af met regionale partners, gemeenten en aannemers om te zorgen dat de bruggen en vaarwegen in Zuid-Holland veilig en goed te gebruiken blijven.

Jouw werkzaamheden

  • Je stelt het multidisciplinaire integraal projectmanagement (IPM)-team functioneel aan en bewaakt de dagelijkse voortgang van de projecten.
  • Je werkt aan de planuitwerking en voorbereiding van omvangrijke bruggen- en renovatieprojecten in de regio.
  • Je bereidt de aanbestedingen voor onderhouds- en renovatieopgaven zorgvuldig voor.
  • Je stemt af met interne stakeholders, zoals beheerders, bedienaars en met externe stakeholders, zoals gemeenten, ProRail, en provincies.
  • Je bewaakt de budgetten, de risico's en de voortgang binnen het gehele traject.

Jouw team

Je maakt onderdeel uit van een multidisciplinair projectteam dat is ingericht volgens het IPM-model. Binnen dit team werk je intensief samen met de vaste rolhouders voor techniek, contracten, omgevingsmanagement en projectbeheersing. Samen vormen jullie het operationele hart van het project en zijn jullie de spil tussen Rijkswaterstaat, de regio en de marktpartijen.

Interesse?

Solliciteer direct via de sollicitatieknop op de pagina. Om het sollicitatieproces efficiënt en doelgericht in te richten, vragen we niet om een traditionele motivatiebrief. In plaats daarvan ontvangen we graag jouw beknopte reactie (maximaal 200 woorden per vraag) op de onderstaande vragen:
  1. Wat spreekt je aan in het werken bij Rijkswaterstaat en in de rol van projectmanager infrastructuur?
  2. Aansturen: kun je een voorbeeld geven van hoe jij een multidisciplinair team waarin uiteenlopende belangen en expertises samenkwamen, hebt gemotiveerd en aangestuurd om gezamenlijke doelen te behalen? Wat was jouw specifieke rol hierin?
  3. Omgevingsbewustzijn: kun je een voorbeeld geven van hoe je het krachtenveld tussen de interne organisatie, marktpartijen en externe partners effectief hebt gemanaged om een goed projectresultaat te bereiken?
We raden je aan om een concreet voorbeeld te gebruiken in je antwoord. Het kan je helpen de vraag te beantwoorden volgens de STARR-methode (Situatie, Taak, Actie, Resultaat, Reflectie).

Meer weten?

Heb je eerst nog inhoudelijke vragen over deze functie? Bel of app met Jorrit Nieuwenhuis, portfoliomanager, via 06 27 06 15 46. Hij staat je graag te woord!

Dit bieden we nog meer

Bij ons werk je aan mooie en betekenisvolle projecten voor heel Nederland, in een organisatie die jouw ontwikkeling serieus neemt en je waardeert als professional. Dat zie je ook terug in de arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • 144 vakantie-uren per jaar (bij 36 uur per week)
  • volledige OV-vergoeding of een km-vergoeding van € 0,07 of € 0,23 p/km (zie voorwaarden)
  • mobiele telefoon en laptop
  • budget van € 750 voor inrichting thuiswerkplek + thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,45 p/dag
  • pensioenregeling via ABP

Een omgeving die jou ondersteunt en kansen biedt

  • hybride werken is mogelijk, afgestemd op jouw werkzaamheden en in samenspraak met je leidinggevende
  • persoonlijke groei – opleidingen en loopbaanbegeleiding

Stel je arbeidsvoorwaarden zelf samen, passend bij jouw leven

  • Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) gebruik je IKB-budget van 16,5% van je salaris voor bijvoorbeeld de aflossing van je studieschuld, een (elektrische) fiets inclusief accessoires, bedrijfsfitness, verduurzaming van je woning of andere fiscaalvriendelijke doelen
  • flexibele verlofregelingen (zorg-, ouderschaps-, adoptie- en pleegzorgverlof)
Bekijk hier de volledige CAO van het Rijk.

Dit vragen wij

  • Je beschikt over wo-werk- en denkniveau, aantoonbaar door een bachelordiploma.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring als projectmanager met complexe infrastructuurprojecten en met het werken volgens het IPM-model.

Aan competenties breng je mee

  • Je stuurt resultaatgericht en weet concrete doelen te vertalen naar een heldere projectstructuur, waarbij je prioriteiten stelt en bijstuurt waar nodig.
  • Je bouwt en onderhoudt gemakkelijk relaties binnen en buiten de organisatie met partners zoals gemeenten, provincies en marktpartijen.
  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal uitstekend in woord en schrift.

Hier kom je te werken

Over Rijkswaterstaat

Rijkswaterstaat

Rijkswaterstaat is de uitvoeringsorganisatie van het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en bestaat uit 6 landelijke en 7 regionale organisatieonderdelen. Al meer dan 225 jaar werken we dagelijks aan een veilig, leefbaar en bereikbaar Nederland. We beheren en ontwikkelen de rijkswegen, -vaarwegen en -wateren en zetten in op een duurzame leefomgeving. Samen met anderen werken we aan een land dat beschermd is tegen overstromingen. Waar voldoende groen is, en voldoende en schoon water. En waar je vlot en veilig van A naar B kunt. Samenwerken aan een veilig, leefbaar en bereikbaar Nederland: dat is werken bij Rijkswaterstaat.

Talent als basis, diversiteit als kracht

Rijkswaterstaat is een inclusieve organisatie. Een organisatie die ruimte biedt aan iedereen en die de kracht van de diversiteit van medewerkers gebruikt om samen betere resultaten te halen voor Nederland. Inclusief betekent dat iedereen zich betrokken en gewaardeerd voelt; niet ondanks, maar dankzij de verschillen. Daarom nodigen wij jou graag uit, als jij je herkent in deze vacature, om te solliciteren.

Rijkswaterstaat Programma’s, Projecten en Onderhoud

Wil jij werken bij Rijkswaterstaat binnen Programma’s, Projecten en Onderhoud (PPO)? Dit organisatieonderdeel is verantwoordelijk voor het complete onderhoud van alle rijkswegen, vaarwegen, tunnels, bruggen, waterkeringen, sluizen en de bedieningsinstallaties in heel Nederland.

Naast het reguliere onderhoud wordt er onder andere gewerkt aan de renovatie van de IJsselbruggen en de Velsertunnel, de aanleg van de Markerwadden en het onderhoud aan de Maeslantkering. Verder zijn er testprojecten op het gebied van smart mobility, intelligente transportsystemen en het hergebruiken van grondstoffen.

Bij PPO werken onder andere inhoudelijke adviseurs en managers op het gebied van techniek, inkoop, contracten, projectbeheersing en projecten. PPO’ers delen hun kennis onderling en werken elke dag aan de verbetering van hun werkwijzen. Deze organisatie werkt actief samen met de andere onderdelen van Rijkswaterstaat en de diverse externe partners, zoals gemeenten, provincies, waterschappen en marktpartijen.

In totaal werken er ruim 1.200 mensen binnen PPO in 7 verschillende regio’s, verspreid over 4 directies: Inkoop- en Contractmanagement, Productie en Projectmanagement, Techniek en Technisch Management en Bedrijfsvoering en Projectbeheersing.

Wil je zien welke gave projecten we doen, bekijk dan deze video!

Bijzonderheden

  • Bij voldoende geschikte reacties kan de vacature eerder sluiten.
  • Om bij ons te werken, moet je een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) kunnen overhandigen, ook als je een interdepartementale transfer maakt. De kosten voor het aanvragen van een VOG worden door ons vergoed.
  • Je wordt ingeschaald op basis van ervaring.
  • Het inwinnen van referenties kan deel uitmaken van het sollicitatieproces, dit doen we altijd in overleg met jou.
  • Het maken van een casus en (online) screening via onder meer databanken kan deel uitmaken van het sollicitatieproces.

title: Cyber SDC- WAF & Internet Ingress & Edge- Manager
description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

PRACTICE DESCRIPTION

Business-critical applications depend on integrated application protection and application delivery services. Web Application Firewall, bot and DDoS protection, content delivery, load balancing, traffic management, DNS integration, certificate services, and cloud ingress platforms must operate as a coordinated service to maintain security, availability, performance, and user experience.

The WAF & Internet Ingress and Edge Manager leads the teams responsible for these capabilities. The role provides service ownership, operational governance, resource leadership, stakeholder coordination, escalation management, lifecycle planning, and continuous improvement across WAF and ingress platforms.

JOB SUMMARY

We are seeking an experienced WAF & Internet Ingress and Edge Manager to lead operational service delivery for enterprise application protection, load balancing, ingress, traffic management, and edge connectivity services.

The role is accountable for service performance, operational resilience, team effectiveness, customer engagement, risk management, application onboarding governance, incident escalation, platform lifecycle management, automation adoption, and cross-team execution. The manager works across application, cloud, networking, firewall, security, vendor, and operations teams to maintain secure, reliable, and supportable services.

Role positioning: This is a service ownership and people leadership role. The manager is not expected to perform every platform configuration personally, but must have sufficient technical depth to guide engineers, challenge designs, direct incident response, manage risk, and make informed operational decisions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Service Leadership and Ownership

  • Own end-to-end operational delivery for WAF and Internet Ingress & Edge services.
  • Establish service priorities, operating rhythms, ownership boundaries, escalation paths, and performance expectations.
  • Maintain alignment between WAF protection, application delivery, ingress, DNS, certificates, load balancing, and edge security operations.
  • Represent the service tower in customer reviews, governance forums, architecture discussions, and operational planning activities.
  • Ensure services remain secure, available, supportable, auditable, and aligned with business needs.

People and Resource Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop WAF and Internet Ingress & Edge engineers across senior and staff levels.
  • Manage staffing, work allocation, coverage schedules, on-call rotations, skills development, and succession planning.
  • Promote cross-training between WAF, load balancing, cloud networking, DNS, certificates, and automation disciplines.
  • Confirm team members follow standard work, change controls, documentation expectations, and operational procedures.
  • Identify capacity or capability gaps and coordinate staffing, vendor, or specialist support as needed.

Operational Governance and Service Performance

  • Own service metrics, SLA and KPI performance, operational reporting, risk tracking, backlog health, and improvement actions.
  • Lead service reviews, problem management, root cause follow-through, and corrective action governance.
  • Maintain clear intake, prioritization, approval, escalation, and lifecycle management processes.
  • Ensure customer dependencies, approvals, and handoffs are visible and appropriately managed.
  • Drive consistent documentation, runbooks, inventories, support records, and operating procedures.

Incident, Escalation, and Resilience Management

  • Serve as an operational escalation point for significant availability, security, performance, or application delivery issues.
  • Coordinate cross-team response across WAF, ingress, cloud, firewall, network, application, and vendor resources.
  • Provide or support incident command when major incidents require structured coordination and stakeholder communication.
  • Ensure recovery actions, communications, technical decisions, and follow-up items are documented and completed.
  • Use incident and problem trends to improve resilience, monitoring, runbooks, and support readiness.

Platform Lifecycle and Continuous Improvement

  • Own lifecycle planning across WAF, CDN, bot and DDoS capabilities, AWS ALB/NLB, AVI, Azure ingress, DNS, certificates, and associated automation.
  • Guide platform upgrades, maintenance, capacity planning, modernization, decommissioning, and vendor coordination.
  • Drive Infrastructure-as-Code, automation, configuration standardization, monitoring, and configuration drift remediation.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify onboarding, reduce manual effort, improve observability, and increase operational consistency.
  • Translate lessons learned into standard work and measurable service improvements.

Application Onboarding and Cross-Team Coordination

  • Govern application onboarding, protection, service exposure, traffic management, and operational acceptance processes.
  • Ensure ownership, dependencies, DNS, certificates, routing, monitoring, security, support, and rollback requirements are understood before production changes.
  • Coordinate with application owners and dependent teams to minimize disruption and resolve blockers.
  • Maintain clear accountability for business decisions, technical approvals, and operational responsibilities.
  • Support predictable handoff from implementation into steady-state operations.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in WAF, application delivery, load balancing, cloud networking, edge security, infrastructure operations, or related technical disciplines.
  • 3+ years of experience leading technical teams, service delivery, operations, or platform management.
  • Experience managing business-critical production services using formal incident, change, problem, and lifecycle management practices.
  • Working knowledge of WAF policy operations, CDN, bot and DDoS controls, AWS ALB/NLB, AVI, Azure ingress, DNS, SSL/TLS certificates, and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong customer engagement, leadership, communication, risk management, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading integrated WAF and application delivery teams in enterprise or regulated environments.
  • Experience with Cloudflare, Akamai, F5 Distributed Cloud, Imperva, AWS WAF, Azure WAF/Front Door, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience with Terraform, Git-based workflows, APIs, monitoring, SIEM integration, and operational automation.
  • Experience managing on-call models and coordinating major incident response.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AWS Solutions Architect, AWS Advanced Networking, Azure Network Engineer Associate, ITIL, or comparable credentials.

TECHNICAL AND LEADERSHIP SKILLS

Service Leadership

  • Team and capacity management
  • Stakeholder and vendor leadership
  • Cross-tower coordination
  • Coaching and succession planning
  • Decision-making under pressure

WAF & Edge Platforms

  • WAF, CDN, bot and DDoS services
  • AWS ALB/NLB, AVI, Azure ingress
  • DNS, certificates, routing and traffic
  • Terraform and configuration automation
  • Monitoring and configuration drift

Operations & Government

  • SLA/KPI and service review ownership
  • Incident command and escalation
  • Change, problem, and risk management
  • Lifecycle and roadmap governance
  • Standard work and continuous improvement

What we offer you
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

  • We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $144,900 to $265,800. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $173,900 to $302,100. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
  • Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
  • Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

  • Engineering degree, preferably in information technology, with a minimum of 7 years of experience
